3.6.3.d: व्यचस्वतीरुर्विया विश्रयन्ताम् । पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः । देवीर्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वाः । देवेभ्यो भवथ सुप्रायणाः । आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके । उषासा नक्ता सदतां नि योनौ । दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे । अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने । दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा । मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै
3.6.3.m: Wide-spreading, let them open wide, / like wives adorning themselves for their husbands. / O divine doors, lofty, all-impelling, / be easy of access for the gods. / Approaching closely at the holy rite, / let Night and Dawn sit down on the womb, / the two divine women, lofty, well-adorned, / putting on splendor, adorned with light. / The two divine hotṛs, the first, eloquent in speech, / measuring out the sacrifice for mortal man to worship,

3.6.3.s: pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū | prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā | ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametu | iḍā manuṣvadiha cetayantī | tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonam | sarasvatīḥ svapasaḥ sadantu | ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī | rūpairapiṃśadbhuvanāni viśvā | tamadya hotariṣito yajīyān | devaṃ tvaṣṭāramiha yakṣi vidvān
3.6.3.d: प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू । प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता । आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयमेतु । इडा मनुष्वदिह चेतयन्ती । तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं स्योनम् । सरस्वतीः स्वपसः सदन्तु । य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जनित्री । रूपैरपिंशद्भुवनानि विश्वा । तमद्य होतरिषितो यजीयान् । देवं त्वष्टारमिह यक्षि विद्वान्
3.6.3.m: impelling the singers at the assemblies, / pointing out the eastern light by instruction, / let Bhāratī come swiftly to our sacrifice, / [and] Iḍā making [it] conscious here in the manner of Manu; / let the three goddesses, the Sarasvatīs skilled in work, / sit upon this pleasant sacrificial grass. / He who shaped these two parents, heaven and earth, / and with forms [fashioned] all beings— / to him today, O hotṛ, urged [as] the better sacrificer, / to the divine Tvaṣṭṛ, sacrifice here knowing [how].

3.6.3.s: upāvasṛjattmanyā samañjan | devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi | vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ | svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena | sadyojāto vyamimīta yajñam | agnirdevānāmabhavatpurogāḥ | asya hotuḥ pradiśyṛtasya vāci | svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ
3.6.3.d: उपावसृजत्त्मन्या समञ्जन् । देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि । वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः । स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन । सद्योजातो व्यमिमीत यज्ञम् । अग्निर्देवानामभवत्पुरोगाः । अस्य होतुः प्रदिश्यृतस्य वाचि । स्वाहाकृतं हविरदन्तु देवाः
3.6.3.m: Let loose [the victim], anointing [it] personally / into the domain of the gods, the offerings in due season; / let the divine tree, the slaughterer, divine Agni, / savor the offering with honey and ghee. / Born instantly, he measured out the sacrifice; / Agni became the leader of the gods. / Under the direction of this hotṛ, by the word of truth, / let the gods eat the offering consecrated with svāhā.

3.6.4.s: agnirhotā no adhvare | vājī sanpariṇīyate | devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ | pari triviṣṭyadhvaram | yātyagnī rathīriva | ā deveṣu prayo dadhat | pari vājapatiḥ kaviḥ | agnirhavyānyakramīt | dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe
3.6.4.d: अग्निर्होता नो अध्वरे । वाजी सन्परिणीयते । देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः । परि त्रिविष्ट्यध्वरम् । यात्यग्नी रथीरिव । आ देवेषु प्रयो दधत् । परि वाजपतिः कविः । अग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत् । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे
3.6.4.m: Agni is our hotṛ at the sacrificial rite; / being a courser, he is led around, / a god worthy of sacrifice among the gods. / Thrice around the sacrificial rite / goes Agni, like a charioteer, / establishing delight among the gods. / Round about, the lord of prize, the sage, / Agni has traversed the offerings, / bestowing treasures upon the pious worshiper.

3.6.5.s: ajaidagniḥ | asanadvājaṃ ni | devo devebhyo havyā'vāṭ | prāñjobhir hinvānaḥ | dhenābhiḥ kalpamānaḥ | yajñasyāyuḥ pratiran | upapreṣya hotaḥ | havyā devebhyaḥ
3.6.5.d: अजैदग्निः । असनद्वाजं नि । देवो देवेभ्यो हव्याऽवाट् । प्राञ्जोभिर् हिन्वानः । धेनाभिः कल्पमानः । यज्ञस्यायुः प्रतिरन् । उपप्रेष्य होतः । हव्या देवेभ्यः
3.6.5.m: Agni has conquered; / he has won the prize. / The god conveyed the offerings to the gods, / impelled forward with bright colors, / prepared with milk-cows, / extending the lifespan of the sacrifice. / Urge [the offerings], O hotṛ, / the offerings for the gods!

3.6.6.s: daivyāḥ śamitāra uta manuṣyā ārabhadhvam | upanayata medhyā duraḥ | āśāsānā medhapatibhyāṃ medham | prāsmā agniṃ bharata | stṛṇīta barhiḥ | anvenaṃ mātā manyatām | anu pitā | anu bhrātā sagarbhyaḥ | anu sakhā sayūthyaḥ | udīcīnāṃ asya pado nidhattāt
3.6.6.d: दैव्याः शमितार उत मनुष्या आरभध्वम् । उपनयत मेध्या दुरः । आशासाना मेधपतिभ्यां मेधम् । प्रास्मा अग्निं भरत । स्तृणीत बर्हिः । अन्वेनं माता मन्यताम् । अनु पिता । अनु भ्राता सगर्भ्यः । अनु सखा सयूथ्यः । उदीचीनां अस्य पदो निधत्तात्
3.6.6.m: Divine slaughterers and human, begin! / Bring near to the doors [the victim] fit for sacrifice, / promising sacrifice to the two lords of the sacrifice. / Bring Agni forward for it! / Strew the sacrificial grass! / May its mother consent to it, / may its father [consent], / may its brother of the same womb [consent], / may its friend of the same herd [consent]. / Place its feet facing northward!

3.6.6.s: sūryaṃ cakṣurgamayatāt | vātaṃ prāṇamanvavasṛjatāt | diśaḥ śrotram | antarikṣamasum | pṛthivīṃ śarīram | ekadhā'sya tvacamācchyatāt | purā nābhyā apiśaso vapāmutkhidatāt | antarevoṣmāṇaṃ vārayatāt | śyenamasya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt | praśasā bāhū
3.6.6.d: सूर्यं चक्षुर्गमयतात् । वातं प्राणमन्ववसृजतात् । दिशः श्रोत्रम् । अन्तरिक्षमसुम् । पृथिवीं शरीरम् । एकधाऽस्य त्वचमाच्छ्यतात् । पुरा नाभ्या अपिशसो वपामुत्खिदतात् । अन्तरेवोष्माणं वारयतात् । श्येनमस्य वक्षः कृणुतात् । प्रशसा बाहू
3.6.6.m: Send its eye to the sun; / release its exhalation to the wind, / its ear to the quarters, / its life-spirit to the intermediate space, / its body to the earth. / Cut off its skin in a single piece; / before the navel is cut open, tear out the omentum; / keep the heat within it; / make its breast an eagle, / its two forelegs two wings,

3.6.6.s: śalā doṣaṇī | kaśyapevāṃsā | acchidre śroṇī | kavaṣorū srekaparṇā'ṣṭhīvantā | ṣaḍviṃśatirasya vaṅkrayaḥ | tā anuṣṭhyoccyāvayatāt | gātraṃ gātramasyānūnaṃ kṛṇutāt | ūvadhyagūhaṃ pārthivaṃ khanatāt | asnā rakṣaḥ saṃsṛjatāt | vaniṣṭhumasya mā rāviṣṭa
3.6.6.d: शला दोषणी । कश्यपेवांसा । अच्छिद्रे श्रोणी । कवषोरू स्रेकपर्णाऽष्ठीवन्ता । षड्विंशतिरस्य वङ्क्रयः । ता अनुष्ठ्योच्च्यावयतात् । गात्रं गात्रमस्यानूनं कृणुतात् । ऊवध्यगूहं पार्थिवं खनतात् । अस्ना रक्षः संसृजतात् । वनिष्ठुमस्य मा राविष्ट
3.6.6.m: its forearms two shafts, / its shoulders like tortoises, its hips unbroken, / its thighs curved, its kneecaps shaped like oleander leaves. / Twenty-six are its ribs; / remove them in their proper order; / make limb after limb of it complete. / Dig an earthly pit to hide the stomach-contents; / unite the demon with the blood; / do not tear its entrails,

3.6.6.s: urūkaṃ manyamānāḥ | nedvastoke tanaye | ravitā ravacchamitāraḥ | adhrigo śamīdhvam | suśami śamīdhvam | śamīdhvamadhrigo | adhriguścāpāpaśca | ubhau devānāṃ śamitārau | tāvimaṃ paśuṃ śrapayatāṃ pravidvāṃsau | yathā yathā'sya śrapaṇaṃ tathā tathā
3.6.6.d: उरूकं मन्यमानाः । नेद्वस्तोके तनये । रविता रवच्छमितारः । अध्रिगो शमीध्वम् । सुशमि शमीध्वम् । शमीध्वमध्रिगो । अध्रिगुश्चापापश्च । उभौ देवानां शमितारौ । ताविमं पशुं श्रपयतां प्रविद्वांसौ । यथा यथाऽस्य श्रपणं तथा तथा
3.6.6.m: thinking [them] an owl, / lest any sounder sound among your children and offspring, / O slaughterers. / O Adhrigu, perform the work! / Perform the work well! / Perform the work, O Adhrigu! / Adhrigu and Apāpa / are the two slaughterers of the gods. / May those two, fully knowing, cook this domestic animal, / strictly according to its cooking.

3.6.7.s: juṣasva saprathastamam | vaco devapsarastamam | havyā juhvāna āsani | imaṃ no yajñamamṛteṣu dhehi | imā havyā jātavedo juṣasva | stokānāmagne medaso ghṛtasya | hotaḥ prāśāna prathamo niṣadya | ghṛtavantaḥ pāvaka te | stokāḥ ścotanti medasaḥ | svadharmaṃ devavītaye
3.6.7.d: जुषस्व सप्रथस्तमम् । वचो देवप्सरस्तमम् । हव्या जुह्वान आसनि । इमं नो यज्ञममृतेषु धेहि । इमा हव्या जातवेदो जुषस्व । स्तोकानामग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य । होतः प्राशान प्रथमो निषद्य । घृतवन्तः पावक ते । स्तोकाः श्चोतन्ति मेदसः । स्वधर्मं देववीतये
3.6.7.m: Accept this most extensive / word, most pleasing to the gods, / offering oblations in your mouth. / Place this sacrifice of ours among the immortals; / accept these oblations, O Jātavedas. / Of the drops of fat, of ghee, O Agni, / O hotṛ, having sat down first, eat! / Rich in ghee, O purifier, for you / drops of fat trickle down, / according to your own law, for the feast of the gods.

3.6.7.s: śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryam | tubhyaṃ stokā ghṛtaścutaḥ | agne viprāya santya | ṛṣiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samidhyase | yajñasya prāvitā bhava | tubhyagg ścotantyadhrigo śacīvaḥ | stokāso agne medaso ghṛtasya | kaviśasto bṛhatā bhānunā''gāḥ | havyā juṣasva medhira | ojiṣṭhaṃ te madhyato meda udbhṛtam | pra te vayaṃ dadāmahe | ścotanti te vaso stokā adhitvaci | prati tāndevaśo vihi
3.6.7.d: श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यम् । तुभ्यं स्तोका घृतश्चुतः । अग्ने विप्राय सन्त्य । ऋषिः श्रेष्ठः समिध्यसे । यज्ञस्य प्राविता भव । तुभ्यग्ग् श्चोतन्त्यध्रिगो शचीवः । स्तोकासो अग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य । कविशस्तो बृहता भानुना'ऽगाः । हव्या जुषस्व मेधिर । ओजिष्ठं ते मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतम् । प्र ते वयं ददामहे । श्चोतन्ति ते वसो स्तोका अधित्वचि । प्रति तान्देवशो विहि
3.6.7.m: Bestow upon us the most excellent boon! / To you belong the drops trickling with ghee, / O Agni, beneficial to the poet. / A supreme seer, you are kindled; / become the protector of the sacrifice! / For you they trickle, O unhindered, mighty one, / the drops of fat, of ghee, O Agni; / praised by the sage, you have come with mighty light; / accept the offerings, O wise one! / Most potent fat has been lifted up from the middle for you; / we offer it forth to you. / The drops trickle onto your skin, O Vasu; / partake of them severally for each god!

3.6.8.s: ā vṛtrahaṇā vṛtrahabhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ | indra yātaṃ namobhiragne arvāk | yuvaṃ rādhobhirakavebhirindra | agne asme bhavatamuttamebhiḥ | hotā yakṣadindrāgnī | chāgasya vapāyā medasaḥ | juṣetāṃ haviḥ | hotaryaja | vi hyakhyanmanasā vasya icchan | indrāgnī jñāsa uta vā sajātān
3.6.8.d: आ वृत्रहणा वृत्रहभिः शुष्मैः । इन्द्र यातं नमोभिरग्ने अर्वाक् । युवं राधोभिरकवेभिरिन्द्र । अग्ने अस्मे भवतमुत्तमेभिः । होता यक्षदिन्द्राग्नी । छागस्य वपाया मेदसः । जुषेतां हविः । होतर्यज । वि ह्यख्यन्मनसा वस्य इच्छन् । इन्द्राग्नी ज्ञास उत वा सजातान्
3.6.8.m: O slayers of Vṛtra, with your Vṛtra-slaying energies, / O Indra and Agni, come hither with homages; / with your infallible, supreme boons, / O Indra and Agni, be with us. / May the hotṛ sacrifice to Indra and Agni. / Of the goat's omentum [and] fat, / let them enjoy the offering. / Hotṛ, sacrifice! / For I looked around in mind, wishing for wealth, / O Indra and Agni, to kinsmen or relatives;

3.6.8.s: nānyā yuvatpramatirasti mahyam | sa vāṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantīmatakṣam | hotā yakṣadindrāgnī | puroḍāśasya juṣetāṃ haviḥ | hotaryaja | tvāmīḍate ajiraṃ dūtyāya | haviṣmantaḥ sadaminmānuṣāsaḥ | yasya devairāsado barhiragne | ahānyasmai sudinā bhavantu | hotā yakṣadagnim | puroḍāśasya juṣatāṃ haviḥ | hotaryaja
3.6.8.d: नान्या युवत्प्रमतिरस्ति मह्यम् । स वां धियं वाजयन्तीमतक्षम् । होता यक्षदिन्द्राग्नी । पुरोडाशस्य जुषेतां हविः । होतर्यज । त्वामीडते अजिरं दूत्याय । हविष्मन्तः सदमिन्मानुषासः । यस्य देवैरासदो बर्हिरग्ने । अहान्यस्मै सुदिना भवन्तु । होता यक्षदग्निम् । पुरोडाशस्य जुषतां हविः । होतर्यज
3.6.8.m: no other care than yours is mine: / so have I fashioned a thought winning prizes for you. / May the hotṛ sacrifice to Indra and Agni. / Of the rice cake let them enjoy the offering. / Hotṛ, sacrifice! / To you, the swift one, they pray for messengership, / mortals always possessing oblations. / On whose sacrificial grass you have sat down with the gods, O Agni, / may the days be fair days for him. / May the hotṛ sacrifice to Agni. / Of the rice cake let him enjoy the offering. / Hotṛ, sacrifice!

3.6.9.s: gīrbhirvipraḥ pramatimicchamānaḥ | īṭṭe rayiṃ yaśasaṃ pūrvabhājam | indrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā suvajrā | pra ṇo navyebhistirataṃ deṣṇaiḥ | mā cchedma raśmīṃriti nādhamānāḥ | pitṛṇāṃ śaktīranu yacchamānāḥ | indrāgnibhyāṃ kaṃ vṛṣaṇo madanti | tā hyadrī dhiṣaṇāyā upasthe | agniṃ sudītiṃ sudṛśaṃ gṛṇantaḥ | namasyāmastveḍyaṃ jātavedaḥ | tvāṃ dūtamaratiṃ havyavāham | devā akṛṇvannamṛtasya nābhim
3.6.9.d: गीर्भिर्विप्रः प्रमतिमिच्छमानः । ईट्टे रयिं यशसं पूर्वभाजम् । इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहणा सुवज्रा । प्र णो नव्येभिस्तिरतं देष्णैः । मा च्छेद्म रश्मींरिति नाधमानाः । पितृणां शक्तीरनु यच्छमानाः । इन्द्राग्निभ्यां कं वृषणो मदन्ति । ता ह्यद्री धिषणाया उपस्थे । अग्निं सुदीतिं सुदृशं गृणन्तः । नमस्यामस्त्वेड्यं जातवेदः । त्वां दूतमरतिं हव्यवाहम् । देवा अकृण्वन्नमृतस्य नाभिम्
3.6.9.m: The inspired poet, seeking care with songs, / praises glorious wealth that receives the first share. / Indra and Agni, slayers of Vṛtra with good vajras, / extend our lifespan with new gifts. / 'May we not cut the reins,' thus praying, / keeping pace with the powers of the fathers, / the bulls exhilarate themselves for Indra and Agni, / for they are the two stones in the lap of the offering-place. / Praising Agni of fair radiance, fair to behold, / we pay homage to you, the praiseworthy Jātavedas; / you as messenger, chariot-wheel, oblation-bearer, / the gods made the navel of immortality.

3.6.10.s: tvaṃ hyagne prathamo manotā | asyā dhiyo abhavo dasma hotā | tvaṃ sīṃ vṛṣannakṛṇorduṣṭarītu | saho viśvasmai sahase sahadhyai | adhā hotā nyasīdo yajīyān | iḍaspada iṣayannīḍyaḥ san | taṃ tvā naraḥ prathamaṃ devayantaḥ | maho rāye citayanto anugman | vṛteva yantaṃ bahubhirvasavyaiḥ | tve rayiṃ jāgṛvāṃso anugman
3.6.10.d: त्वं ह्यग्ने प्रथमो मनोता । अस्या धियो अभवो दस्म होता । त्वं सीं वृषन्नकृणोर्दुष्टरीतु । सहो विश्वस्मै सहसे सहध्यै । अधा होता न्यसीदो यजीयान् । इडस्पद इषयन्नीड्यः सन् । तं त्वा नरः प्रथमं देवयन्तः । महो राये चितयन्तो अनुग्मन् । वृतेव यन्तं बहुभिर्वसव्यैः । त्वे रयिं जागृवांसो अनुग्मन्
3.6.10.m: For you, O Agni, were the first thinker, / and of this thought you became the wondrous Hotṛ. / You, O bull, made unconquerable / power to overpower every power. / Then, being most worthy of sacrifice, you sat down as Hotṛ, / in the place of refreshment, bringing refreshment, being worthy of praise. / Men seeking the gods followed you, the first, / paying attention [to you] for great wealth. / As if encompassed by many treasures, / the vigilant followed the wealth in you.

3.6.10.s: ruśantamagniṃ darśataṃ bṛhantam | vapāvantaṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsam | padaṃ devasya namasā viyantaḥ | śravasyavaḥ śrava āpannamṛktam | nāmāni ciddadhire yajñiyāni | bhadrāyāṃ te raṇayanta saṃdṛṣṭau | tvāṃ vardhanti kṣitayaḥ pṛthivyām | tvaṃ rāya ubhayāso janānām | tvaṃ trātā taraṇe cetyo bhūḥ | pitā mātā sadaminmānuṣāṇām
3.6.10.d: रुशन्तमग्निं दर्शतं बृहन्तम् । वपावन्तं विश्वहा दीदिवांसम् । पदं देवस्य नमसा वियन्तः । श्रवस्यवः श्रव आपन्नमृक्तम् । नामानि चिद्दधिरे यज्ञियानि । भद्रायां ते रणयन्त संदृष्टौ । त्वां वर्धन्ति क्षितयः पृथिव्याम् । त्वं राय उभयासो जनानाम् । त्वं त्राता तरणे चेत्यो भूः । पिता माता सदमिन्मानुषाणाम्
3.6.10.m: Agni, bright, visible, vast, / having the omentum, ever shining, / approaching the deity's place with reverence, / desiring fame, they attained unassailable fame. / They assumed indeed names worthy of sacrifice; / they rejoiced in your auspicious sight. / Settlements on the earth magnify you; / you are the wealth of both sorts of people. / You have become our savior, accessible, to be acknowledged, / father and mother always of human beings.

3.6.10.s: sa paryeṇyaḥ sa priyo vikṣvagniḥ | hotā mandro niṣasādā yajīyān | taṃ tvā vayaṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsam | upajñu bādho namasā sadema | taṃ tvā vayaṃ sudhiyo navyamagne | sumnāyava īmahe devayantaḥ | tvaṃ viśo anayo dīdyānaḥ | divo agne bṛhatā rocanena | viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ śaśvatīnām | nitośanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām
3.6.10.d: स पर्येण्यः स प्रियो विक्ष्वग्निः । होता मन्द्रो निषसादा यजीयान् । तं त्वा वयं दम आ दीदिवांसम् । उपज्ञु बाधो नमसा सदेम । तं त्वा वयं सुधियो नव्यमग्ने । सुम्नायव ईमहे देवयन्तः । त्वं विशो अनयो दीद्यानः । दिवो अग्ने बृहता रोचनेन । विशां कविं विश्पतिं शश्वतीनाम् । नितोशनं वृषभं चर्षणीनाम्
3.6.10.m: Agni is to be surrounded, dear among the clans; / the delightful Hotṛ, most sacrifice-minded, has sat down. / Such as you are, shining in the house, / we would approach with reverence on bent knees. / To you, O Agni, being newly well-disposed, / we, desiring favor, pray, seeking the gods. / You led the clans, shining, / O Agni, through the great luminous sphere of heaven, / the poet of the clans, the lord of perpetual clans, / the conqueror, the bull of peoples.

3.6.10.s: pretīṣaṇimiṣayantaṃ pāvakam | rājantamagniṃ yajataṃ rayīṇām | so agna īje śaśame ca martaḥ | yasta ānaṭ samidhā havyadātim | ya āhutiṃ parivedā namobhiḥ | viśvethsa vāmā dadhate tvotaḥ | asmā u te mahi mahe vidhema | namobhiragne samidhota havyaiḥ | vedī sūno sahaso gīrbhirukthaiḥ | ā te bhadrāyāṃ sumatau yatema
3.6.10.d: प्रेतीषणिमिषयन्तं पावकम् । राजन्तमग्निं यजतं रयीणाम् । सो अग्न ईजे शशमे च मर्तः । यस्त आनट् समिधा हव्यदातिम् । य आहुतिं परिवेदा नमोभिः । विश्वेथ्स वामा दधते त्वोतः । अस्मा उ ते महि महे विधेम । नमोभिरग्ने समिधोत हव्यैः । वेदी सूनो सहसो गीर्भिरुक्थैः । आ ते भद्रायां सुमतौ यतेम
3.6.10.m: The impetuous, refreshing, purifying, / radiant, worshipful Agni of riches— / that mortal has sacrificed and striven, O Agni, / who has reached your offering of oblations with kindling, / who comprehends your oblation with reverences; / protected by you, he attains all desirable things. / To you, the great one, we would pay this great homage / with reverences, O Agni, with kindling, and with oblations, / upon the altar, O son of strength, with chants and hymns; / we would strive for your auspicious favor.

3.6.10.s: ā yastatantha rodasī vi bhāsā | śravobhiśca śravasyastarutraḥ | bṛhadbhirvājaiḥ sthavirebhirasme | revadbhiragne vitaraṃ vibhāhi | nṛvadvaso sadamiddhe hyasme | bhūri tokāya tanayāya paśvaḥ | pūrvīriṣo bṛhatīrāre aghāḥ | asme bhadrā sauśravasāni santu | purūṇyagne purudhā tvāyā | vasūni rājanvasutāte aśyām | purūṇi hi tve puruvāra santi | agne vasu vidhate rājani tve
3.6.10.d: आ यस्ततन्थ रोदसी वि भासा । श्रवोभिश्च श्रवस्यस्तरुत्रः । बृहद्भिर्वाजैः स्थविरेभिरस्मे । रेवद्भिरग्ने वितरं विभाहि । नृवद्वसो सदमिद्धे ह्यस्मे । भूरि तोकाय तनयाय पश्वः । पूर्वीरिषो बृहतीरारे अघाः । अस्मे भद्रा सौश्रवसानि सन्तु । पुरूण्यग्ने पुरुधा त्वाया । वसूनि राजन्वसुताते अश्याम् । पुरूणि हि त्वे पुरुवार सन्ति । अग्ने वसु विधते राजनि त्वे
3.6.10.m: You who have stretched over the two worlds with radiance, / and through fame, being desirous of fame, a conqueror, / with vast, stout prizes for us, / rich, O Agni, shine far and wide. / Bestow always upon us, O good one, / abundant domestic animals along with men for offspring and lineage. / May there be refreshments, many and vast, with evils kept far away; / may there be auspicious renowns for us. / In many ways through devotion to you, O Agni, / many goods may I attain, O king, in your treasury. / For in you, O widely favored one, there are many / goods, O Agni, in you as king for the worshiper.

3.6.11.s: ābharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū | asmāṃ indrāgnī avataṃ śacībhiḥ | ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya | yebhiḥ sapitvaṃ pitaro na āyan | hotā yakṣadindrāgnī | chāgasya haviṣa āttāmadya | madhyato meda udbhṛtam | purā dveṣobhyaḥ | purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbhaḥ | ghastānnūnam
3.6.11.d: आभरतं शिक्षतं वज्रबाहू । अस्मां इन्द्राग्नी अवतं शचीभिः । इमे नु ते रश्मयः सूर्यस्य । येभिः सपित्वं पितरो न आयन् । होता यक्षदिन्द्राग्नी । छागस्य हविष आत्तामद्य । मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतम् । पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः । पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभः । घस्तान्नूनम्
3.6.11.m: Bring [wealth], give [it], you two with vajras in your arms; / protect us, O Indra-Agni, with your aids. / These now are those rays of the sun, / by which our fathers came to communion. / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Indra-Agni. / Let them eat today of the goat's oblation; / the fat is extracted from the middle. / Before malice, / before human seizure, / let them eat now.

3.6.11.s: ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānām | sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇām | agniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasanānām | pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata uthsādataḥ | aṅgādaṅgādavattānām | karata evendrāgnī | juṣetāṃ haviḥ | hotaryaja | devebhyo vanaspate havīṃṣi | hiraṇyaparṇa pradivaste artham
3.6.11.d: घासे अज्राणां यवसप्रथमानाम् । सुमत्क्षराणां शतरुद्रियाणाम् । अग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसनानाम् । पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामत उथ्सादतः । अङ्गादङ्गादवत्तानाम् । करत एवेन्द्राग्नी । जुषेतां हविः । होतर्यज । देवेभ्यो वनस्पते हवींषि । हिरण्यपर्ण प्रदिवस्ते अर्थम्
3.6.11.m: At the eating of the wide pastures expanding with grass, / freely flowing, belonging to the hundred Rudras, / consumed by Agni, clothed in fat, / from the flank, from the thigh, from the liver, from the rump, / cut off limb by limb. / Thus may Indra-Agni do; / let them enjoy the oblation. / Hotṛ, sacrifice! / To the gods, O tree, [carry] the oblations; / golden-leaved, from of old is your purpose.

3.6.11.s: pradakṣiṇidraśanayā niyūya | ṛtasya vakṣi pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ | hotā yakṣadvanaspatimabhi hi | piṣṭatamayā rabhiṣṭhayā raśanayā''dhita | yatrendrāgniyośchāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni | yatra vanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsi | yatra devānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni | yatrāgnerhotuḥ priyā dhāmāni | tatraitaṃ prastutyevopastutyevopāvasrakṣat | rabhīyāṃsamiva kṛtvī
3.6.11.d: प्रदक्षिणिद्रशनया नियूय । ऋतस्य वक्षि पथिभी रजिष्ठैः । होता यक्षद्वनस्पतिमभि हि । पिष्टतमया रभिष्ठया रशनया'ऽधित । यत्रेन्द्राग्नियोश्छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि । यत्र वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांसि । यत्र देवानामाज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि । यत्राग्नेर्होतुः प्रिया धामानि । तत्रैतं प्रस्तुत्येवोपस्तुत्येवोपावस्रक्षत् । रभीयांसमिव कृत्वी
3.6.11.m: Tying around clockwise with a cord, / carry [them] by the straightest paths of truth. / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the tree. For he has encircled [it] / with the best-prepared, fastest cord, / where the dear abodes of the goat oblation of Indra-Agni are, / where the dear places of the tree are, / where the dear abodes of the ghee-drinking gods are, / where the dear abodes of Agni the Hotṛ are; / there he has let it loose, as if to praise beforehand, as if to laud, / having made it, as it were, swifter.

3.6.11.s: karadevaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ | juṣatāṃ haviḥ | hotaryaja | piprīhi devāṃ uśato yaviṣṭha | vidvāṃ ṛtūṃr ṛtupate yajeha | ye daivyā ṛtvijastebhiragne | tvaṃ hotṝṇāmasyāyajiṣṭhaḥ | hotā yakṣadagniṃ sviṣṭakṛtam | ayāḍagnirindrāgniyośchāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni | ayāḍvanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsi | ayāḍdevānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni | yakṣadagner hotuḥ priyā dhāmāni | yakṣathsvaṃ mahimānam | āyajatāmejyā iṣaḥ | kṛṇotu so adhvarā jātavedāḥ | juṣatāṃ haviḥ | hotaryaja
3.6.11.d: करदेवं देवो वनस्पतिः । जुषतां हविः । होतर्यज । पिप्रीहि देवां उशतो यविष्ठ । विद्वां ऋतूंर् ऋतुपते यजेह । ये दैव्या ऋत्विजस्तेभिरग्ने । त्वं होतॄणामस्यायजिष्ठः । होता यक्षदग्निं स्विष्टकृतम् । अयाडग्निरिन्द्राग्नियोश्छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि । अयाड्वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांसि । अयाड्देवानामाज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि । यक्षदग्नेर् होतुः प्रिया धामानि । यक्षथ्स्वं महिमानम् । आयजतामेज्या इषः । कृणोतु सो अध्वरा जातवेदाः । जुषतां हविः । होतर्यज
3.6.11.m: Thus may the divine tree do; / let it enjoy the oblation. / Hotṛ, sacrifice! / Gratify the longing gods, O youngest one; / knowing the seasons, O lord of the seasons, sacrifice here. / With those who are divine priests, O Agni, / you are the best sacrificer among the Hotṛs. / May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt. / Agni has sacrificed to the dear abodes of the goat oblation of Indra-Agni; / he has sacrificed to the dear places of the tree; / he has sacrificed to the dear abodes of the ghee-drinking gods. / May he sacrifice to the dear abodes of Agni the Hotṛ; / may he sacrifice to his own greatness; / may he sacrifice for refreshments worthy of sacrifice. / Let him make the sacrificial rites, the Jātavedas; / let him enjoy the oblation. / Hotṛ, sacrifice!

3.6.12.s: upoha yadvidathaṃ vājino gūḥ | gīrbhirviprāḥ pramatimicchamānāḥ | arvanto na kāṣṭhāṃ nakṣamāṇāḥ | indrāgnī johuvato naraste | vanaspate raśanayā'bhidhāya | piṣṭatamayā vayunāni vidvān | vaha devatrā didhiṣo havīṃṣi | pra ca dātāramamṛteṣu vocaḥ | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtam | ayāḍagnirindrāgniyośchāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni
3.6.12.d: उपोह यद्विदथं वाजिनो गूः । गीर्भिर्विप्राः प्रमतिमिच्छमानाः । अर्वन्तो न काष्ठां नक्षमाणाः । इन्द्राग्नी जोहुवतो नरस्ते । वनस्पते रशनयाऽभिधाय । पिष्टतमया वयुनानि विद्वान् । वह देवत्रा दिधिषो हवींषि । प्र च दातारममृतेषु वोचः । अग्निं स्विष्टकृतम् । अयाडग्निरिन्द्राग्नियोश्छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि
3.6.12.m: When the prize-winners have approached the assembly, / the inspired poets seeking guidance with songs, / like steeds reaching the goal, / those men calling aloud upon Indra-Agni. / O tree, having bound with a cord, / knowing the proper ways with the best-prepared [cord], / do you carry the oblations to the gods, desirous of presenting them, / and proclaim the giver among the immortals. / To Agni Sviṣṭakṛt: / Agni has sacrificed to the dear abodes of the goat oblation of Indra-Agni;

3.6.12.s: ayāḍvanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsi | ayāḍdevānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni | yakṣadagner hotuḥ priyā dhāmāni | yakṣathsvaṃ mahimānam | āyajatāmejyā iṣaḥ | kṛṇotu so adhvarā jātavedāḥ | juṣatāṃ haviḥ | agne yadadya viśo adhvarasya hotaḥ | pāvaka śoce veṣṭvaṃ hi yajvā | ṛtā yajāsi mahinā vi yadbhūḥ | havyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya
3.6.12.d: अयाड्वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांसि । अयाड्देवानामाज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि । यक्षदग्नेर् होतुः प्रिया धामानि । यक्षथ्स्वं महिमानम् । आयजतामेज्या इषः । कृणोतु सो अध्वरा जातवेदाः । जुषतां हविः । अग्ने यदद्य विशो अध्वरस्य होतः । पावक शोचे वेष्ट्वं हि यज्वा । ऋता यजासि महिना वि यद्भूः । हव्या वह यविष्ठ या ते अद्य
3.6.12.m: he has sacrificed to the dear places of the tree; / he has sacrificed to the dear abodes of the ghee-drinking gods. / May he sacrifice to the Hotṛ Agni's / dear abodes; / may he sacrifice to his own greatness; / may he sacrifice for refreshments worthy of sacrifice. / Let him make the sacrificial rites, the Jātavedas; / let him enjoy the oblation. / O Agni, when today, Hotṛ of the people of the sacrificial rite, / you of purifying glow proceed—for you are the sacrificer— / sacrifice according to truth, since in your greatness you expand; / carry the oblations today, O youngest one, which are yours.

3.6.13.s: devaṃ barhiḥ sudevaṃ devaiḥ syāthsuvīraṃ vīrairvastorvṛjyetāktoḥ prabhriyetātyanyānrāyā barhiṣmato madema vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devīrdvāraḥ saṃghāte viḍvīryāmañchithirā dhruvā devahūtau vathsa īmenāstaruṇa āmimīyātkumāro vā navajāto mainā arvā reṇukakāṭaḥ pṛṇagvasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devī uṣāsā naktā'dyāsmin yajñe prayatyahvetāmapi nūnaṃ daivīrviśaḥ prāyāsiṣṭāṃ suprīte sudhite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja | devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī yayoranyā'ghā dveṣāṃsi yūyavadā'nyā vakṣadvasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja | devī ūrjāhutī iṣamūrjamanyā vakṣathsagdhiṃ sapītimanyā navena pūrvaṃ dayamānāḥ syāma purāṇena navaṃ tāmūrjamūrjāhutī ūrjayamāne adhātāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja | devā daivyāhotārā neṣṭārā potārā hatāghaśaṃsāvābharadvasū vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja | devīstisrastisro devīriḍā sarasvatī bhāratī dyāṃ bhāratyādityairaspṛkṣath sarasvatīmaṃ rudrairyajñamāvīdihaiveḍayā vasumatyā sadhamādaṃ madema vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu yaja | devo narāśaṃsastri śīrṣā ṣaḍakṣaḥ śatamidenaṃ śitipṛṣṭhā ādadhati sahasramīṃ pravahanti mitrāvaruṇedasya hotramarhato bṛhaspatiḥ stotramaśvinā''dhvaryavaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devo vanaspatirvarṣaprāvā ghṛtanirṇigdyāmagreṇāspṛkṣadā'ntarikṣaṃ madhyenāprāḥ pṛthivīmupareṇādṛṃhīdvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devaṃ barhirvāritīnāṃ nidhe dhāsi pracyutīnāmapracyutaṃ nikāmadharaṇaṃ puruspārhaṃ yaśasvadenā barhiṣā'nyā barhīgṣyabhiṣyāma vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja | devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛthsudraviṇā mandraḥ kaviḥ satyamanmā''yajī hotā hotur hoturāyajīyānagne yāndevānayāḍyāṃ apiprerye te hotre amathsata tāṃ sasanuṣīṃ hotrāṃ devaṃgamāṃ divi deveṣu yajñamerayemaṃ sviṣṭakṛccāgne hotā'bhūrvasuvane vasudheyasya namovāke vīhi yaja
3.6.13.d: देवं बर्हिः सुदेवं देवैः स्याथ्सुवीरं वीरैर्वस्तोर्वृज्येताक्तोः प्रभ्रियेतात्यन्यान्राया बर्हिष्मतो मदेम वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवीर्द्वारः संघाते विड्वीर्यामञ्छिथिरा ध्रुवा देवहूतौ वथ्स ईमेनास्तरुण आमिमीयात्कुमारो वा नवजातो मैना अर्वा रेणुककाटः पृणग्वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवी उषासा नक्ताऽद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे प्रयत्यह्वेतामपि नूनं दैवीर्विशः प्रायासिष्टां सुप्रीते सुधिते वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज । देवी जोष्ट्री वसुधिती ययोरन्याऽघा द्वेषांसि यूयवदाऽन्या वक्षद्वसु वार्याणि यजमानाय वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज । देवी ऊर्जाहुती इषमूर्जमन्या वक्षथ्सग्धिं सपीतिमन्या नवेन पूर्वं दयमानाः स्याम पुराणेन नवं तामूर्जमूर्जाहुती ऊर्जयमाने अधातां वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज । देवा दैव्याहोतारा नेष्टारा पोतारा हताघशंसावाभरद्वसू वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीतां यज । देवीस्तिस्रस्तिस्रो देवीरिडा सरस्वती भारती द्यां भारत्यादित्यैरस्पृक्षथ् सरस्वतीमं रुद्रैर्यज्ञमावीदिहैवेडया वसुमत्या सधमादं मदेम वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु यज । देवो नराशंसस्त्रि शीर्षा षडक्षः शतमिदेनं शितिपृष्ठा आदधति सहस्रमीं प्रवहन्ति मित्रावरुणेदस्य होत्रमर्हतो बृहस्पतिः स्तोत्रमश्विना'ऽध्वर्यवं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवो वनस्पतिर्वर्षप्रावा घृतनिर्णिग्द्यामग्रेणास्पृक्षदाऽन्तरिक्षं मध्येनाप्राः पृथिवीमुपरेणादृंहीद्वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनां निधे धासि प्रच्युतीनामप्रच्युतं निकामधरणं पुरुस्पार्हं यशस्वदेना बर्हिषाऽन्या बर्हीग्ष्यभिष्याम वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु यज । देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृथ्सुद्रविणा मन्द्रः कविः सत्यमन्मा'ऽयजी होता होतुर् होतुरायजीयानग्ने यान्देवानयाड्यां अपिप्रेर्ये ते होत्रे अमथ्सत तां ससनुषीं होत्रां देवंगमां दिवि देवेषु यज्ञमेरयेमं स्विष्टकृच्चाग्ने होताऽभूर्वसुवने वसुधेयस्य नमोवाके वीहि यज
3.6.13.m: May the divine sacrificial grass be rich in gods together with the gods, rich in heroes together with heroes; by day let it be plucked, by night brought forward; may we exult surpassing others in wealth by having sacrificial grass! May it enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / May the divine doors, firm in joint and loose in movement, be steadfast at the invocation of the gods; may a young calf bleat around them, or a newborn boy; let not the dust-scattering courser touch them! May they enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / May the divine Dawn and Night, as this sacrifice proceeds today, call [the gods]; may they now advance to the divine clans, well-pleased, well-established! May they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The two divine loving ones, bestowers of wealth: of them, may the one keep afar evils and enmities, may the other bring wealth and choice goods for the sacrificer! May they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The two divine oblations of vigor: may the one bring refreshment and vigor, the other common meals and drinking together; may we, distributing the old with the new, the new with the old, [abide]! That vigor the two oblations of vigor, bestowing vigor, have established. May they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The two divine hotṛs, the neṣṭṛs, the potṛs, slayers of him who speaks evil, bringing wealth! May they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The three divine goddesses, Iḍā, Sarasvatī, Bhāratī: may Bhāratī touch heaven together with the Ādityas; Sarasvatī has favored this sacrifice together with the Rudras; right here, along with Iḍā who possesses wealth, may we rejoice in communal delight! May they enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The divine Narāśaṃsa, three-headed, six-eyed: a hundred white-backed [horses] carry him forward, a thousand bear him along; Mitra and Varuṇa are worthy of his office of hotṛ, Bṛhaspati of his praise-song, the Aśvins of his adhvaryu-offices. May he enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The divine Vanaspati, furthering the rain, robed in ghee: with his top he has touched heaven, with his middle he has filled the intermediate space, with his base he has made firm the earth. May he enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The divine sacrificial grass, foundation for the placement of flowing [waters], unmoved among things that fall away, providing whatever is desired, much coveted, glorious: by this sacrificial grass may we surpass other sacrificial grasses! May it enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse! / The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, possessing good wealth, cheerful, wise, true of thought, well-sacrificing hotṛ, more sacrificing than any hotṛ: O Agni, the gods whom you have sacrificed to, whom you have gratified, who rejoiced in your hotṛ-office, send that successful priestly invocation which reaches the gods, [send] this sacrifice in heaven to the gods! You have become, O Agni, the hotṛ that makes the sacrifice right; enjoy [the offering] at the utterance of homage for the winning of wealth; recite the offering verse!

3.6.14.s: devaṃ barhiḥ | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu | devīrdvāraḥ | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu | devī uṣāsānaktā | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām | devī joṣṭrī | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām | devī ūrjāhutī | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām
3.6.14.d: देवं बर्हिः । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु । देवीर्द्वारः । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु । देवी उषासानक्ता । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम् । देवी जोष्ट्री । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम् । देवी ऊर्जाहुती । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम्
3.6.14.m: The divine sacrificial grass: / may it enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The divine doors: / may they enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The divine Dawn and Night: / may they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The two divine loving ones: / may they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The two divine oblations of vigor: / may they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth!

3.6.14.s: devā daivyā hotārā | vasuvane vasudheyasya vītām | devīstisrastisro devīḥ | vasuvane vasudheyasya viyantu | devo narāśaṃsaḥ | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu | devo vanaspatiḥ | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu | devaṃ barhirvāritīnām | vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu
3.6.14.d: देवा दैव्या होतारा । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वीताम् । देवीस्तिस्रस्तिस्रो देवीः । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वियन्तु । देवो नराशंसः । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु । देवो वनस्पतिः । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु । देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनाम् । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य वेतु
3.6.14.m: The two divine hotṛs: / may they two enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The three divine goddesses: / may they enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The divine Narāśaṃsa: / may he enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The divine Vanaspati: / may he enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth! / The divine sacrificial grass of the flowing [waters]: / may it enjoy the gift of wealth for the winning of wealth!

3.6.14.s: devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | sudraviṇā mandraḥ kaviḥ | satyamanmā''yajī hotā | hotur hoturāyajīyān | agneyāndevānayāṭ | yāṃ apipreḥ | ye te hotre amathsata | tāṃ sasanuṣīṃ hotrāṃ devaṃgamām | divi deveṣu yajñamerayemam | sviṣṭakṛccāgne hotā'bhūḥ | vasuvane vasudheyasya namovāke vīhi
3.6.14.d: देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृत् । सुद्रविणा मन्द्रः कविः । सत्यमन्मा'ऽयजी होता । होतुर् होतुरायजीयान् । अग्नेयान्देवानयाट् । यां अपिप्रेः । ये ते होत्रे अमथ्सत । तां ससनुषीं होत्रां देवंगमाम् । दिवि देवेषु यज्ञमेरयेमम् । स्विष्टकृच्चाग्ने होताऽभूः । वसुवने वसुधेयस्य नमोवाके वीहि
3.6.14.m: The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, / possessing good wealth, cheerful, wise, / true of thought, the well-sacrificing hotṛ, / more sacrificing than any hotṛ: / O Agni, the gods whom you have sacrificed to, / whom you have gratified, / who rejoiced in your hotṛ-office, / that successful priestly invocation which reaches the gods, / send this sacrifice in heaven to the gods! / You have become, O Agni, the hotṛ that makes the sacrifice right; / enjoy [the offering] at the utterance of homage for the winning of wealth!

3.6.15.s: agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamānaḥ pacanpaktīḥ pacanpuroḍāśaṃ badhnannindrāgnibhyāṃ chāgaṃ sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadindrāgnibhyāṃ chāgenāghastāṃ taṃ medastaḥ prati pacatā'grabhīṣṭāmavīvṛdhetāṃ puroḍāśena tvāmadyarṣa ārṣeyarṣīṇāṃ napādavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāno bahubhya ā saṃgatebhya eṣa me deveṣu vasu vāryāyakṣyata iti tā yā devā devadānānyadustānyasmā ā ca śāsvā ca gurasveṣitaśca hotarasi bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhi
3.6.15.d: अग्निमद्य होतारमवृणीतायं यजमानः पचन्पक्तीः पचन्पुरोडाशं बध्नन्निन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागं सूपस्था अद्य देवो वनस्पतिरभवदिन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागेनाघस्तां तं मेदस्तः प्रति पचताऽग्रभीष्टामवीवृधेतां पुरोडाशेन त्वामद्यर्ष आर्षेयर्षीणां नपादवृणीतायं यजमानो बहुभ्य आ संगतेभ्य एष मे देवेषु वसु वार्यायक्ष्यत इति ता या देवा देवदानान्यदुस्तान्यस्मा आ च शास्वा च गुरस्वेषितश्च होतरसि भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रूहि
3.6.15.m: Today this sacrificer has chosen Agni as hotṛ, cooking the cooked offerings, cooking the sacrificial cake, binding the he-goat for Indra and Agni. The divine Vanaspati was today a good resting place for Indra and Agni with the he-goat; they two have eaten from the fat, they have accepted the cooked offering, they have grown strong by the sacrificial cake. Today, O seer, of seers' descent, grandson of seers, this sacrificer has chosen you from among many who have assembled, saying, 'This one will sacrifice for me among the gods for wealth and choice goods.' Whatever gifts of the gods the gods have given, teach them, promise them to him! And you, O hotṛ, are sent for good utterance; human [hotṛ], directed for the sūktavāka, utter the well-spoken hymns!

3.7.1.s: sarvān vā eṣo'gnau kāmānpraveśayati | yo'gnīnanvādhāya vratamupaiti | sa yadaniṣṭvā prayāyāt | akāmaprītā enaṃ kāmā nānuprayāyuḥ | atejā avīryaḥ syāt | sa juhuyāt | tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama | viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak | agne kāmāya yemira iti | kāmānevāsmindadhāti
3.7.1.d: सर्वान् वा एषोऽग्नौ कामान्प्रवेशयति । योऽग्नीनन्वाधाय व्रतमुपैति । स यदनिष्ट्वा प्रयायात् । अकामप्रीता एनं कामा नानुप्रयायुः । अतेजा अवीर्यः स्यात् । स जुहुयात् । तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम । विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् । अग्ने कामाय येमिर इति । कामानेवास्मिन्दधाति
3.7.1.m: Truly, he causes all desires to enter into the fire, / who, having added the firewoods to the fires, enters upon the vow. / If he should set out without having sacrificed, / desires, unsatisfied by desire, would not follow after him; / he would be without fiery energy, without heroic power. / He should make an offering: / 'To you those / all safe dwellings individually, / O Agni, have yielded to desire'—so saying; / he thereby places desires in himself.

3.7.1.s: kāmaprītā enaṃ kāmā anu prayānti | tejasvī vīryāvānbhavati | saṃtatirvā eṣā yajñasya | yo'gnīnanvādhāya vratamupaiti | sa yadudvāyati | vicchittirevāsya sā | taṃ prāñcamuddhṛtya | manasopatiṣṭheta | mano vai prajāpatiḥ | prājāpatyo yajñaḥ
3.7.1.d: कामप्रीता एनं कामा अनु प्रयान्ति । तेजस्वी वीर्यावान्भवति । संततिर्वा एषा यज्ञस्य । योऽग्नीनन्वाधाय व्रतमुपैति । स यदुद्वायति । विच्छित्तिरेवास्य सा । तं प्राञ्चमुद्धृत्य । मनसोपतिष्ठेत । मनो वै प्रजापतिः । प्राजापत्यो यज्ञः
3.7.1.m: Satisfied by desire, desires follow after him; / he becomes endowed with fiery energy, endowed with heroic power. / Truly, this is the continuity of the sacrifice: / that he, having added the firewoods to the fires, enters upon the vow. / If it goes out, / that is indeed an interruption of it. / Having taken it up facing east, / he should attend upon it with the mind. / Mind indeed is Prajāpati; / the sacrifice belongs to Prajāpati.

3.7.1.s: manasaiva yajñaṃ saṃtanoti | bhūrityāha | bhūto vai prajāpatiḥ | bhūtimevopaiti | vi vā eṣa indriyeṇa vīryeṇarddhyate | yasyāhitāgneragnirapakṣāyati | yāvacchamyayā pravidhyet | yadi tāvadapakṣāyet | taṃ saṃbharet | idaṃ ta ekaṃ para uta ekam
3.7.1.d: मनसैव यज्ञं संतनोति । भूरित्याह । भूतो वै प्रजापतिः । भूतिमेवोपैति । वि वा एष इन्द्रियेण वीर्येणर्द्ध्यते । यस्याहिताग्नेरग्निरपक्षायति । यावच्छम्यया प्रविध्येत् । यदि तावदपक्षायेत् । तं संभरेत् । इदं त एकं पर उत एकम्
3.7.1.m: With the mind indeed he extends the sacrifice. / He says, 'Bhūḥ.' / Prajāpati is indeed the existent; / he approaches prosperity itself. / He is deprived of virile strength and heroic power / whose fire burns away, when he has set up his fires. / If it should burn away as far as / one could cast with a yoke-pin, / he should collect it together: / 'This one [form] of yours is here, and one is beyond;

3.7.1.s: tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃviśasva | saṃveśanastanuvai cāruredhi | priye devānāṃ parame janitra iti | brahmaṇaivainaṃ saṃbharati | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | yadi parastarāmapakṣāyet | anu prayāyāvasyet | so eva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | oṣadhīrvā etasya paśūnpayaḥ praviśati | yasya haviṣe vathsā apākṛtā dhayanti
3.7.1.d: तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा संविशस्व । संवेशनस्तनुवै चारुरेधि । प्रिये देवानां परमे जनित्र इति । ब्रह्मणैवैनं संभरति । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । यदि परस्तरामपक्षायेत् । अनु प्रयायावस्येत् । सो एव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । ओषधीर्वा एतस्य पशून्पयः प्रविशति । यस्य हविषे वथ्सा अपाकृता धयन्ति
3.7.1.m: enter together with the third light; / entering together, become fair to your body, / in the dear, highest birthplace of the gods'—so saying; / by means of the brahman indeed he gathers it. / That indeed is the expiation for it. / If it should burn away further beyond, / having pursued it, he should make camp. / That indeed is the expiation for it. / The milk of the domestic animals of that man truly enters the plants / whose calves, having been set apart for the offering, suckle.

3.7.1.s: tān yadduhyāt | yātayāmnā haviṣā yajeta | yanna duhyāt | yajñaparurantariyāt | vāyavyāṃ yavāgūṃ nirvapet | vāyurvai payasaḥ pradāpayitā | sa evāsmai payaḥ pradāpayati | payo vā oṣadhayaḥ | payaḥ payaḥ | payasaivāsmai payo'varundhe
3.7.1.d: तान् यद्दुह्यात् । यातयाम्ना हविषा यजेत । यन्न दुह्यात् । यज्ञपरुरन्तरियात् । वायव्यां यवागूं निर्वपेत् । वायुर्वै पयसः प्रदापयिता । स एवास्मै पयः प्रदापयति । पयो वा ओषधयः । पयः पयः । पयसैवास्मै पयोऽवरुन्धे
3.7.1.m:
If he were to milk them,
he would sacrifice with an oblation whose strength is spent.
If he were not to milk them,
he would leave out a joint of the sacrifice.
He should apportion barley gruel for Vāyu.
Vāyu indeed is the impeller of milk.
He makes milk be given to him.
Plants are milk.
Milk is milk.
By means of milk, he secures milk for him.

3.7.1.s: athottarasmai haviṣe vathsānapākuryāt | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | anyatarān vā eṣa devānbhāgadheyena vyardhayati | ye yajamānasya sāyaṃ gṛhamāgacchanti | yasya sāyaṃ dugdhaṃ havirārtimārchati | indrāya vrīhīnnirupyopavaset | payo vā oṣadhayaḥ | paya evārabhya gṛhītvopavasati | yatprātaḥ syāt | tacchṛtaṃ kuryāt
3.7.1.d: अथोत्तरस्मै हविषे वथ्सानपाकुर्यात् । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । अन्यतरान् वा एष देवान्भागधेयेन व्यर्धयति । ये यजमानस्य सायं गृहमागच्छन्ति । यस्य सायं दुग्धं हविरार्तिमार्छति । इन्द्राय व्रीहीन्निरुप्योपवसेत् । पयो वा ओषधयः । पय एवारभ्य गृहीत्वोपवसति । यत्प्रातः स्यात् । तच्छृतं कुर्यात्
3.7.1.m:
Then for the subsequent oblation he should separate the calves.
That is the expiation for it.
He deprives one or the other gods of their share,
who come to the sacrificer's house in the evening,
if his evening-milked oblation meets with mishap.
Having apportioned rice grains for Indra, he should fast.
Plants are milk.
Having grasped and taken hold of milk, he fasts.
What should be [milked] in the morning,
that he should boil.

3.7.1.s: athetara aindraḥ puroḍāśaḥ syāt | indriye evāsmai samīcī dadhāti | payo vā oṣadhayaḥ | payaḥ payaḥ | payasaivāsmai payo'varundhe | athottarasmai haviṣe vathsānapākuryāt | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | ubhayān vā eṣa devānbhāgadheyena vyardhayati | ye yajamānasya sāyaṃ ca prātaśca gṛhamāgacchanti | yasyobhayaṃ havirārtimārchati
3.7.1.d: अथेतर ऐन्द्रः पुरोडाशः स्यात् । इन्द्रिये एवास्मै समीची दधाति । पयो वा ओषधयः । पयः पयः । पयसैवास्मै पयोऽवरुन्धे । अथोत्तरस्मै हविषे वथ्सानपाकुर्यात् । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । उभयान् वा एष देवान्भागधेयेन व्यर्धयति । ये यजमानस्य सायं च प्रातश्च गृहमागच्छन्ति । यस्योभयं हविरार्तिमार्छति
3.7.1.m:
Then the other should be a cake for Indra.
He places harmonious faculties in him.
Plants are milk.
Milk is milk.
By means of milk, he secures milk for him.
Then for the subsequent oblation he should separate the calves.
That is the expiation for it.
He deprives both [classes of] gods of their share,
who come to the sacrificer's house both in the evening and in the morning,
if both his oblations meet with mishap.

3.7.1.s: aindraṃ pañcaśarāvamodanaṃ nirvapet | agniṃ devatānāṃ prathamaṃ yajet | agnimukhā eva devatāḥ prīṇāti | agniṃ vā anvanyā devatāḥ | indramanvanyāḥ | tā evobhayīḥ prīṇāti | payo vā oṣadhayaḥ | payaḥ payaḥ | payasaivāsmai payo'varundhe | athottarasmai haviṣe vathsānapākuryāt
3.7.1.d: ऐन्द्रं पञ्चशरावमोदनं निर्वपेत् । अग्निं देवतानां प्रथमं यजेत् । अग्निमुखा एव देवताः प्रीणाति । अग्निं वा अन्वन्या देवताः । इन्द्रमन्वन्याः । ता एवोभयीः प्रीणाति । पयो वा ओषधयः । पयः पयः । पयसैवास्मै पयोऽवरुन्धे । अथोत्तरस्मै हविषे वथ्सानपाकुर्यात्
3.7.1.m:
He should apportion a boiled rice mess in five bowls for Indra.
He should sacrifice to Agni first among the deities.
He gladdens the deities having Agni as their mouth.
Some deities follow Agni,
other deities follow Indra.
He gladdens both of them.
Plants are milk.
Milk is milk.
By means of milk, he secures milk for him.
Then for the subsequent oblation he should separate the calves.

3.7.1.s: saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | ardho vā etasya yajñasya mīyate | yasya vratye'hanpatnyanālambhukā bhavati | tāmaparudhya yajeta | sarveṇaiva yajñena yajate | tāmiṣṭvopahvayeta | amūhamasmi | sā tvam | dyauraham | pṛthivī tvam | sāmāham | ṛktvam | tāvehi saṃbhavāva | saha reto dadhāvahai | puṃse putrāya vettavai | rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāyeti | ardha evaināmupahvayate | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ
3.7.1.d: सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । अर्धो वा एतस्य यज्ञस्य मीयते । यस्य व्रत्येऽहन्पत्न्यनालम्भुका भवति । तामपरुध्य यजेत । सर्वेणैव यज्ञेन यजते । तामिष्ट्वोपह्वयेत । अमूहमस्मि । सा त्वम् । द्यौरहम् । पृथिवी त्वम् । सामाहम् । ऋक्त्वम् । तावेहि संभवाव । सह रेतो दधावहै । पुंसे पुत्राय वेत्तवै । रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्यायेति । अर्ध एवैनामुपह्वयते । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः
3.7.1.m:
That is the expiation for it.
Half of his sacrifice is destroyed,
whose wife becomes untouchable on the day of observance.
Having set her aside, he should sacrifice.
He sacrifices with the entire sacrifice.
Having sacrificed, he should summon her:
'I am he,
you are she;
I am heaven,
you are earth;
I am the Sāman,
you are the Ṛk.
Come, let the two of us unite,
let us deposit seed together,
to obtain a male son,
for the increase of wealth, for good offspring, for good heroic power.'
He summons her into the half [of the rite].
That is the expiation for it.

3.7.2.s: yadviṣṣaṇṇena juhuyāt | aprajā apaśuryajamānaḥ syāt | yadanāyatane ninayet | anāyatanaḥ syāt | prājāpatyayarcā valmīkavapāyāmavanayet | prājāpatyo vai valmīkaḥ | yajñaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpatāveva yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | bhūrityāha | bhūto vai prajāpatiḥ
3.7.2.d: यद्विष्षण्णेन जुहुयात् । अप्रजा अपशुर्यजमानः स्यात् । यदनायतने निनयेत् । अनायतनः स्यात् । प्राजापत्ययर्चा वल्मीकवपायामवनयेत् । प्राजापत्यो वै वल्मीकः । यज्ञः प्रजापतिः । प्रजापतावेव यज्ञं प्रतिष्ठापयति । भूरित्याह । भूतो वै प्रजापतिः
3.7.2.m:
If he were to offer what has run out,
the sacrificer would be without offspring, without domestic animals.
If he were to pour it out on an improper place,
he would be without a proper place.
With a verse to Prajāpati, he should pour it out into the mound of an anthill.
The anthill belongs to Prajāpati.
The sacrifice is Prajāpati.
He establishes the sacrifice in Prajāpati.
He says: 'Bhūḥ.'
Prajāpati is being.

3.7.2.s: bhūtimevopaiti | tatkṛtvā | anyāṃ dugdhvā punarhotavyam | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | yatkīṭāvapannena juhuyāt | aprajā apaśuryajamānaḥ syāt | yadanāyatane ninayet | anāyatanaḥ syāt | madhyamena parṇena dyāvāpṛthivyayarcā'ntaḥparidhi ninayet | dyāvāpṛthivyorevainatpratiṣṭhāpayati
3.7.2.d: भूतिमेवोपैति । तत्कृत्वा । अन्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर्होतव्यम् । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । यत्कीटावपन्नेन जुहुयात् । अप्रजा अपशुर्यजमानः स्यात् । यदनायतने निनयेत् । अनायतनः स्यात् । मध्यमेन पर्णेन द्यावापृथिव्ययर्चाऽन्तःपरिधि निनयेत् । द्यावापृथिव्योरेवैनत्प्रतिष्ठापयति
3.7.2.m:
He attains prosperity.
Having done that,
and having milked another [cow], an offering should be made again.
That is the expiation for it.
If he were to offer what an insect has fallen into,
the sacrificer would be without offspring, without domestic animals.
If he were to pour it out on an improper place,
he would be without a proper place.
With the middle [leaf] of the Palāśa tree, with a verse to heaven and earth, he should pour it out inside the enclosing sticks.
He establishes it in heaven and earth.

3.7.2.s: tatkṛtvā | anyāṃ dugdhvā punarhotavyam | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | yadava vṛṣṭena juhuyāt | aparūpamasyātmañjāyeta | kilāso vā syādarśaso vā | yatpratyeyāt | yajñaṃ vicchindyāt | sa juhuyāt | mitro janānkalpayati prajānan
3.7.2.d: तत्कृत्वा । अन्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर्होतव्यम् । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । यदव वृष्टेन जुहुयात् । अपरूपमस्यात्मञ्जायेत । किलासो वा स्यादर्शसो वा । यत्प्रत्येयात् । यज्ञं विच्छिन्द्यात् । स जुहुयात् । मित्रो जनान्कल्पयति प्रजानन्
3.7.2.m:
Having done that,
and having milked another [cow], an offering should be made again.
That is the expiation for it.
If he were to offer what has been rained upon,
a disfigurement would arise on his body:
either white leprosy or piles.
If he were to turn back,
he would interrupt the sacrifice.
He should offer [saying]:
'Mitra arranges the peoples, knowing well;

3.7.2.s: mitro dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyām | mitraḥ kṛṣṭīranimiṣā'bhicaṣṭe | satyāya havyaṃ ghṛtavajjuhoteti | mitreṇaivainatkalpayati | tatkṛtvā | anyāṃ dugdhvā punarhotavyam | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | yatpūrvasyāmāhutyāṃ hutāyāmuttarā''hutiḥ skandet | dvipādbhiḥ paśubhiryajamāno vyṛddhyeta | yaduttarayā'bhijuhuyāt
3.7.2.d: मित्रो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्याम् । मित्रः कृष्टीरनिमिषाऽभिचष्टे । सत्याय हव्यं घृतवज्जुहोतेति । मित्रेणैवैनत्कल्पयति । तत्कृत्वा । अन्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर्होतव्यम् । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । यत्पूर्वस्यामाहुत्यां हुतायामुत्तरा'ऽहुतिः स्कन्देत् । द्विपाद्भिः पशुभिर्यजमानो व्यृद्ध्येत । यदुत्तरयाऽभिजुहुयात्
3.7.2.m:
Mitra has supported earth and heaven;
Mitra gazes upon the settlements unblinking;
to truth offer the ghee-rich oblation.'
Through Mitra he arranges it.
Having done that,
and having milked another [cow], an offering should be made again.
That is the expiation for it.
If, when the first offering has been offered, the subsequent offering spills,
the sacrificer would be deprived of two-footed domestic animals.
If he should pour [an offering] over it with the subsequent [mantra],

3.7.2.s: catuṣpādbhiḥ paśubhiryajamāno vyṛddhyeta | yatra vettha vanaspate devānāṃ guhyā nāmāni | tatra havyāni gāmayeti vānaspatyayarcā samidhamādhāya | tūṣṇīmeva punarjuhuyāt | vanaspatinaiva yajñasyārtāṃ cānārtāṃ cāhutī vidādhāra | tatkṛtvā | anyāṃ dugdhvā punarhotavyam | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | yatpurā prayājebhyaḥ prāṅaṅgāraḥ skandet | adhvaryave ca yajamānāya cākaṃ syāt
3.7.2.d: चतुष्पाद्भिः पशुभिर्यजमानो व्यृद्ध्येत । यत्र वेत्थ वनस्पते देवानां गुह्या नामानि । तत्र हव्यानि गामयेति वानस्पत्ययर्चा समिधमाधाय । तूष्णीमेव पुनर्जुहुयात् । वनस्पतिनैव यज्ञस्यार्तां चानार्तां चाहुती विदाधार । तत्कृत्वा । अन्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर्होतव्यम् । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः । यत्पुरा प्रयाजेभ्यः प्राङङ्गारः स्कन्देत् । अध्वर्यवे च यजमानाय चाकं स्यात्
3.7.2.m:
the sacrificer would be deprived of four-footed domestic animals.
Having laid on a kindling-stick with a verse addressed to the forest lord: 'Where, O forest lord, you know the secret names of the gods, / there convey the oblations,'
he should offer again silently.
Through the forest lord he supports the injured and the uninjured offerings of the sacrifice.
Having done that,
and having milked another [cow], an offering should be made again.
That is the expiation for it.
If, before the fore-sacrifices, an ember should jump eastward,
there would be misfortune for the Adhvaryu and for the sacrificer.

3.7.2.s: yaddakṣiṇā | brahmaṇe ca yajamānāya cākaṃ syāt | yatpratyak | hotre ca patniyai ca yajamānāya cākaṃ syāt | yadudaṅṅ | agnīdhe ca paśubhyaśca yajamānāya cākaṃ syāt | yadabhijuhuyāt | rudro'sya paśūn ghātukaḥ syāt | yannābhijuhuyāt | aśāntaḥ prahriyeta
3.7.2.d: यद्दक्षिणा । ब्रह्मणे च यजमानाय चाकं स्यात् । यत्प्रत्यक् । होत्रे च पत्नियै च यजमानाय चाकं स्यात् । यदुदङ्ङ् । अग्नीधे च पशुभ्यश्च यजमानाय चाकं स्यात् । यदभिजुहुयात् । रुद्रोऽस्य पशून् घातुकः स्यात् । यन्नाभिजुहुयात् । अशान्तः प्रह्रियेत
3.7.2.m:
If southward,
there would be misfortune for the Brahman and for the sacrificer.
If westward,
there would be misfortune for the Hotṛ, the wife, and the sacrificer.
If northward,
there would be misfortune for the Agnīdh, the domestic animals, and the sacrificer.
If he were to pour an offering over it,
Rudra would be a slayer of his domestic animals.
If he were not to pour an offering over it,
it would be cast into [the fire] unappeased.

3.7.2.s: sruvasya budhnenābhinidadhyāt | mā tamo mā yajñastamanmā yajamānastamat | namaste astvāyate | namo rudra parāyate | namo yatra niṣīdasi | amuṃ mā hiṃsīramuṃ mā hiṃsīriti yena skandet | taṃ praharet | sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedāḥ | stomapṛṣṭho ghṛtavānthsupratīkaḥ | mā no hāsīnmetthito nettvā jahāma | gopoṣaṃ no vīrapoṣaṃ ca yaccheti | brahmaṇaivainaṃ praharati | saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ
3.7.2.d: स्रुवस्य बुध्नेनाभिनिदध्यात् । मा तमो मा यज्ञस्तमन्मा यजमानस्तमत् । नमस्ते अस्त्वायते । नमो रुद्र परायते । नमो यत्र निषीदसि । अमुं मा हिंसीरमुं मा हिंसीरिति येन स्कन्देत् । तं प्रहरेत् । सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो जातवेदाः । स्तोमपृष्ठो घृतवान्थ्सुप्रतीकः । मा नो हासीन्मेत्थितो नेत्त्वा जहाम । गोपोषं नो वीरपोषं च यच्छेति । ब्रह्मणैवैनं प्रहरति । सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः

3.7.3.s: vi vā eṣa indriyeṇa vīryeṇarddhyate | yasyāhitāgneragnirmathyamāno na jāyate | yatrānyaṃ paśyet | tata āhṛtya hotavyam | agnāvevāsyāgni hotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | yadyanyaṃ na vindet | ajāyāṃ hotavyam | āgneyī vā eṣā | yadajā | agnāvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati
3.7.3.d: वि वा एष इन्द्रियेण वीर्येणर्द्ध्यते । यस्याहिताग्नेरग्निर्मथ्यमानो न जायते । यत्रान्यं पश्येत् । तत आहृत्य होतव्यम् । अग्नावेवास्याग्नि होत्रं हुतं भवति । यद्यन्यं न विन्देत् । अजायां होतव्यम् । आग्नेयी वा एषा । यदजा । अग्नावेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति
3.7.3.m:
He is deprived of faculty and heroic power,
whose fire, being churned, is not produced when his fires are established.
Where he sees another [fire],
bringing it from there, the offering should be made.
His agnihotra is offered in fire indeed.
If he should not find another,
the offering should be made in a female goat.
She is related to Agni,
namely the goat.
His agnihotra is offered in fire indeed.

3.7.3.s: ajasya tu nāśnīyāt | yadajasyāśnīyāt | yāmevāgnāvāhutiṃ juhuyāt | tāmadyāt | tasmādajasya nāśyam | yadyajāṃ na vindet | brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇe haste hotavyam | eṣa vā agnirvaiśvānaraḥ | yadbrāhmaṇaḥ | agnāvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati
3.7.3.d: अजस्य तु नाश्नीयात् । यदजस्याश्नीयात् । यामेवाग्नावाहुतिं जुहुयात् । तामद्यात् । तस्मादजस्य नाश्यम् । यद्यजां न विन्देत् । ब्राह्मणस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते होतव्यम् । एष वा अग्निर्वैश्वानरः । यद्ब्राह्मणः । अग्नावेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति
3.7.3.m:
However, he should not eat of a goat.
If he were to eat of a goat,
whatever oblation he would offer into the fire,
that he would eat.
Therefore, [meat] of a goat is not to be eaten.
If he should not find a female goat,
the offering should be made in the right hand of a Brahmin.
He is Agni Vaiśvānara,
namely the Brahmin.
His agnihotra is offered in fire indeed.

3.7.3.s: brāhmaṇaṃ tu vasatyai nāparundhyāt | yadbrāhmaṇaṃ vasatyā aparundhyāt | yasminnevāgnāvāhutiṃ juhuyāt | taṃ bhāgadheyena vyardhayet | tasmādbrāhmaṇo vasatyai nāparudhyaḥ | yadi brāhmaṇaṃ na vindet | darbhastambe hotavyam | agnivān vai darbhastambaḥ | agnāvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | darbhāṃstu nādhyāsīta ||
3.7.3.d: ब्राह्मणं तु वसत्यै नापरुन्ध्यात् । यद्ब्राह्मणं वसत्या अपरुन्ध्यात् । यस्मिन्नेवाग्नावाहुतिं जुहुयात् । तं भागधेयेन व्यर्धयेत् । तस्माद्ब्राह्मणो वसत्यै नापरुध्यः । यदि ब्राह्मणं न विन्देत् । दर्भस्तम्बे होतव्यम् । अग्निवान् वै दर्भस्तम्बः । अग्नावेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । दर्भांस्तु नाध्यासीत ॥
3.7.3.m:
One should not, however, turn away a Brahmin from dwelling [with him].
If one turns away a Brahmin from dwelling,
one deprives of his share that very fire in which he would offer.
Therefore, a Brahmin must not be turned away from dwelling.
If he does not find a Brahmin,
he should offer upon a clump of darbha grass.
A clump of darbha grass, indeed, contains fire.
His agnihotra becomes offered in fire itself.
One should not, however, sit upon the darbha grass.

3.7.3.s: yaddarbhānadhyāsīta | yāmevāgnāvāhutiṃ juhuyāt | tāmadhyāsīta | tasmāddarbhā nādhyāsitavyāḥ | yadi darbhānna vindet | apsu hotavyam | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ | devatāsvevāsyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati | āpastu na paricakṣīta | yadāpaḥ paricakṣīta
3.7.3.d: यद्दर्भानध्यासीत । यामेवाग्नावाहुतिं जुहुयात् । तामध्यासीत । तस्माद्दर्भा नाध्यासितव्याः । यदि दर्भान्न विन्देत् । अप्सु होतव्यम् । आपो वै सर्वा देवताः । देवतास्वेवास्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति । आपस्तु न परिचक्षीत । यदापः परिचक्षीत
3.7.3.m:
If he were to sit upon the darbha grass,
he would sit upon that very oblation which he would offer in the fire.
Therefore, darbha grass must not be sat upon.
If he does not find darbha grass,
he should offer into water.
All deities, indeed, are water.
His agnihotra becomes offered in the deities themselves.
One should not, however, despise water.
If he were to despise water,

3.7.3.s: yāmevāpsvāhutiṃ juhuyāt | tāṃ paricakṣīta | tasmādāpo na paricakṣyāḥ | medhyā ca vā etasyāmedhyā ca tanuvau saṃsṛjyete | yasyāhitāgneranyairagnibhiragnayaḥ saṃsṛjyante | agnaye vivicaye puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | medhyāṃ caivāsyāmedhyāṃ ca tanuvau vyāvartayati | agnaye vratapataye puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | agnimeva vratapatiṃ svena bhāgadheyenopadhāvati | sa evainaṃ vratamālambhayati
3.7.3.d: यामेवाप्स्वाहुतिं जुहुयात् । तां परिचक्षीत । तस्मादापो न परिचक्ष्याः । मेध्या च वा एतस्यामेध्या च तनुवौ संसृज्येते । यस्याहिताग्नेरन्यैरग्निभिरग्नयः संसृज्यन्ते । अग्नये विविचये पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् । मेध्यां चैवास्यामेध्यां च तनुवौ व्यावर्तयति । अग्नये व्रतपतये पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् । अग्निमेव व्रतपतिं स्वेन भागधेयेनोपधावति । स एवैनं व्रतमालम्भयति
3.7.3.m:
he would despise that very oblation which he would offer in the water.
Therefore, water must not be despised.
Both pure and impure bodies, indeed, mingle for him
whose fires, as an establisher of fires, mingle with other fires.
He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Vivici.
He separates his pure and impure bodies.
He should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Vratapati.
He runs toward Agni Vratapati with his own share;
he makes him undertake the vow.

3.7.3.s: garbhaṃ sravantamagadamakaḥ | agnirindrastvaṣṭā bṛhaspatiḥ | pṛthivyāmavacuścotaitat | nābhiprāpnoti nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ | reto vā etadvājinamāhitāgneḥ | yadagnihotram | tadyathsravet | reto'sya vājinaṃ sravet | garbhaṃ sravantamagadamakarityāha | reta evāsminvājinaṃ dadhāti
3.7.3.d: गर्भं स्रवन्तमगदमकः । अग्निरिन्द्रस्त्वष्टा बृहस्पतिः । पृथिव्यामवचुश्चोतैतत् । नाभिप्राप्नोति निरृतिं पराचैः । रेतो वा एतद्वाजिनमाहिताग्नेः । यदग्निहोत्रम् । तद्यथ्स्रवेत् । रेतोऽस्य वाजिनं स्रवेत् । गर्भं स्रवन्तमगदमकरित्याह । रेत एवास्मिन्वाजिनं दधाति
3.7.3.m:
"He made healthy the flowing embryo,
Agni, Indra, Tvaṣṭṛ, Bṛhaspati.
It has dripped down onto the earth;
it does not reach Nirṛti turning away."
Vigorous seed, indeed, of the establisher of fires is this,
namely, the agnihotra.
If that should flow,
his vigorous seed would flow.
He says: "He made healthy the flowing embryo";
he places vigorous seed into him.

3.7.3.s: agnirityāha | agnirvai retodhāḥ | reta eva taddadhāti | indra ityāha | indriyamevāsmindadhāti | tvaṣṭetyāha | tvaṣṭā vai paśūnāṃ mithunānāṃ rūpakṛt | rūpameva paśuṣu dadhāti | bṛhaspatirityāha | brahma vai devānāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | brahmaṇaivāsmai prajāḥ prajanayati | pṛthivyāmavacuścotaitadityāha | asyāmevainatpratiṣṭhāpayati | nābhi prāpnoti nirṛtiṃ parācairityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai
3.7.3.d: अग्निरित्याह । अग्निर्वै रेतोधाः । रेत एव तद्दधाति । इन्द्र इत्याह । इन्द्रियमेवास्मिन्दधाति । त्वष्टेत्याह । त्वष्टा वै पशूनां मिथुनानां रूपकृत् । रूपमेव पशुषु दधाति । बृहस्पतिरित्याह । ब्रह्म वै देवानां बृहस्पतिः । ब्रह्मणैवास्मै प्रजाः प्रजनयति । पृथिव्यामवचुश्चोतैतदित्याह । अस्यामेवैनत्प्रतिष्ठापयति । नाभि प्राप्नोति निरृतिं पराचैरित्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै

3.7.4.s: yāḥ purastātprasravanti | upariṣṭāthsarvataśca yāḥ | tābhī raśmi pavitrābhiḥ | śraddhāṃ yajñamārabhe | devā gātuvidaḥ | gātuṃ yajñāya vindata | manasaspatinā devena | vātādyajñaḥ prayujyatām | tṛtīyasyai divaḥ | gāyatriyā soma ābhṛtaḥ ||
3.7.4.d: याः पुरस्तात्प्रस्रवन्ति । उपरिष्टाथ्सर्वतश्च याः । ताभी रश्मि पवित्राभिः । श्रद्धां यज्ञमारभे । देवा गातुविदः । गातुं यज्ञाय विन्दत । मनसस्पतिना देवेन । वाताद्यज्ञः प्रयुज्यताम् । तृतीयस्यै दिवः । गायत्रिया सोम आभृतः ॥
3.7.4.m:
Those that flow from the front,
from above, and from every side,
with them, purified by rays,
I begin faith, the sacrifice.
O gods, finders of the path,
find the path for the sacrifice.
With the divine Lord of the Mind,
may the sacrifice be joined from the wind.
From the third heaven
Soma was brought by the Gāyatrī.

3.7.4.s: somapīthāya saṃnayitum | vakalamantaramādade | āpo devīḥ śuddhāḥ stha | imā pātrāṇi śundhata | upātaṅkyāya devānām | parṇavalkamuta śundhata | payo gṛheṣu payo aghniyāsu | payo vathseṣu paya indrāya haviṣe dhriyasva | gāyatrī parṇavalkena | payaḥ somaṃ karotvimam
3.7.4.d: सोमपीथाय संनयितुम् । वकलमन्तरमाददे । आपो देवीः शुद्धाः स्थ । इमा पात्राणि शुन्धत । उपातङ्क्याय देवानाम् । पर्णवल्कमुत शुन्धत । पयो गृहेषु पयो अघ्नियासु । पयो वथ्सेषु पय इन्द्राय हविषे ध्रियस्व । गायत्री पर्णवल्केन । पयः सोमं करोत्विमम्
3.7.4.m:
To curdle for the soma-draught,
I take the inner bark.
O divine Waters, you are pure;
cleanse these vessels.
For the curdling agent of the gods,
cleanse also the parṇa-bark.
Milk in the houses, milk in the inviolable cows,
milk in the calves; be held as milk, as oblation for Indra.
May the Gāyatrī, with the parṇa-bark,
make this milk into Soma.

3.7.4.s: agniṃ gṛhṇāmi surathaṃ yo mayobhūḥ | ya udyantamārohati sūryamahne | ādityaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamam | śvo yajñāya ramatāṃ devatābhyaḥ | vasūnrudrānādityān | indreṇa saha devatāḥ | tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi | sva āyatane manīṣayā | imāmūrjaṃ pañcadaśīṃ ye praviṣṭāḥ | tāndevānparigṛhṇāmi pūrvaḥ
3.7.4.d: अग्निं गृह्णामि सुरथं यो मयोभूः । य उद्यन्तमारोहति सूर्यमह्ने । आदित्यं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमम् । श्वो यज्ञाय रमतां देवताभ्यः । वसून्रुद्रानादित्यान् । इन्द्रेण सह देवताः । ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि । स्व आयतने मनीषया । इमामूर्जं पञ्चदशीं ये प्रविष्टाः । तान्देवान्परिगृह्णामि पूर्वः
3.7.4.m:
I grasp Agni of good chariot, who is causing joy,
who ascends to the rising sun for the day,
the Āditya, highest light of lights;
let him rest for tomorrow's sacrifice for the deities.
The Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas,
the deities together with Indra—
those I grasp first
in [their] own abode with thought.
Those who have entered this fifteenth vigor—
those deities I grasp first.

3.7.4.s: agnirhavyavāḍiha tānāvahatu | paurṇamāsaṃ haviridameṣāṃ mayi | āmāvāsyaṃ haviridameṣāṃ mayi | antarā'gnī paśavaḥ | devasaṃsadamāgaman | tānpūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi | sva āyatane manīṣayā | iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām | agniṃ gṛhapatimabhisaṃvasānāḥ | tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi
3.7.4.d: अग्निर्हव्यवाडिह तानावहतु । पौर्णमासं हविरिदमेषां मयि । आमावास्यं हविरिदमेषां मयि । अन्तराऽग्नी पशवः । देवसंसदमागमन् । तान्पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि । स्व आयतने मनीषया । इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् । अग्निं गृहपतिमभिसंवसानाः । ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि

3.7.4.s: sva āyatane manīṣayā | iha paśavo viśvarūpā ramantām | agniṃ gṛhapatimabhi saṃvasānāḥ | tānpūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi | sva āyatane manīṣayā | ayaṃ pitṛṇāmagniḥ | avāḍḍhavyā pitṛbhya ā | taṃ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi | aviṣaṃ naḥ pituṃ karat | ajasraṃ tvāṃ sabhāpālāḥ
3.7.4.d: स्व आयतने मनीषया । इह पशवो विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् । अग्निं गृहपतिमभि संवसानाः । तान्पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि । स्व आयतने मनीषया । अयं पितृणामग्निः । अवाड्ढव्या पितृभ्य आ । तं पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि । अविषं नः पितुं करत् । अजस्रं त्वां सभापालाः

3.7.4.s: vijayabhāgaṃ samindhatām | agne dīdāya me sabhya | vijityai śaradaḥ śatam | annamāvasathīyam | abhiharāṇi śaradaḥ śatam | āvasathe śriyaṃ mantram | ahirbudhniyo niyacchatu | idamahamagni jyeṣṭhebhyaḥ | vasubhyo yajñaṃ prabravīmi | idamahamindrajyeṣṭhebhyaḥ
3.7.4.d: विजयभागं समिन्धताम् । अग्ने दीदाय मे सभ्य । विजित्यै शरदः शतम् । अन्नमावसथीयम् । अभिहराणि शरदः शतम् । आवसथे श्रियं मन्त्रम् । अहिर्बुध्नियो नियच्छतु । इदमहमग्नि ज्येष्ठेभ्यः । वसुभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रवीमि । इदमहमिन्द्रज्येष्ठेभ्यः
3.7.4.m:
kindle you, who have the share of victory.
O Sabhya Agni, shine for me,
for victory, for a hundred autumns.
May I bring near the food of the hall,
for a hundred autumns.
In the hall, may Ahi Budhnya
bestow prosperity and sacred utterance.
Here I announce the sacrifice to the Vasus,
who have Agni as their chief.
Here I announce the sacrifice to the Rudras,

3.7.4.s: rudrebhyo yajñaṃ prabravīmi | idamahaṃ varuṇajyeṣṭhebhyaḥ | ādityebhyo yajñaṃ prabravīmi | payasvatīroṣadhayaḥ | payasvadvīrudhāṃ payaḥ | apāṃ payaso yatpayaḥ | tena māmindra saṃsṛja | agne vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmi | tacchakeyaṃ tanme rādhyatām | vāyo vratapata āditya vratapate
3.7.4.d: रुद्रेभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रवीमि । इदमहं वरुणज्येष्ठेभ्यः । आदित्येभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रवीमि । पयस्वतीरोषधयः । पयस्वद्वीरुधां पयः । अपां पयसो यत्पयः । तेन मामिन्द्र संसृज । अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतं चरिष्यामि । तच्छकेयं तन्मे राध्यताम् । वायो व्रतपत आदित्य व्रतपते

3.7.4.s: vratānāṃ vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmi | tacchakeyaṃ tanme rādhyatām | imāṃ prācīmudīcīm | iṣamūrjamabhi saṃskṛtām | bahuparṇāmaśuṣkāgrām | harāmi paśupāmaham | yatkṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | prāviśastvaṃ vanaspatīn | tatastvāmekaviṃśatidhā | saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā
3.7.4.d: व्रतानां व्रतपते व्रतं चरिष्यामि । तच्छकेयं तन्मे राध्यताम् । इमां प्राचीमुदीचीम् । इषमूर्जमभि संस्कृताम् । बहुपर्णामशुष्काग्राम् । हरामि पशुपामहम् । यत्कृष्णो रूपं कृत्वा । प्राविशस्त्वं वनस्पतीन् । ततस्त्वामेकविंशतिधा । संभरामि सुसंभृता
3.7.4.m:
O lord of vows of vows, I will perform the vow;
may I be able to do that; may that succeed for me.
Facing east, facing north,
prepared for refreshment and vigor,
having many leaves, its tip not dried,
I bring the guardian of domestic animals.
Since, having assumed a black form,
you entered the trees,
therefore, being well gathered, I gather you
in twenty-one pieces.

3.7.4.s: trīnparidhīṃstisraḥ samidhaḥ | yajñāyuranusaṃcarān | upaveṣaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ dhṛṣṭim | saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā | yā jātā oṣadhayaḥ | devebhyastriyugaṃ purā | tāsāṃ parva rādhyāsam | paristaramāharan | apāṃ medhyaṃ yajñiyam | sadevaṃ śivamastu me
3.7.4.d: त्रीन्परिधींस्तिस्रः समिधः । यज्ञायुरनुसंचरान् । उपवेषं मेक्षणं धृष्टिम् । संभरामि सुसंभृता । या जाता ओषधयः । देवेभ्यस्त्रियुगं पुरा । तासां पर्व राध्यासम् । परिस्तरमाहरन् । अपां मेध्यं यज्ञियम् । सदेवं शिवमस्तु मे
3.7.4.m:
Three enclosing-sticks, three kindling-sticks,
traversing according to the lifespan of the sacrifice,
the fire-shovel, the stirring-stick, the fire-poker—
well gathered, I gather.
The plants that were born
for the gods three ages ago,
may I succeed in their joint
as I bring the strew.
Pure for water, worthy of sacrifice,
accompanied by the gods, may it be auspicious to me.

3.7.4.s: ācchettā vo mā riṣam | jīvāni śaradaḥ śatam | aparimitānāṃ parimitāḥ | saṃnahye sukṛtāya kam | eno mā nigāṃ katamaccanāham | punarutthāya bahulā bhavantu | sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhirūrṇāmṛdu | syonaṃ pitṛbhyastvā bharāmyaham | asminthsīdantu me pitaraḥ somyāḥ | pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāścānugaiḥ saha
3.7.4.d: आच्छेत्ता वो मा रिषम् । जीवानि शरदः शतम् । अपरिमितानां परिमिताः । संनह्ये सुकृताय कम् । एनो मा निगां कतमच्चनाहम् । पुनरुत्थाय बहुला भवन्तु । सकृदाच्छिन्नं बर्हिरूर्णामृदु । स्योनं पितृभ्यस्त्वा भराम्यहम् । अस्मिन्थ्सीदन्तु मे पितरः सोम्याः । पितामहाः प्रपितामहाश्चानुगैः सह
3.7.4.m: May I, the cutter, not harm you; / may I live a hundred autumns. / You are the measured ones of the unmeasured; / I tie [you] together for well-done ritual work. / May I fall into no sin whatsoever; / rising up again, may [the plants] become abundant. / Cut only once, the sacred grass is soft as wool; / comfortable for the fathers, I bring you. / Upon this let my soma-loving fathers sit, / grandfathers and great-grandfathers, together with their followers.

3.7.4.s: trivṛtpalāśe darbhaḥ | iyānprādeśasaṃmitaḥ | yajñe pavitraṃ potṛtamam | payo havyaṃ karotu me | imau prāṇāpānau | yajñasyāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ | āpyāyayantau saṃcaratām | pavitre havyaśodhane | pavitre stho vaiṣṇavī | vāyurvāṃ manasā punātu
3.7.4.d: त्रिवृत्पलाशे दर्भः । इयान्प्रादेशसंमितः । यज्ञे पवित्रं पोतृतमम् । पयो हव्यं करोतु मे । इमौ प्राणापानौ । यज्ञस्याङ्गानि सर्वशः । आप्याययन्तौ संचरताम् । पवित्रे हव्यशोधने । पवित्रे स्थो वैष्णवी । वायुर्वां मनसा पुनातु
3.7.4.m: Threefold darbha-grass in palāśa leaves, / of this size, measured as a span; / as the purifier in the sacrifice, most purifying, / let it prepare the milk as an offering for me. / Exhalation and inhalation, / swelling every limb of the sacrifice, / let the two purifiers move about, / cleansing the sacrificial substance. / You two are the purifiers sacred to Viṣṇu; / may Vāyu purify you with his mind.

3.7.4.s: ayaṃ prāṇaścāpānaśca | yajamānamapigacchatām | yajñe hyabhūtāṃ potārau | pavitre havyaśodhane | tvayā vediṃ vividuḥ pṛthivīm | tvayā yajño jāyate viśvadāniḥ | acchidraṃ yajñamanveṣi vidvān | tvayā hotā saṃtanotyardhamāsān | trayastriṃśo'si tantūnām | pavitreṇa sahāgahi
3.7.4.d: अयं प्राणश्चापानश्च । यजमानमपिगच्छताम् । यज्ञे ह्यभूतां पोतारौ । पवित्रे हव्यशोधने । त्वया वेदिं विविदुः पृथिवीम् । त्वया यज्ञो जायते विश्वदानिः । अच्छिद्रं यज्ञमन्वेषि विद्वान् । त्वया होता संतनोत्यर्धमासान् । त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽसि तन्तूनाम् । पवित्रेण सहागहि
3.7.4.m: Let this exhalation and inhalation / reach the sacrificer; / for they have become the two purifiers at the sacrifice, / the two strainers cleansing the sacrificial substance. / Through you they discovered the altar, the earth; / through you the sacrifice is born, granting all things. / Knowing, you follow the unblemished sacrifice; / through you the hotṛ extends the half-months. / You are the thirty-third of the threads; / come together with the purifier.

3.7.4.s: śiveyaṃ rajjurabhidhānī | aghniyāmupasevatām | aprasraṃsāya yajñasya | ukhe upadadhāmyaham | paśubhiḥ saṃnītaṃ bibhṛtām | indrāya śṛtaṃ dadhi | upaveṣo'si yajñāya | tvāṃ pariveṣamadhārayan | indrāya haviḥ kṛṇvantaḥ | śivaḥ śagmo bhavāsi naḥ
3.7.4.d: शिवेयं रज्जुरभिधानी । अघ्नियामुपसेवताम् । अप्रस्रंसाय यज्ञस्य । उखे उपदधाम्यहम् । पशुभिः संनीतं बिभृताम् । इन्द्राय शृतं दधि । उपवेषोऽसि यज्ञाय । त्वां परिवेषमधारयन् । इन्द्राय हविः कृण्वन्तः । शिवः शग्मो भवासि नः
3.7.4.m: Auspicious is this halter, the neck-rope; / let it serve the inviolable cow. / So that the sacrifice does not slip down, / I place the two cooking pots. / Let the two bear [the milk] gathered together by the cattle, / the cooked milk and curds for Indra. / You are the fire-stirrer for the sacrifice; / they maintained you for serving the meal. / Making the oblation for Indra, / be auspicious and helpful to us.

3.7.4.s: amṛnmayaṃ devapātram | yajñasyāyuṣi prayujyatām | tiraḥpavitramati nītāḥ | āpo dhāraya mā'tiguḥ | devena savitrotpūtāḥ | vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ | gāṃ doha pavitre rajjum | sarvā pātrāṇi śundhata | etā ācaranti madhumadduhānāḥ | prajāvatīryaśaso viśvarūpāḥ
3.7.4.d: अमृन्मयं देवपात्रम् । यज्ञस्यायुषि प्रयुज्यताम् । तिरःपवित्रमति नीताः । आपो धारय माऽतिगुः । देवेन सवित्रोत्पूताः । वसोः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः । गां दोह पवित्रे रज्जुम् । सर्वा पात्राणि शुन्धत । एता आचरन्ति मधुमद्दुहानाः । प्रजावतीर्यशसो विश्वरूपाः
3.7.4.m: Let the divine vessel, not made of clay, / be employed during the lifespan of the sacrifice. / Carried across the strainer, / hold the waters, let them not overflow. / Purified by god Savitṛ, / by the rays of the radiant sun, / cleanse the cow, the milking strainers, the rope, / and all the vessels. / These [cows] approach, yielding sweet [milk], / rich in offspring, glorious, of all colors.

3.7.4.s: bahvīrbhavantīrupajāyamānāḥ | iha va indro ramayatu gāvaḥ | pūṣā stha | ayakṣmā vaḥ prajayā saṃsṛjāmi | rāyaspoṣeṇa bahulā bhavantīḥ | ūrjaṃ payaḥ pinvamānā ghṛtaṃ ca | jīvo jīvantīrupa vaḥ sadeyam | dyauścemaṃ yajñaṃ pṛthivī ca saṃduhātām | dhātā somena saha vātena vāyuḥ | yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu
3.7.4.d: बह्वीर्भवन्तीरुपजायमानाः । इह व इन्द्रो रमयतु गावः । पूषा स्थ । अयक्ष्मा वः प्रजया संसृजामि । रायस्पोषेण बहुला भवन्तीः । ऊर्जं पयः पिन्वमाना घृतं च । जीवो जीवन्तीरुप वः सदेयम् । द्यौश्चेमं यज्ञं पृथिवी च संदुहाताम् । धाता सोमेन सह वातेन वायुः । यजमानाय द्रविणं दधातु
3.7.4.m: Becoming many, being born, / may Indra delight you cows here. / You are Pūṣan. / Free from disease, I unite you with your offspring; / becoming abundant through increase of wealth, / swelling with vigor, milk, and ghee, / may I, living, dwell beside you living ones. / Let heaven and earth milk this sacrifice together; / may the Creator, together with Soma, and Vāyu with the wind, / bestow wealth upon the sacrificer.

3.7.4.s: uthsaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilam | iḍāṃ devīṃ madhumatīṃ suvarvidam | tadindrāgnī jinvataṃ sūnṛtāvat | tadyajamānamamṛtatve dadhātu | kāmadhukṣaḥ pra ṇo brūhi | indrāya havirindriyam | amūṃ yasyāṃ devānām | manuṣyāṇāṃ payo hitam | bahu dugdhīndrāya devebhyaḥ | havyamāpyāyatāṃ punaḥ
3.7.4.d: उथ्सं दुहन्ति कलशं चतुर्बिलम् । इडां देवीं मधुमतीं सुवर्विदम् । तदिन्द्राग्नी जिन्वतं सूनृतावत् । तद्यजमानममृतत्वे दधातु । कामधुक्षः प्र णो ब्रूहि । इन्द्राय हविरिन्द्रियम् । अमूं यस्यां देवानाम् । मनुष्याणां पयो हितम् । बहु दुग्धीन्द्राय देवेभ्यः । हव्यमाप्यायतां पुनः
3.7.4.m: They milk the fountain, the four-spouted pitcher, / the divine Iḍā, full of sweetness, finding heaven. / Let Indrāgnī quicken that with truth; / let that place the sacrificer in immortality. / Which [cow] have you milked? Tell us forth, / the offering with Indra's power for Indra; / that one in which is placed the milk / of the gods and of humans. / Milk much for Indra, for the gods; / let the offering swell again.

3.7.4.s: vathsebhyo manuṣyebhyaḥ | punardohāya kalpatām | yajñasya saṃtatirasi | yajñasya tvā saṃtatimanu saṃtanomi | adastamasi viṣṇave tvā | yajñāyāpi dadhāmyaham | adbhirariktena pātreṇa | yāḥ pūtāḥ pariśerate | ayaṃ payaḥ somaṃ kṛtvā | svāṃ yonimapigacchatu
3.7.4.d: वथ्सेभ्यो मनुष्येभ्यः । पुनर्दोहाय कल्पताम् । यज्ञस्य संततिरसि । यज्ञस्य त्वा संततिमनु संतनोमि । अदस्तमसि विष्णवे त्वा । यज्ञायापि दधाम्यहम् । अद्भिररिक्तेन पात्रेण । याः पूताः परिशेरते । अयं पयः सोमं कृत्वा । स्वां योनिमपिगच्छतु
3.7.4.m: For the calves, for humans, / may it be capable of milking again. / You are the continuity of the sacrifice; / following the continuity of the sacrifice, I extend you. / You are unbroken; for Viṣṇu, / for the sacrifice, I cover you. / With water, with a vessel not empty, / which purified lie around, / having made this milk into soma, / let it go to its own womb.

3.7.4.s: parṇavalkaḥ pavitram | saumyaḥ somāddhi nirmitaḥ | imau parṇaṃ ca darbhaṃ ca | devānāṃ havyaśodhanau | prātarveṣāya gopāya | viṣṇo havyaṃ hi rakṣasi | ubhāvagnī upastṛṇate | devatā upavasantu me | ahaṃ grāmyānupavasāmi | mahyaṃ gopataye paśūn
3.7.4.d: पर्णवल्कः पवित्रम् । सौम्यः सोमाद्धि निर्मितः । इमौ पर्णं च दर्भं च । देवानां हव्यशोधनौ । प्रातर्वेषाय गोपाय । विष्णो हव्यं हि रक्षसि । उभावग्नी उपस्तृणते । देवता उपवसन्तु मे । अहं ग्राम्यानुपवसामि । मह्यं गोपतये पशून्
3.7.4.m: The parṇa-bark is the purifier, / sacred to Soma, for it was fashioned from soma. / These two, the parṇa and the darbha, / are the purifiers of the offering for the gods. / Guard [the milk] for the morning service; for, O Viṣṇu, you protect the offering. / For him who spreads the sacred grass on both fires, / let the deities stay near me; / I stay near the domestic animals, / for myself, the lord of cattle.

3.7.5.s: devā deveṣu parākramadhvam | prathamā dvitīyeṣu | dvitīyāstṛtīyeṣu | trirekādaśā iha mā'vata | idaṃ śakeyaṃ yadidaṃ karomi | ātmā karotvātmane | idaṃ kariṣye bheṣajam | idaṃ me viśvabheṣajā | aśvinā prāvataṃ yuvam | idamahaṃ senāyā abhītvaryai
3.7.5.d: देवा देवेषु पराक्रमध्वम् । प्रथमा द्वितीयेषु । द्वितीयास्तृतीयेषु । त्रिरेकादशा इह माऽवत । इदं शकेयं यदिदं करोमि । आत्मा करोत्वात्मने । इदं करिष्ये भेषजम् । इदं मे विश्वभेषजा । अश्विना प्रावतं युवम् । इदमहं सेनाया अभीत्वर्यै
3.7.5.m: O gods, stride forth among the gods; / the first among the second, / the second among the third; / you thrice eleven, protect me here. / May I accomplish this that I am doing; / let the self act for the self. / I shall perform this healing; / O you who have all healing remedies, / you two Aśvins, protect this [work] of mine. / Here do I [turn away] the front of the attacking army.

3.7.5.s: mukhamapohāmi | sūrya jyotirvibhāhi | mahata indriyāya | āpyāyatāṃ ghṛtayoniḥ | agnirhavyā'numanyatām | khamaṅkṣva tvacamaṅkṣva | surūpaṃ tvā vasuvidam | paśūnāṃ tejasā | agnaye juṣṭamabhighārayāmi | syonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomi
3.7.5.d: मुखमपोहामि । सूर्य ज्योतिर्विभाहि । महत इन्द्रियाय । आप्यायतां घृतयोनिः । अग्निर्हव्याऽनुमन्यताम् । खमङ्क्ष्व त्वचमङ्क्ष्व । सुरूपं त्वा वसुविदम् । पशूनां तेजसा । अग्नये जुष्टमभिघारयामि । स्योनं ते सदनं करोमि
3.7.5.m: I wipe away the surface. / Shine out with the light of the sun, / for great power of the senses. / May the womb of ghee swell; / may Agni approve the offerings. / Anoint your opening, anoint your skin, / you of handsome form, finding goods / by the fiery energy of cattle; / I besprinkle [it], acceptable to Agni; / I make a pleasant seat for you.

3.7.5.s: ghṛtasya dhārayā suśevaṃ kalpayāmi | tasminthsīdāmṛte pratitiṣṭha | vrīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ | ārdraḥ prathasnurbhuvanasya gopāḥ | śṛta uthsnāti janitā matīnām | yasta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭaḥ | devānāṃ viṣṭhāmanu yo vitasthe | ātmanvānthsoma ghṛtavān hi bhūtvā | devāngaccha suvarvinda yajamānāya mahyam | irā bhūtiḥ pṛthivyai raso motkramīt
3.7.5.d: घृतस्य धारया सुशेवं कल्पयामि । तस्मिन्थ्सीदामृते प्रतितिष्ठ । व्रीहीणां मेध सुमनस्यमानः । आर्द्रः प्रथस्नुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः । शृत उथ्स्नाति जनिता मतीनाम् । यस्त आत्मा पशुषु प्रविष्टः । देवानां विष्ठामनु यो वितस्थे । आत्मन्वान्थ्सोम घृतवान् हि भूत्वा । देवान्गच्छ सुवर्विन्द यजमानाय मह्यम् । इरा भूतिः पृथिव्यै रसो मोत्क्रमीत्
3.7.5.m: With a stream of ghee I prepare a very kind [seat]. / Sit upon that, stand firm upon immortality, / you sacrificial essence of rice, being well-disposed; / moist, expansive, guardian of the world, / cooked, the generator of thoughts swims up. / That self of yours which has entered the cattle, / which was distributed throughout the forms of the gods— / having indeed become endowed with a self, O Soma, full of ghee, / go to the gods, find heaven for me, the sacrificer. / Let refreshment, prosperity, the sap of the earth not depart.

3.7.5.s: devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devāḥ | yo'hamasmi sa san yaje | yasyāsmi na tamantaremi | svaṃ ma iṣṭaṃ svaṃ dattam | svaṃ pūrtaṃ svaṃ śrāntam | svaṃ hutam | tasya me'gnirupadraṣṭā | vāyurupaśrotā | ādityo'nukhyātā | dyauḥ pitā
3.7.5.d: देवाः पितरः पितरो देवाः । योऽहमस्मि स सन् यजे । यस्यास्मि न तमन्तरेमि । स्वं म इष्टं स्वं दत्तम् । स्वं पूर्तं स्वं श्रान्तम् । स्वं हुतम् । तस्य मेऽग्निरुपद्रष्टा । वायुरुपश्रोता । आदित्योऽनुख्याता । द्यौः पिता
3.7.5.m: The gods are the fathers, the fathers are the gods; / being who I am, I sacrifice. / I do not bypass him whose I am. / My own is the offered, my own the given, / my own the consecrated work, my own the toiled, / my own the poured oblation. / Of that, Agni is the overseer for me, / Vāyu the listener, / the Āditya the announcer, / heaven the father,
