3.7.5.s: pṛthivī mātā | prajāpatirbandhuḥ | ya evāsmi sa san yaje | mā bhermā saṃvikthā mā tvā hiṃsiṣam | mā te tejo'pakramīt | bharatamuddharemanuṣiñca | avadānāni te pratyavadāsyāmi | namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ | yadavadānāni te'vadyan | vilomākārṣamātmanaḥ
3.7.5.d: पृथिवी माता । प्रजापतिर्बन्धुः । य एवास्मि स सन् यजे । मा भेर्मा संविक्था मा त्वा हिंसिषम् । मा ते तेजोऽपक्रमीत् । भरतमुद्धरेमनुषिञ्च । अवदानानि ते प्रत्यवदास्यामि । नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः । यदवदानानि तेऽवद्यन् । विलोमाकार्षमात्मनः
3.7.5.m: the earth the mother, / Prajāpati the kinsman. / Just being who I am, I sacrifice. / Do not fear, do not tremble, may I not harm you; / may your fiery energy not depart. / O two Bhāratas, lift [it] up, pour [ghee] after it. / I shall cut off portions for you in return. / Homage be to you, do not harm me; / if, cutting portions of you, / I have done what goes against the hair of your self,

3.7.5.s: ājyena pratyanajmyenat | tatta āpyāyatāṃ punaḥ | ajyāyo yavamātrāt | āvyādhātkṛtyatāmidam | mā rūrupāma yajñasya | śuddhaṃ sviṣṭamidaṃ haviḥ | manunā dṛṣṭāṃ ghṛtapadīm | mitrāvaruṇasamīritām | dakṣiṇārdhādasaṃbhindan | avadyāmyekatomukhām
3.7.5.d: आज्येन प्रत्यनज्म्येनत् । तत्त आप्यायतां पुनः । अज्यायो यवमात्रात् । आव्याधात्कृत्यतामिदम् । मा रूरुपाम यज्ञस्य । शुद्धं स्विष्टमिदं हविः । मनुना दृष्टां घृतपदीम् । मित्रावरुणसमीरिताम् । दक्षिणार्धादसंभिन्दन् । अवद्याम्येकतोमुखाम्
3.7.5.m: with ghee I anoint it in return; / let that swell again for you. / Not larger than a barleycorn, / let this be cut from the wound. / May we not impair the sacrifice; / pure and well-sacrificed is this offering. / Seen by Manu, stepping in ghee, / stirred by Mitra and Varuṇa, / without tearing from the southern half, / I cut off [a portion from the cake] facing one side.

3.7.5.s: iḍe bhāgaṃ juṣasva naḥ | jinva gā jinvārvataḥ | tasyāste bhakṣivāṇaḥ syāma | sarvātmānaḥ sarvagaṇāḥ | bradhna pinvasva | dadato me mā kṣāyi | kurvato me mopadasat | diśāṃ klṛptirasi | diśo me kalpantām | kalpantāṃ me diśaḥ
3.7.5.d: इडे भागं जुषस्व नः । जिन्व गा जिन्वार्वतः । तस्यास्ते भक्षिवाणः स्याम । सर्वात्मानः सर्वगणाः । ब्रध्न पिन्वस्व । ददतो मे मा क्षायि । कुर्वतो मे मोपदसत् । दिशां क्लृप्तिरसि । दिशो मे कल्पन्ताम् । कल्पन्तां मे दिशः
3.7.5.m: O Iḍā, enjoy our share; / quicken the cows, quicken the coursers. / May we be consumers of you, / whole in self, whole in troop. / O bright sun, swell; / may there be no exhaustion for me as I give; / may there be no deficiency for me as I act. / You are the ordering of the directions; / may the directions be ordered for me; / may the directions be ordered for me.

3.7.5.s: daivīśca mānuṣīśca | ahorātre me kalpetām | ardhamāsā me kalpantām | māsā me kalpantām | ṛtavo me kalpantām | saṃvathsaro me kalpatām | klṛptirasi kalpatāṃ me | āśānāṃ tvā''śāpālebhyaḥ | caturbhyo amṛtebhyaḥ | idaṃ bhūtasyādhyakṣebhyaḥ
3.7.5.d: दैवीश्च मानुषीश्च । अहोरात्रे मे कल्पेताम् । अर्धमासा मे कल्पन्ताम् । मासा मे कल्पन्ताम् । ऋतवो मे कल्पन्ताम् । संवथ्सरो मे कल्पताम् । क्लृप्तिरसि कल्पतां मे । आशानां त्वा'ऽशापालेभ्यः । चतुर्भ्यो अमृतेभ्यः । इदं भूतस्याध्यक्षेभ्यः
3.7.5.m: both divine and human. / May day and night be well-ordered for me. / May the half-months be well-ordered for me. / May the months be well-ordered for me. / May the seasons be well-ordered for me. / May the year be well-ordered for me. / You are order; let there be order for me. / For the guardians of the regions of the world, / the four immortals, / for the overseers of being, with this [offering],

3.7.5.s: vidhema haviṣā vayam | bhajatāṃ bhāgī bhāgam | mā'bhāgo'bhakta | nirabhāgaṃ bhajāmaḥ | apaspinva | oṣadhīrjinva | dvipātpāhi | catuṣpādava | divo vṛṣṭimeraya | brāhmaṇānāmidaṃ haviḥ
3.7.5.d: विधेम हविषा वयम् । भजतां भागी भागम् । माऽभागोऽभक्त । निरभागं भजामः । अपस्पिन्व । ओषधीर्जिन्व । द्विपात्पाहि । चतुष्पादव । दिवो वृष्टिमेरय । ब्राह्मणानामिदं हविः
3.7.5.m: may we worship with the oblation. / Let the one entitled to a share receive his share; / may the one without a share not receive it. / We exclude the one without a share. / Swell the waters; / quicken the plants; / protect the two-footed; / guard the four-footed; / send rain down from heaven. / This oblation belongs to the Brahmins,

3.7.5.s: somyānāṃ somapīthinām | nirbhakto brāhmaṇaḥ | nehābrāhmaṇasyāsti | samaṅktāṃ barhirhaviṣā ghṛtena | samādityairvasubhiḥ saṃ marudbhiḥ | samindreṇa viśvebhirdevebhiraṅktām | divyaṃ nabho gacchatu yathsvāhā | indrāṇīvāvidhavā bhūyāsam | aditiriva suputrā | asthūri tvā gārhapatya
3.7.5.d: सोम्यानां सोमपीथिनाम् । निर्भक्तो ब्राह्मणः । नेहाब्राह्मणस्यास्ति । समङ्क्तां बर्हिर्हविषा घृतेन । समादित्यैर्वसुभिः सं मरुद्भिः । समिन्द्रेण विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरङ्क्ताम् । दिव्यं नभो गच्छतु यथ्स्वाहा । इन्द्राणीवाविधवा भूयासम् । अदितिरिव सुपुत्रा । अस्थूरि त्वा गार्हपत्य
3.7.5.m: to those worthy of soma who drink the soma draught. / Excluded is the non-Brahmin; / there is nothing here for the non-Brahmin. / May the sacrificial grass be anointed with the oblation, with ghee, / together with the Ādityas, the Vasus, and the Maruts. / Let it be anointed with Indra, with the All-Gods; / may that which is svāhā go to the heavenly sky. / Like Indrāṇī, may I never become a widow; / like Aditi, may I be blessed with good sons. / O Gārhapatya, [may I sit] beside you steadily,

3.7.5.s: upaniṣade suprajāstvāya | saṃ patnī patyā sukṛtena gacchatām | yajñasya yuktau dhuryāvabhūtām | saṃjānānau vijahatāmarātīḥ | divi jyotirajaramārabhetām | daśa te tanuvo yajña yajñiyāḥ | tāḥ prīṇātu yajamāno ghṛtena | nāriṣṭhayoḥ praśiṣamīḍamānaḥ | devānāṃ daivye'pi yajamāno'mṛto'bhūt | yaṃ vāṃ devā akalpayan
3.7.5.d: उपनिषदे सुप्रजास्त्वाय । सं पत्नी पत्या सुकृतेन गच्छताम् । यज्ञस्य युक्तौ धुर्यावभूताम् । संजानानौ विजहतामरातीः । दिवि ज्योतिरजरमारभेताम् । दश ते तनुवो यज्ञ यज्ञियाः । ताः प्रीणातु यजमानो घृतेन । नारिष्ठयोः प्रशिषमीडमानः । देवानां दैव्येऽपि यजमानोऽमृतोऽभूत् । यं वां देवा अकल्पयन्
3.7.5.m: to sit down for good offspring. / Let the wife unite with her husband through good deed; / yoked to the sacrifice, they have become draft animals. / Being of one accord, let them cast off enmities; / let them attain imperishable light in heaven. / Ten are your sacrificial bodies, O sacrifice; / let the sacrificer propitiate them with ghee. / Praising the instruction of the two Nāriṣṭhas, / the sacrificer has become immortal among the divine host of gods. / The share of vigor that the gods allotted to you two,

3.7.5.s: ūrjo bhāgaṃ śatakratū | etadvāṃ tena prīṇāni | tena tṛpyatamaṃhahau | ahaṃ devānāṃ sukṛtāmasmi loke | mamedamiṣṭaṃ na mithurbhavāti | ahaṃ nāriṣṭhāvanuyajāmi vidvān | yadābhyāmindro adadhādbhāgadheyam | adārasṛdbhavata deva soma | asmin yajñe maruto mṛḍatā naḥ | mā no vidadabhi bhāmo aśastiḥ
3.7.5.d: ऊर्जो भागं शतक्रतू । एतद्वां तेन प्रीणानि । तेन तृप्यतमंहहौ । अहं देवानां सुकृतामस्मि लोके । ममेदमिष्टं न मिथुर्भवाति । अहं नारिष्ठावनुयजामि विद्वान् । यदाभ्यामिन्द्रो अदधाद्भागधेयम् । अदारसृद्भवत देव सोम । अस्मिन् यज्ञे मरुतो मृडता नः । मा नो विददभि भामो अशस्तिः
3.7.5.m: O two of a hundred resolves, / let me propitiate you with that; / be sated with that, O you two conquerors of distress. / I am in the world of the gods who have done good deeds; / this sacrifice of mine shall not fail. / Knowing [them], I make the after-offering to the two Nāriṣṭhas, / the share which Indra assigned to them. / Be not evasive, O divine Soma; / in this sacrifice, O Maruts, be gracious to us. / May anger and curses not overtake us;

3.7.5.s: mā no vidadvṛjanā dveṣyā yā | ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vayam | pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe | sa no dohatāṃ suvīryam | rāyaspoṣaṃ sahasriṇam | prāṇāya surādhase | pūrṇamāsāya svāhā | amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā | dhenuriva bhūya āpyāyamānā | sā no dohatāṃ suvīryam | rāyaspoṣaṃ sahasriṇam | apānāya surādhase | amāvāsyāyai svāhā | abhistṛṇīhi paridhehi vedim | jāmiṃ mā hiṃsīramuyā śayānā | hotṛṣadanā haritāḥ suvarṇāḥ | niṣkā ime yajamānasya bradhne
3.7.5.d: मा नो विदद्वृजना द्वेष्या या । ऋषभं वाजिनं वयम् । पूर्णमासं यजामहे । स नो दोहतां सुवीर्यम् । रायस्पोषं सहस्रिणम् । प्राणाय सुराधसे । पूर्णमासाय स्वाहा । अमावास्या सुभगा सुशेवा । धेनुरिव भूय आप्यायमाना । सा नो दोहतां सुवीर्यम् । रायस्पोषं सहस्रिणम् । अपानाय सुराधसे । अमावास्यायै स्वाहा । अभिस्तृणीहि परिधेहि वेदिम् । जामिं मा हिंसीरमुया शयाना । होतृषदना हरिताः सुवर्णाः । निष्का इमे यजमानस्य ब्रध्ने
3.7.5.m: may hatred and treacherous plots not overtake us. / We sacrifice to the vigorous bull, / the full moon. / May he yield for us noble heroic power, / thousandfold increase of wealth, / for exhalation rich in bounties. / Svāhā to the full moon! / The auspicious, very benevolent new moon, / swelling ever more like a milk cow, / may she yield for us noble heroic power, / thousandfold increase of wealth, / for inhalation rich in bounties. / Svāhā to the new moon! / Strew around, enclose the altar! / Being laid this way, do not harm your kin. / The seats of the hotṛ are golden-yellow, of beautiful color; / these golden ornaments belong to the sacrificer at the sun.

3.7.6.s: paristṛṇīta paridhattāgnim | parihito'gniryajamānaṃ bhunaktu | apāṃ rasa oṣadhīnāṃ suvarṇaḥ | niṣkā ime yajamānasya santu kāmadughāḥ | amutrāmuṣmiṃ lloke | bhūpate bhuvanapate | mahato bhūtasya pate | brahmāṇaṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe | ahaṃ bhūpatirahaṃ bhuvanapatiḥ | ahaṃ mahato bhūtasya patiḥ
3.7.6.d: परिस्तृणीत परिधत्ताग्निम् । परिहितोऽग्निर्यजमानं भुनक्तु । अपां रस ओषधीनां सुवर्णः । निष्का इमे यजमानस्य सन्तु कामदुघाः । अमुत्रामुष्मिं ल्लोके । भूपते भुवनपते । महतो भूतस्य पते । ब्रह्माणं त्वा वृणीमहे । अहं भूपतिरहं भुवनपतिः । अहं महतो भूतस्य पतिः
3.7.6.m: Enclose, enclose the fire all around; / enclosed, let Agni protect the sacrificer. / The sap of the waters, the golden essence of the plants, / may these golden ornaments of the sacrificer yield all wishes, / yonder in that other world. / O lord of the earth, lord of the world, / lord of the great being, / we choose you as the brahman-priest. / I am the lord of the earth, I am the lord of the world, / I am the lord of the great being.

3.7.6.s: devena savitrā prasūta ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyāmi | devasavitaretaṃ tvā vṛṇate | bṛhaspatiṃ daivyaṃ brahmāṇam | tadahaṃ manase prabravīmi | mano gāyatriyai | gāyatrī triṣṭubhe | triṣṭubjagatyai | jagatyanuṣṭubhe | anuṣṭuk paṅktyai | paṅktiḥ prajāpataye
3.7.6.d: देवेन सवित्रा प्रसूत आर्त्विज्यं करिष्यामि । देवसवितरेतं त्वा वृणते । बृहस्पतिं दैव्यं ब्रह्माणम् । तदहं मनसे प्रब्रवीमि । मनो गायत्रियै । गायत्री त्रिष्टुभे । त्रिष्टुब्जगत्यै । जगत्यनुष्टुभे । अनुष्टुक् पङ्क्त्यै । पङ्क्तिः प्रजापतये
3.7.6.m: Impelled by the divine Savitṛ, I shall perform the office of ṛtvij. / O divine Savitṛ, they choose this one: you, / Bṛhaspati, as the divine brahman-priest. / That I proclaim to the mind; / the mind to the Gāyatrī; / the Gāyatrī to the Triṣṭubh; / the Triṣṭubh to the Jagatī; / the Jagatī to the Anuṣṭubh; / the Anuṣṭubh to the Paṅkti; / the Paṅkti to Prajāpati;

3.7.6.s: prajāpatirviśvebhyo devebhyaḥ | viśve devā bṛhaspataye | bṛhaspatirbrahmaṇe | brahma bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ | bṛhaspatirdevānāṃ brahmā | ahaṃ manuṣyāṇām | bṛhaspate yajñaṃ gopāya | idaṃ tasmai harmyaṃ karomi | yo vo devāścarati brahmacaryam | medhāvī dikṣu manasā tapasvī
3.7.6.d: प्रजापतिर्विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः । विश्वे देवा बृहस्पतये । बृहस्पतिर्ब्रह्मणे । ब्रह्म भूर्भुवः सुवः । बृहस्पतिर्देवानां ब्रह्मा । अहं मनुष्याणाम् । बृहस्पते यज्ञं गोपाय । इदं तस्मै हर्म्यं करोमि । यो वो देवाश्चरति ब्रह्मचर्यम् । मेधावी दिक्षु मनसा तपस्वी
3.7.6.m: Prajāpati to the All-Gods; / the All-Gods to Bṛhaspati; / Bṛhaspati to brahman; / brahman: bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ. / Bṛhaspati is the brahman-priest of the gods; / I of men. / O Bṛhaspati, protect the sacrifice. / I make this dwelling for him / who among you, O gods, practices studenthood of sacred lore, / wise, endowed with austerities, with his mind in the quarters of space.

3.7.6.s: antardūtaścarati mānuṣīṣu | catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ | ghṛtapratīkā bhuvanasya madhye | marmṛjyamānā mahate saubhagāya | mahyaṃ dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān | bhūmirbhūtvā mahimānaṃ pupoṣa | tato devī vardhayate payāṃsi | yajñiyā yajñaṃ vi ca yanti śaṃ ca | oṣadhīrāpa iha śakvarīśca | yo mā hṛdā manasā yaśca vācā
3.7.6.d: अन्तर्दूतश्चरति मानुषीषु । चतुःशिखण्डा युवतिः सुपेशाः । घृतप्रतीका भुवनस्य मध्ये । मर्मृज्यमाना महते सौभगाय । मह्यं धुक्ष्व यजमानाय कामान् । भूमिर्भूत्वा महिमानं पुपोष । ततो देवी वर्धयते पयांसि । यज्ञिया यज्ञं वि च यन्ति शं च । ओषधीराप इह शक्वरीश्च । यो मा हृदा मनसा यश्च वाचा
3.7.6.m: As a messenger, he moves within human females; / the maiden with four locks of hair, beautifully adorned, / with ghee-anointed face in the middle of the world, / grooming herself for great good fortune: / yield desires to me, the sacrificer. / Becoming the earth, she nourished greatness; / thence the goddess increases milk; / worthy of sacrifice, they diverge and converge at the sacrifice, / the plants, waters, and mighty verses here. / Whoever [hates] me with heart, with mind, and whoever with speech,

3.7.6.s: yo brahmaṇā karmaṇā dveṣṭi devāḥ | yaḥ śrutena hṛdayeneṣṇatā ca | tasyendra vajreṇa śiraśchinadmi | ūrṇāmṛdu prathamānaṃ syonam | devebhyo juṣṭaṃ sadanāya barhiḥ | suvarge loke yajamānaṃ hi dhehi | māṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe parame vyoman | catuḥ śikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ | ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste | sā stīryamāṇā mahate saubhagāya
3.7.6.d: यो ब्रह्मणा कर्मणा द्वेष्टि देवाः । यः श्रुतेन हृदयेनेष्णता च । तस्येन्द्र वज्रेण शिरश्छिनद्मि । ऊर्णामृदु प्रथमानं स्योनम् । देवेभ्यो जुष्टं सदनाय बर्हिः । सुवर्गे लोके यजमानं हि धेहि । मां नाकस्य पृष्ठे परमे व्योमन् । चतुः शिखण्डा युवतिः सुपेशाः । घृतप्रतीका वयुनानि वस्ते । सा स्तीर्यमाणा महते सौभगाय
3.7.6.m: whoever hates the gods with sacred lore or with rite, / and whoever through sacred study or by an eager heart: / I sever his head with Indra's vajra. / Soft as wool, spreading out, comfortable, / the sacrificial grass acceptable to the gods to sit upon: / do establish the sacrificer in the heavenly realm, / and me upon the back of the firmament in the highest heaven. / The maiden with four locks of hair, beautifully adorned, / with ghee-anointed face, clothes herself in forms; / she, being strewn for great good fortune,

3.7.6.s: sā me dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān | śivā ca me śagmā caidhi | syonā ca me suṣadā caidhi | ūrjasvatī ca me payasvatī caidhi | iṣamūrjaṃ me pinvasva | brahmatejo me pinvasva | kṣatramojo me pinvasva | viśaṃ puṣṭiṃ me pinvasva | āyurannādyaṃ me pinvasva | prajāṃ paśūnme pinvasva
3.7.6.d: सा मे धुक्ष्व यजमानाय कामान् । शिवा च मे शग्मा चैधि । स्योना च मे सुषदा चैधि । ऊर्जस्वती च मे पयस्वती चैधि । इषमूर्जं मे पिन्वस्व । ब्रह्मतेजो मे पिन्वस्व । क्षत्रमोजो मे पिन्वस्व । विशं पुष्टिं मे पिन्वस्व । आयुरन्नाद्यं मे पिन्वस्व । प्रजां पशून्मे पिन्वस्व
3.7.6.m: yield desires to me, the sacrificer! / Be propitious and helpful to me; / be gentle and easy to sit upon for me; / be full of vigor and full of milk for me; / swell refreshment and vigor for me; / swell spiritual preeminence and fiery energy for me; / swell regal power and splendorous might for me; / swell the common people and nourishment for me; / swell lifespan and proper food for me; / swell offspring and domestic animals for me.

3.7.6.s: asmin yajña upa bhūya innu me | avikṣobhāya paridhīndadhāmi | dhartā dharuṇo dharīyān | agnirdveṣāṃsi nirito nudātai | vicchinadmi vidhṛtībhyāṃ sapatnān | jātān bhrātṛvyān ye ca janiṣyamāṇāḥ | viśo yantrābhyāṃ vidhamāmyenān | ahaṃ svānāmuttamo'sāni devāḥ | viśo yantre nudamāne arātim | viśvaṃ pāpmānamamatiṃ durmarāyum
3.7.6.d: अस्मिन् यज्ञ उप भूय इन्नु मे । अविक्षोभाय परिधीन्दधामि । धर्ता धरुणो धरीयान् । अग्निर्द्वेषांसि निरितो नुदातै । विच्छिनद्मि विधृतीभ्यां सपत्नान् । जातान् भ्रातृव्यान् ये च जनिष्यमाणाः । विशो यन्त्राभ्यां विधमाम्येनान् । अहं स्वानामुत्तमोऽसानि देवाः । विशो यन्त्रे नुदमाने अरातिम् । विश्वं पाप्मानममतिं दुर्मरायुम्
3.7.6.m: At this sacrifice now, for further [welfare] for me, / for non-commotion, I lay down the enclosing sticks. / Upholder, foundation, strong upholder, / may Agni expel hatreds from here. / With the two separating sticks I sever the rivals, / born enemies and those yet to be born. / With the two controllers of the common people I blow them away; / may I be highest among my own people, O gods. / The two controllers of the common people, driving away enmity, / [driving away] all evil, distress, and the one who wishes to kill,

3.7.6.s: sīdantī devī sukṛtasya loke | dhṛtī stho vidhṛtī svadhṛtī | prāṇānmayi dhārayatam | prajāṃ mayi dhārayatam | paśūnmayi dhārayatam | ayaṃ prastara ubhayasya dhartā | dhartā prayājānāmutānūyājānām | sa dādhāra samidho viśvarūpāḥ | tasminthsruco adhyāsādayāmi | āroha patho juhu devayānān
3.7.6.d: सीदन्ती देवी सुकृतस्य लोके । धृती स्थो विधृती स्वधृती । प्राणान्मयि धारयतम् । प्रजां मयि धारयतम् । पशून्मयि धारयतम् । अयं प्रस्तर उभयस्य धर्ता । धर्ता प्रयाजानामुतानूयाजानाम् । स दाधार समिधो विश्वरूपाः । तस्मिन्थ्स्रुचो अध्यासादयामि । आरोह पथो जुहु देवयानान्
3.7.6.m: sitting, divine, in the world of good deeds. / You two are support, separation, self-supported; / uphold the exhalations in me; / uphold offspring in me; / uphold domestic animals in me. / This prastara-bunch is the upholder of both, / upholder of fore-offerings and of after-offerings; / it has upheld fuel sticks of every form; / upon it I place the offering ladles. / Mount the paths leading to the gods, O juhu ladle!

3.7.6.s: yatrarṣayaḥ prathamajā ye purāṇāḥ | hiraṇyapakṣā'jirā sambhṛtāṅgā | vahāsi mā sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ | avāhaṃ bādha upabhṛtā sapatnān | jātānbhrātṛvyān ye ca janiṣyamāṇāḥ | dohai yajñaṃ sudughāmiva dhenum | ahamuttaro bhūyāsam | adhare mathsapatnāḥ | yo mā vācā manasā durmarāyuḥ | hṛdā'rātīyādabhidāsadagne
3.7.6.d: यत्रर्षयः प्रथमजा ये पुराणाः । हिरण्यपक्षाऽजिरा सम्भृताङ्गा । वहासि मा सुकृतां यत्र लोकाः । अवाहं बाध उपभृता सपत्नान् । जातान्भ्रातृव्यान् ये च जनिष्यमाणाः । दोहै यज्ञं सुदुघामिव धेनुम् । अहमुत्तरो भूयासम् । अधरे मथ्सपत्नाः । यो मा वाचा मनसा दुर्मरायुः । हृदाऽरातीयादभिदासदग्ने
3.7.6.m:
Where the ancient first-born seers are,
golden-winged, swift, of complete limbs,
convey me where the worlds of the virtuous are.
With the upabhṛt spoon I drive away my rivals,
both the born rivals and those yet to be born;
may I milk the sacrifice like an easily-milked cow.
May I be superior;
may my rivals be beneath me.
Whoever seeks my death with speech, with mind,
or plots against me with his heart, who assails [me], O Agni—

3.7.6.s: idamasya cittamadharaṃ dhruvāyāḥ | ahamuttaro bhūyāsam | adhare mathsapatnāḥ | ṛṣabho'si śākvaraḥ | ghṛtācīnāṃ sūnuḥ | priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda | syono me sīda suṣadaḥ pṛthivyām | prathayi prajayā paśubhiḥ suvarge loke | divi sīda pṛthivyāmantarikṣe | ahamuttaro bhūyāsam
3.7.6.d: इदमस्य चित्तमधरं ध्रुवायाः । अहमुत्तरो भूयासम् । अधरे मथ्सपत्नाः । ऋषभोऽसि शाक्वरः । घृताचीनां सूनुः । प्रियेण नाम्ना प्रिये सदसि सीद । स्योनो मे सीद सुषदः पृथिव्याम् । प्रथयि प्रजया पशुभिः सुवर्गे लोके । दिवि सीद पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे । अहमुत्तरो भूयासम्

3.7.6.s: adhare mathsapatnāḥ | iyaṃ sthālī ghṛtasya pūrṇā | acchinnapayāḥ śatadhāra uthsaḥ | mārutena śarmaṇā daivyena | yajño'si sarvataḥ śritaḥ | sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacchrayatām | śataṃ me santvāśiṣaḥ | sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtāḥ | irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ | prajāpatirasi sarvataḥ śritaḥ
3.7.6.d: अधरे मथ्सपत्नाः । इयं स्थाली घृतस्य पूर्णा । अच्छिन्नपयाः शतधार उथ्सः । मारुतेन शर्मणा दैव्येन । यज्ञोऽसि सर्वतः श्रितः । सर्वतो मां भूतं भविष्यच्छ्रयताम् । शतं मे सन्त्वाशिषः । सहस्रं मे सन्तु सूनृताः । इरावतीः पशुमतीः । प्रजापतिरसि सर्वतः श्रितः

3.7.6.s: sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacchrayatām | śataṃ me santvāśiṣaḥ | sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtāḥ | irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ | idamindriyamamṛtaṃ vīryam | anenendrāya paśavo'cikithsan | tena devā avatopa mām | iheṣamūrjaṃ yaśaḥ saha ojaḥ saneyam | śṛtaṃ mayi śrayatām | yatpṛthivīmacarattatpraviṣṭam
3.7.6.d: सर्वतो मां भूतं भविष्यच्छ्रयताम् । शतं मे सन्त्वाशिषः । सहस्रं मे सन्तु सूनृताः । इरावतीः पशुमतीः । इदमिन्द्रियममृतं वीर्यम् । अनेनेन्द्राय पशवोऽचिकिथ्सन् । तेन देवा अवतोप माम् । इहेषमूर्जं यशः सह ओजः सनेयम् । शृतं मयि श्रयताम् । यत्पृथिवीमचरत्तत्प्रविष्टम्

3.7.6.s: yenāsiñcadbalamindre prajāpatiḥ | idaṃ tacchukraṃ madhu vājinīvat | yenopariṣṭādadhi nonmahendram | dadhi māṃ dhinotu | ayaṃ vedaḥ pṛthivīmanvavindat | guhā satīṃ gahane gahvareṣu | sa vindatu yajamānāya lokam | acchidraṃ yajñaṃ bhūrikarmā karotu | ayaṃ yajñaḥ samasadaddhaviṣmān | ṛcā sāmnā yajuṣā devatābhiḥ
3.7.6.d: येनासिञ्चद्बलमिन्द्रे प्रजापतिः । इदं तच्छुक्रं मधु वाजिनीवत् । येनोपरिष्टादधि नोन्महेन्द्रम् । दधि मां धिनोतु । अयं वेदः पृथिवीमन्वविन्दत् । गुहा सतीं गहने गह्वरेषु । स विन्दतु यजमानाय लोकम् । अच्छिद्रं यज्ञं भूरिकर्मा करोतु । अयं यज्ञः समसदद्धविष्मान् । ऋचा साम्ना यजुषा देवताभिः

3.7.6.s: tena lokānthsūryavato jayema | indrasya sakhyamamṛtatvamaśyām | yo naḥ kanīya iha kāmayātai | asmin yajñe yajamānāya mahyam | apa tamindrāgnī bhuvanānnudetām | ahaṃ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ videya | agne vājajit | vājaṃ tvā sariṣyantam | vājaṃ jeṣyantam | vājinaṃ vājajitam
3.7.6.d: तेन लोकान्थ्सूर्यवतो जयेम । इन्द्रस्य सख्यममृतत्वमश्याम् । यो नः कनीय इह कामयातै । अस्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय मह्यम् । अप तमिन्द्राग्नी भुवनान्नुदेताम् । अहं प्रजां वीरवतीं विदेय । अग्ने वाजजित् । वाजं त्वा सरिष्यन्तम् । वाजं जेष्यन्तम् । वाजिनं वाजजितम्
3.7.6.m:
Thereby may we conquer the sunlit worlds;
may I attain friendship with Indra and immortality.
Whoever here would wish for us less,
for me the sacrificer in this sacrifice,
may Indrāgnī thrust him away from this world.
May I find offspring rich in heroes.
O Agni, winner of the prize,
thee who art about to run for the prize,
who art about to conquer the prize,
the prize-seeking winner of the prize,

3.7.6.s: vājajityāyai saṃmārjmi | agnimannādamannādyāya | upahūto dyauḥ pitā | upa māṃ dyauḥ pitā hvayatām | agnirāgnīddhrāt | āyuṣe varcase | jīvātvai puṇyāya | upahūtā pṛthivī mātā | upa māṃ mātā pṛthivī hvayatām | agnirāgnīddhrāt
3.7.6.d: वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्मि । अग्निमन्नादमन्नाद्याय । उपहूतो द्यौः पिता । उप मां द्यौः पिता ह्वयताम् । अग्निराग्नीद्ध्रात् । आयुषे वर्चसे । जीवात्वै पुण्याय । उपहूता पृथिवी माता । उप मां माता पृथिवी ह्वयताम् । अग्निराग्नीद्ध्रात्

3.7.6.s: āyuṣe varcase | jīvātvai puṇyāya | mano jyotirjuṣatāmājyam | vicchinnaṃ yajñaṃ samimaṃ dadhātu | bṛhaspatistanutāmimaṃ naḥ | viśve devā iha mādayantām | yaṃ te agna āvṛścāmi | ahaṃ vā kṣipitaścaran | prajāṃ ca tasya mūlaṃ ca | nīcairdevā nivṛścata
3.7.6.d: आयुषे वर्चसे । जीवात्वै पुण्याय । मनो ज्योतिर्जुषतामाज्यम् । विच्छिन्नं यज्ञं समिमं दधातु । बृहस्पतिस्तनुतामिमं नः । विश्वे देवा इह मादयन्ताम् । यं ते अग्न आवृश्चामि । अहं वा क्षिपितश्चरन् । प्रजां च तस्य मूलं च । नीचैर्देवा निवृश्चत

3.7.6.s: agne yo no'bhidāsati | samāno yaśca niṣṭyaḥ | idhmasyeva prakṣāyataḥ | mā tasyoccheṣi kiṃcana | yo māṃ dveṣṭi jātavedaḥ | yaṃ cāhaṃ dveṣmi yaśca mām | sarvāṃstānagne saṃdaha | yāṃścāhaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām | agne vājajit | vājaṃ tvā sasṛvāṃsam
3.7.6.d: अग्ने यो नोऽभिदासति । समानो यश्च निष्ट्यः । इध्मस्येव प्रक्षायतः । मा तस्योच्छेषि किंचन । यो मां द्वेष्टि जातवेदः । यं चाहं द्वेष्मि यश्च माम् । सर्वांस्तानग्ने संदह । यांश्चाहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम् । अग्ने वाजजित् । वाजं त्वा ससृवांसम्
3.7.6.m:
O Agni, whoever assails us,
whether a kinsman or an outsider,
like burning firewood,
may nothing of him remain.
Whoever hates me, O Jātavedas,
and whom I hate and who [hates] me,
burn them all completely, O Agni,
those whom I hate and who [hate] me.
O Agni, winner of the prize,
thee who hast run for the prize,

3.7.6.s: vājaṃ jigivāṃsam | vājinaṃ vājajitam | vājajityāyai saṃmārjmi | agnimannādamannādyāya | vedirbarhiḥ śṛtaṃ haviḥ | idhmaḥ paridhayaḥ srucaḥ | ājyaṃ yajña ṛco yajuḥ | yājyāśca vaṣaṭkārāḥ | saṃ me saṃnatayo namantām | idhmasaṃnahane hute
3.7.6.d: वाजं जिगिवांसम् । वाजिनं वाजजितम् । वाजजित्यायै संमार्ज्मि । अग्निमन्नादमन्नाद्याय । वेदिर्बर्हिः शृतं हविः । इध्मः परिधयः स्रुचः । आज्यं यज्ञ ऋचो यजुः । याज्याश्च वषट्काराः । सं मे संनतयो नमन्ताम् । इध्मसंनहने हुते
3.7.6.m:
who hast conquered the prize,
the prize-seeking winner of the prize,
for winning the prize I wipe down;
Agni, the eater of food, for the eating of food.
The altar, the sacrificial grass, the cooked oblation,
the firewood, the enclosure sticks, the spoons,
the clarified butter, the sacrifice, the Ṛg verses, the Yajus,
the offering verses and the vaṣaṭ-calls—
may my compliances bend together for me,
when the cord binding the firewood is offered.

3.7.6.s: divaḥ khīlo'vatataḥ | pṛthivyā adhyutthitaḥ | tenā sahasrakāṇḍena | dviṣantaṃ śocayāmasi | dviṣanme bahu śocatu | oṣadhe mo ahaṃ śucam | yajña namaste yajña | namo namaśca te yajña | śivena me saṃtiṣṭhasva | syonena me saṃtiṣṭhasva
3.7.6.d: दिवः खीलोऽवततः । पृथिव्या अध्युत्थितः । तेना सहस्रकाण्डेन । द्विषन्तं शोचयामसि । द्विषन्मे बहु शोचतु । ओषधे मो अहं शुचम् । यज्ञ नमस्ते यज्ञ । नमो नमश्च ते यज्ञ । शिवेन मे संतिष्ठस्व । स्योनेन मे संतिष्ठस्व

3.7.6.s: subhūtena me saṃtiṣṭhasva | brahmavarcasena me saṃtiṣṭhasva | yajñasyarddhimanu saṃtiṣṭhasva | upa te yajña namaḥ | upa te namaḥ | upa te namaḥ | triṣphalī kriyamāṇānām | yo nyaṅgo avaśiṣyate | rakṣasāṃ bhāgadheyam | āpastatpravahatāditaḥ
3.7.6.d: सुभूतेन मे संतिष्ठस्व । ब्रह्मवर्चसेन मे संतिष्ठस्व । यज्ञस्यर्द्धिमनु संतिष्ठस्व । उप ते यज्ञ नमः । उप ते नमः । उप ते नमः । त्रिष्फली क्रियमाणानाम् । यो न्यङ्गो अवशिष्यते । रक्षसां भागधेयम् । आपस्तत्प्रवहतादितः

3.7.6.s: ulūkhale musale yacca śūrpe | āśiśleṣa dṛṣadi yatkapāle | avapruṣo vipruṣaḥ saṃyajāmi | viśve devā haviridaṃ juṣantām | yajñe yā vipruṣaḥ santi bahvīḥ | agnau tāḥ sarvāḥ sviṣṭāḥ suhutā juhomi | udyannadya mitramahaḥ | sapatnānme anīnaśaḥ | divainān vidyutā jahi | nimrocannadharānkṛdhi
3.7.6.d: उलूखले मुसले यच्च शूर्पे । आशिश्लेष दृषदि यत्कपाले । अवप्रुषो विप्रुषः संयजामि । विश्वे देवा हविरिदं जुषन्ताम् । यज्ञे या विप्रुषः सन्ति बह्वीः । अग्नौ ताः सर्वाः स्विष्टाः सुहुता जुहोमि । उद्यन्नद्य मित्रमहः । सपत्नान्मे अनीनशः । दिवैनान् विद्युता जहि । निम्रोचन्नधरान्कृधि

3.7.6.s: udyannadya vi no bhaja | pitā putrebhyo yathā | dīrghāyutvasya heśiṣe | tasya no dehi sūrya | udyannadya mitramahaḥ | ārohannuttarāṃ divam | hṛdrogaṃ mama sūrya | harimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya | śukeṣu me harimāṇam | ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi
3.7.6.d: उद्यन्नद्य वि नो भज । पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा । दीर्घायुत्वस्य हेशिषे । तस्य नो देहि सूर्य । उद्यन्नद्य मित्रमहः । आरोहन्नुत्तरां दिवम् । हृद्रोगं मम सूर्य । हरिमाणं च नाशय । शुकेषु मे हरिमाणम् । रोपणाकासु दध्मसि

3.7.6.s: atho hāridraveṣu me | harimāṇaṃ nidadhmasi | udagādayamādityaḥ | viśvena sahasā saha | dviṣantaṃ mama randhayan | mo ahaṃ dviṣato radham | yo naḥ śapādaśapataḥ | yaśca naḥ śapataḥ śapāt | uṣāśca tasmai nimrukca | sarvaṃ pāpaṃ samūhatām
3.7.6.d: अथो हारिद्रवेषु मे । हरिमाणं निदध्मसि । उदगादयमादित्यः । विश्वेन सहसा सह । द्विषन्तं मम रन्धयन् । मो अहं द्विषतो रधम् । यो नः शपादशपतः । यश्च नः शपतः शपात् । उषाश्च तस्मै निम्रुक्च । सर्वं पापं समूहताम्
3.7.6.m:
and also to the yellow wagtails
we deposit my jaundice.
Up has risen this Āditya
together with all victorious power,
subduing my hater;
may I not yield to the hater.
Whoever curses us when we curse not,
and whoever curses us when we curse,
may Dawn and Sunset
sweep together all evil for him.
Whoever is our rival, whoever is hostile,
the mortal who assails [us], O gods,
like burning firewood,
may nothing of him remain.
Loosed, fly far away,
O arrow sharpened by brahman;
go, enter the enemies,
leave not any of them remaining.

3.7.6.s: yo naḥ sapatno yo raṇaḥ | marto'bhidāsati devāḥ | idhmasyeva prakṣāyataḥ | mā tasyoccheṣi kiñcana | avasṛṣṭaḥ parāpata | śaro brahmasaṃśitaḥ | gacchāmitrānpraviśa | maiṣāṃ kaṃcanocchiṣaḥ
3.7.6.d: यो नः सपत्नो यो रणः । मर्तोऽभिदासति देवाः । इध्मस्येव प्रक्षायतः । मा तस्योच्छेषि किञ्चन । अवसृष्टः परापत । शरो ब्रह्मसंशितः । गच्छामित्रान्प्रविश । मैषां कंचनोच्छिषः

3.7.7.s: sakṣedaṃ paśya | vidhartaridaṃ paśya | nākedaṃ paśya | ramatiḥ paniṣṭhā | ṛtaṃ varṣiṣṭham | amṛtā yānyāhuḥ | sūryo variṣṭho akṣabhirvibhāti | anu dyāvāpṛthivī devaputre | dīkṣā'si tapaso yoniḥ | tapo'si brahmaṇo yoniḥ
3.7.7.d: सक्षेदं पश्य । विधर्तरिदं पश्य । नाकेदं पश्य । रमतिः पनिष्ठा । ऋतं वर्षिष्ठम् । अमृता यान्याहुः । सूर्यो वरिष्ठो अक्षभिर्विभाति । अनु द्यावापृथिवी देवपुत्रे । दीक्षाऽसि तपसो योनिः । तपोऽसि ब्रह्मणो योनिः
3.7.7.m: O conqueror, see this! / O sustainer, see this! / O firmament, see this! / The most wondrous delight, / the highest truth, / which they call immortal. / The sun, the widest, shines with [his] eyes, / along with heaven and earth whose sons are gods. / You are the consecration, the womb of heat; / you are heat, the womb of brahman.

3.7.7.s: brahmāsi kṣatrasya yoniḥ | kṣatramasyṛtasya yoniḥ | ṛtamasi bhūrārabhe | śraddhāṃ manasā | dīkṣāṃ tapasā | viśvasya bhuvanasyādhipatnīm | sarve kāmā yajamānasya santu | vātaṃ prāṇaṃ manasā'nvārabhāmahe | prajāpatiṃ yo bhuvanasya gopāḥ | sa no mṛtyostrāyatāṃ pātvaṃhasaḥ
3.7.7.d: ब्रह्मासि क्षत्रस्य योनिः । क्षत्रमस्यृतस्य योनिः । ऋतमसि भूरारभे । श्रद्धां मनसा । दीक्षां तपसा । विश्वस्य भुवनस्याधिपत्नीम् । सर्वे कामा यजमानस्य सन्तु । वातं प्राणं मनसाऽन्वारभामहे । प्रजापतिं यो भुवनस्य गोपाः । स नो मृत्योस्त्रायतां पात्वंहसः
3.7.7.m: You are brahman, the womb of regal power; / you are regal power, the womb of truth; / you are truth, the earth. I take hold of / faith with the mind, / consecration with heat, / the sovereign mistress of the whole world. / May all desires of the sacrificer be fulfilled. / With the mind we take hold of the wind, the exhalation, / of Prajāpati who is the guardian of the world: / may he rescue us from death, protect us from distress!

3.7.7.s: jyogjīvā jarāmaśīmahi | indra śākvara gāyatrīṃ prapadye | tāṃ te yunajmi | indra śākvara triṣṭubhaṃ prapadye | tāṃ te yunajmi | indra śākvara jagatīṃ prapadye | tāṃ te yunajmi | indra śākvarānuṣṭubhaṃ prapadye | tāṃ te yunajmi | indra śākvara paṅktiṃ prapadye
3.7.7.d: ज्योग्जीवा जरामशीमहि । इन्द्र शाक्वर गायत्रीं प्रपद्ये । तां ते युनज्मि । इन्द्र शाक्वर त्रिष्टुभं प्रपद्ये । तां ते युनज्मि । इन्द्र शाक्वर जगतीं प्रपद्ये । तां ते युनज्मि । इन्द्र शाक्वरानुष्टुभं प्रपद्ये । तां ते युनज्मि । इन्द्र शाक्वर पङ्क्तिं प्रपद्ये
3.7.7.m: Living long, may we reach old age. / O mighty Indra, I resort to the gāyatrī; / that I yoke for you. / O mighty Indra, I resort to the triṣṭubh; / that I yoke for you. / O mighty Indra, I resort to the jagatī; / that I yoke for you. / O mighty Indra, I resort to the anuṣṭubh; / that I yoke for you. / O mighty Indra, I resort to the paṅkti;

3.7.7.s: tāṃ te yunajmi | ā'haṃ dīkṣāmaruhamṛtasya patnīm | gāyatreṇa chandasā brahmaṇā ca | ṛtaṃ satye'dhāyi | satyamṛte'dhāyi | ṛtaṃ ca me satyaṃ cābhūtām | jyotirabhūvaṃ suvaragamam | suvargaṃ lokaṃ nākasya pṛṣṭham | bradhnasya viṣṭapamagamam | pṛthivī dīkṣā
3.7.7.d: तां ते युनज्मि । आऽहं दीक्षामरुहमृतस्य पत्नीम् । गायत्रेण छन्दसा ब्रह्मणा च । ऋतं सत्येऽधायि । सत्यमृतेऽधायि । ऋतं च मे सत्यं चाभूताम् । ज्योतिरभूवं सुवरगमम् । सुवर्गं लोकं नाकस्य पृष्ठम् । ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपमगमम् । पृथिवी दीक्षा
3.7.7.m: that I yoke for you. / I have ascended to the consecration, the wife of truth, / with the gāyatrī meter and with brahman. / Truth has been set in reality; / reality has been set in truth; / both truth and reality have come to be for me. / I have become light; I have gone to the sun; / I have gone to the heavenly realm, the back of the firmament, / the summit of the bright one. / The earth is the consecration.

3.7.7.s: tayā'gnirdīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | yayā'gnirdīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | tayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi | antarikṣaṃ dīkṣā | tayā vāyurdīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | yayā vāyurdīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | tayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi | dyaurdīkṣā | tayā''dityo dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | yayā''dityo dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ
3.7.7.d: तयाऽग्निर्दीक्षया दीक्षितः । ययाऽग्निर्दीक्षया दीक्षितः । तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि । अन्तरिक्षं दीक्षा । तया वायुर्दीक्षया दीक्षितः । यया वायुर्दीक्षया दीक्षितः । तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि । द्यौर्दीक्षा । तया'ऽदित्यो दीक्षया दीक्षितः । यया'ऽदित्यो दीक्षया दीक्षितः
3.7.7.m:
With that consecration Agni was consecrated; / with which consecration Agni was consecrated, / with that consecration I consecrate you. / The intermediate space is the consecration; / with that consecration Vāyu was consecrated; / with which consecration Vāyu was consecrated, / with that consecration I consecrate you. / The sky is the consecration; / with that consecration the Āditya was consecrated; / with which consecration the Āditya was consecrated,

with that consecration I consecrate you. / The directions are the consecration; / with that consecration the Moon was consecrated; / with which consecration the Moon was consecrated, / with that consecration I consecrate you. / The waters are the consecration; / with that consecration King Varuṇa was consecrated; / with which consecration King Varuṇa was consecrated, / with that consecration I consecrate you. / The plants are the consecration;

3.7.7.s: tayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi | diśo dīkṣā | tayā candramā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | yayā candramā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | tayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi | āpo dīkṣā | tayā varuṇo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | yayā varuṇo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | tayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi | oṣadhayo dīkṣā
3.7.7.d: तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि । दिशो दीक्षा । तया चन्द्रमा दीक्षया दीक्षितः । यया चन्द्रमा दीक्षया दीक्षितः । तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि । आपो दीक्षा । तया वरुणो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितः । यया वरुणो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितः । तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि । ओषधयो दीक्षा

3.7.7.s: tayā somo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | yayā somo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | tayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi | vāgdīkṣā | tayā prāṇo dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | yayā prāṇo dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ | tayā tvā dīkṣayā dīkṣayāmi | pṛthivī tvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣatām | antarikṣaṃ tvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣatām | dyaustvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣatām
3.7.7.d: तया सोमो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितः । यया सोमो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितः । तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि । वाग्दीक्षा । तया प्राणो दीक्षया दीक्षितः । यया प्राणो दीक्षया दीक्षितः । तया त्वा दीक्षया दीक्षयामि । पृथिवी त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षताम् । अन्तरिक्षं त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षताम् । द्यौस्त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षताम्
3.7.7.m: with that consecration King Soma was consecrated; / with which consecration King Soma was consecrated, / with that consecration I consecrate you. / Speech is the consecration; / with that consecration the exhalation was consecrated; / with which consecration the exhalation was consecrated, / with that consecration I consecrate you. / May the earth consecrate herself after you as you are being consecrated; / may the intermediate space consecrate itself after you as you are being consecrated; / may the sky consecrate itself after you as you are being consecrated;

3.7.7.s: diśastvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣantām | āpastvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣantām | oṣadhayastvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣantām | vāktvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣatām | ṛcastvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣantām | sāmāni tvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣantām | yajūṃṣi tvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣantām | ahaśca rātriśca | kṛṣiśca vṛṣṭiśca | tviṣiścāpacitiśca
3.7.7.d: दिशस्त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षन्ताम् । आपस्त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षन्ताम् । ओषधयस्त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षन्ताम् । वाक्त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षताम् । ऋचस्त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षन्ताम् । सामानि त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षन्ताम् । यजूंषि त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षन्ताम् । अहश्च रात्रिश्च । कृषिश्च वृष्टिश्च । त्विषिश्चापचितिश्च
3.7.7.m: may the directions consecrate themselves after you as you are being consecrated; / may the waters consecrate themselves after you as you are being consecrated; / may the plants consecrate themselves after you as you are being consecrated; / may speech consecrate itself after you as you are being consecrated; / may the ṛc verses consecrate themselves after you as you are being consecrated; / may the sāman chants consecrate themselves after you as you are being consecrated; / may the yajus formulas consecrate themselves after you as you are being consecrated. / Day and night, / plow-land and rain, / brilliance and reverence,

3.7.7.s: āpaścauṣadhayaśca | ūrkca sūnṛtā ca | tāstvā dīkṣamāṇamanu dīkṣantām | sve dakṣe dakṣapiteha sīda | devānāṃ sumno mahate raṇāya | svāsasthastanuvā saṃviśasva | pitevaidhi sūnava āsuśevaḥ | śivo mā śivamāviśa | satyaṃ ma ātmā | śraddhā me kṣitiḥ
3.7.7.d: आपश्चौषधयश्च । ऊर्क्च सूनृता च । तास्त्वा दीक्षमाणमनु दीक्षन्ताम् । स्वे दक्षे दक्षपितेह सीद । देवानां सुम्नो महते रणाय । स्वासस्थस्तनुवा संविशस्व । पितेवैधि सूनव आसुशेवः । शिवो मा शिवमाविश । सत्यं म आत्मा । श्रद्धा मे क्षितिः
3.7.7.m: waters and plants, / vigor and pleasant speech— / may they consecrate themselves after you as you are being consecrated. / In your own skill, O father of skill, sit here, / the favor of the gods for the great battle. / Well seated, enter with [your] body; / be like a father very kind to a son. / Auspicious, enter into me as auspicious. / Truth is my self; / faith is my inexhaustibility;

3.7.7.s: tapo me pratiṣṭhā | savitṛprasūtā mā diśo dīkṣayantu | satyamasmi | ahaṃ tvadasmi madasi tvametat | mamāsi yonistava yonirasmi | mamaiva sanvaha havyānyagne | putraḥ pitre lokakṛjjātavedaḥ | ājuhvānaḥ supratīkaḥ purastāt | agne svāṃ yonimāsīda sādhyā | asminthsadhasthe adhyuttarasmin
3.7.7.d: तपो मे प्रतिष्ठा । सवितृप्रसूता मा दिशो दीक्षयन्तु । सत्यमस्मि । अहं त्वदस्मि मदसि त्वमेतत् । ममासि योनिस्तव योनिरस्मि । ममैव सन्वह हव्यान्यग्ने । पुत्रः पित्रे लोककृज्जातवेदः । आजुह्वानः सुप्रतीकः पुरस्तात् । अग्ने स्वां योनिमासीद साध्या । अस्मिन्थ्सधस्थे अध्युत्तरस्मिन्
3.7.7.m: heat is my foundation. / Impelled by Savitṛ, may the directions consecrate me. / I am truth. / I am from you; you are this from me. / You are my womb; I am your womb. / Being mine indeed, convey the oblations, O Agni, / a son to a father, creating a place, O Jātavedas. / Invoked, fair of face in front, / O Agni, sit on your own womb, propitiable / on this higher assembly place.

3.7.7.s: viśve devā yajamānaśca sīdata | ekamiṣe viṣṇustvā'nvetu | dve ūrje viṣṇustvā'nvetu | trīṇi vratāya viṣṇustvā'nvetu | catvāri māyo bhavāya viṣṇustvā'nvetu | pañca paśubhyo viṣṇustvā'nvetu | ṣaḍrāyaspoṣāya viṣṇustvā'nvetu | sapta saptabhyo hotrābhyo viṣṇustvā'nvetu | sakhāyaḥ saptapadā abhūma | sakhyaṃ te gameyam
3.7.7.d: विश्वे देवा यजमानश्च सीदत । एकमिषे विष्णुस्त्वाऽन्वेतु । द्वे ऊर्जे विष्णुस्त्वाऽन्वेतु । त्रीणि व्रताय विष्णुस्त्वाऽन्वेतु । चत्वारि मायो भवाय विष्णुस्त्वाऽन्वेतु । पञ्च पशुभ्यो विष्णुस्त्वाऽन्वेतु । षड्रायस्पोषाय विष्णुस्त्वाऽन्वेतु । सप्त सप्तभ्यो होत्राभ्यो विष्णुस्त्वाऽन्वेतु । सखायः सप्तपदा अभूम । सख्यं ते गमेयम्
3.7.7.m: Sit down, all-gods and sacrificer! / One: may Viṣṇu follow you for refreshment. / Two: may Viṣṇu follow you for vigor. / Three: may Viṣṇu follow you for vow. / Four: may Viṣṇu follow you for delight. / Five: may Viṣṇu follow you for domestic animals. / Six: may Viṣṇu follow you for prosperity of wealth. / Seven: may Viṣṇu follow you for seven hotrā offices. / Friends of seven steps have we become; / may I attain your friendship.

3.7.7.s: sakhyātte mā yoṣam | sakhyānme mā yoṣṭhāḥ | sā'si subrahmaṇye | tasyāste pṛthivī pādaḥ | sā'si subrahmaṇye | tasyāste'ntarikṣaṃ pādaḥ | sā'si subrahmaṇye | tasyāste dyauḥ pādaḥ | sā'si subrahmaṇye | tasyāste diśaḥ pādaḥ
3.7.7.d: सख्यात्ते मा योषम् । सख्यान्मे मा योष्ठाः । साऽसि सुब्रह्मण्ये । तस्यास्ते पृथिवी पादः । साऽसि सुब्रह्मण्ये । तस्यास्तेऽन्तरिक्षं पादः । साऽसि सुब्रह्मण्ये । तस्यास्ते द्यौः पादः । साऽसि सुब्रह्मण्ये । तस्यास्ते दिशः पादः
3.7.7.m: May I not be separated from your friendship; / do not be separated from my friendship! / You are she, O Subrahmaṇyā; / of you, as such, the earth is a foot. / You are she, O Subrahmaṇyā; / of you, as such, the intermediate space is a foot. / You are she, O Subrahmaṇyā; / of you, as such, the sky is a foot. / You are she, O Subrahmaṇyā; / of you, as such, the directions are a foot.

3.7.7.s: parorajāste pañcamaḥ pādaḥ | sā na iṣamūrjaṃ dhukṣva | teja indriyam | brahmavarcasamannādyam | vimime tvā payasvatīm | devānāṃ dhenuṃ sudughāmanapasphurantīm | indraḥ somaṃ pibatu | kṣemo astu naḥ | imāṃ narāḥ kṛṇuta vedimetya | vasumatīṃ rudravatīmādityavatīm
3.7.7.d: परोरजास्ते पञ्चमः पादः । सा न इषमूर्जं धुक्ष्व । तेज इन्द्रियम् । ब्रह्मवर्चसमन्नाद्यम् । विमिमे त्वा पयस्वतीम् । देवानां धेनुं सुदुघामनपस्फुरन्तीम् । इन्द्रः सोमं पिबतु । क्षेमो अस्तु नः । इमां नराः कृणुत वेदिमेत्य । वसुमतीं रुद्रवतीमादित्यवतीम्
3.7.7.m: Beyond the dust is your fifth foot. / As such, milk for us refreshment, vigor, / fiery energy, sensory power, / spiritual preeminence, food. / I measure you out, full of milk, / the easy-to-milk, non-kicking cow of the gods. / May Indra drink Soma; / may there be safety for us. / Men, having come, make this altar, / possessed of Vasus, possessed of Rudras, possessed of Ādityas,

3.7.7.s: varṣmandivaḥ | nābhā pṛthivyāḥ | yathā'yaṃ yajamāno na riṣyet | devasya savituḥ save | catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ | ghṛtapratīkā bhuvanasya madhye | tasyāṃ suparṇāvadhi yau niviṣṭau | tayordevānāmadhi bhāgadheyam | apa janyaṃ bhayaṃ nuda | apa cakrāṇi vartaya | gṛhaṃ somasya gacchatam | na vā uvetanmriyase na riṣyasi | devāṃ ideṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ | yatra yanti sukṛto nāpi duṣkṛtaḥ | tatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu
3.7.7.d: वर्ष्मन्दिवः । नाभा पृथिव्याः । यथाऽयं यजमानो न रिष्येत् । देवस्य सवितुः सवे । चतुःशिखण्डा युवतिः सुपेशाः । घृतप्रतीका भुवनस्य मध्ये । तस्यां सुपर्णावधि यौ निविष्टौ । तयोर्देवानामधि भागधेयम् । अप जन्यं भयं नुद । अप चक्राणि वर्तय । गृहं सोमस्य गच्छतम् । न वा उवेतन्म्रियसे न रिष्यसि । देवां इदेषि पथिभिः सुगेभिः । यत्र यन्ति सुकृतो नापि दुष्कृतः । तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु
3.7.7.m: of the sky, / at the navel of the earth, / so that this sacrificer will not be harmed, / at the impulse of the god Savitṛ. / A four-crested maiden, well-adorned, / with a face of ghee, in the middle of the world, / upon whom two fair-winged birds have settled— / on them is the gods' share. / Drive away fear from strangers; / roll away the wheels! / Go to the house of Soma! / You do not die indeed at this; you are not harmed; / you go to the gods along paths easy to travel, / where the doers of good go, not the doers of evil: / there may the god Savitṛ place you.

3.7.8.s: yadasya pāre rajasaḥ | śukraṃ jyotirajāyata | tannaḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ | agne vaiśvānara svāhā | yasmādbhīṣā'vāśiṣṭhāḥ | tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa | namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣe | yasmādbhīṣā nyaṣadaḥ | tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi
3.7.8.d: यदस्य पारे रजसः । शुक्रं ज्योतिरजायत । तन्नः पर्षदति द्विषः । अग्ने वैश्वानर स्वाहा । यस्माद्भीषाऽवाशिष्ठाः । ततो नो अभयं कृधि । प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मृड । नमो रुद्राय मीढुषे । यस्माद्भीषा न्यषदः । ततो नो अभयं कृधि
3.7.8.m:
The bright light that was born / on the far shore of the mist, / may that carry us across our haters! / O Agni Vaiśvānara, svāhā! / That out of fear of which you cried out, / from that make us free from danger; / be gracious to all offspring! / Homage to Rudra the bountiful! / That out of fear of which you sat down, / from that make us free from danger!

Be gracious to all offspring; / homage to Rudra the bounteous! / Arise, bull; stand firm, do not come to harm; / do not harm this sacrifice or the sacrificer. / Establish the sacrificer in the heavenly realm; / be prosperity for our two-footed, prosperity for our four-footed! / From whatever you trembled in fear, fled, or collapsed, / make us safe from that; / be gracious to all offspring; / homage to Rudra the bounteous!

3.7.8.s: prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa | namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣe | udusra tiṣṭha pratitiṣṭha mā riṣaḥ | memaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca rīriṣaḥ | suvarge loke yajamānaṃ hi dhehi | śaṃ na edhi dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade | yasmādbhīṣā'vepiṣṭhāḥ palāyiṣṭhāḥ samajñāsthāḥ | tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa | namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣe
3.7.8.d: प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मृड । नमो रुद्राय मीढुषे । उदुस्र तिष्ठ प्रतितिष्ठ मा रिषः । मेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च रीरिषः । सुवर्गे लोके यजमानं हि धेहि । शं न एधि द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे । यस्माद्भीषाऽवेपिष्ठाः पलायिष्ठाः समज्ञास्थाः । ततो नो अभयं कृधि । प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मृड । नमो रुद्राय मीढुषे

3.7.8.s: ya idamakaḥ | tasmai namaḥ | tasmai svāhā | na vā u vetanmriyase | āśānāṃ tvā viśvā āśāḥ | yajñasya hi stha ṛtviyau | indrāgnī cetanasya ca | hutāhutasya tṛpyatam | ahutasya hutasya ca | hutasya cāhutasya ca | ahutasya hutasya ca | indrāgnī asya somasya | vītaṃ pibataṃ juṣethām | mā yajamānaṃ tamo vidat | martvijo mo imāḥ prajāḥ | mā yaḥ somamimaṃ pibāt | saṃsṛṣṭamubhayaṃ kṛtam
3.7.8.d: य इदमकः । तस्मै नमः । तस्मै स्वाहा । न वा उ वेतन्म्रियसे । आशानां त्वा विश्वा आशाः । यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्वियौ । इन्द्राग्नी चेतनस्य च । हुताहुतस्य तृप्यतम् । अहुतस्य हुतस्य च । हुतस्य चाहुतस्य च । अहुतस्य हुतस्य च । इन्द्राग्नी अस्य सोमस्य । वीतं पिबतं जुषेथाम् । मा यजमानं तमो विदत् । मर्त्विजो मो इमाः प्रजाः । मा यः सोममिमं पिबात् । संसृष्टमुभयं कृतम्
3.7.8.m: Whoever has done this, / homage to him, / svāhā to him! / 'You do not indeed die now…' [etc.]; / 'The regions you…', 'All the regions…' [etc.]. / For you two are seasonal [rulers] of the sacrifice, / and mindful, O Indra and Agni. / Delight in the offered and the unoffered, / in the unoffered and the offered, / in the offered and the unoffered, / in the unoffered and the offered! / O Indra and Agni, partake of this soma, / drink and be pleased! / May darkness not find the sacrificer, / nor the officiating priests, nor these offspring, / nor whoever will drink this soma! / Both are combined, are made.

3.7.9.s: anāgasastvā vayam | iṃdreṇa preṣitā upa | vāyuṣṭe astvaṃśabhūḥ | mitraste astvaṃśabhūḥ | varuṇaste astvaṃśabhūḥ | apāṃ kṣayā ṛtasya garbhāḥ | bhuvanasya gopāḥ śyenā atithayaḥ | parvatānāṃ kakubhaḥ prayuto napātāraḥ | vagnunendragg hvayata | ghoṣeṇāmīvāṃścātayata
3.7.9.d: अनागसस्त्वा वयम् । इंद्रेण प्रेषिता उप । वायुष्टे अस्त्वंशभूः । मित्रस्ते अस्त्वंशभूः । वरुणस्ते अस्त्वंशभूः । अपां क्षया ऋतस्य गर्भाः । भुवनस्य गोपाः श्येना अतिथयः । पर्वतानां ककुभः प्रयुतो नपातारः । वग्नुनेन्द्रग्ग् ह्वयत । घोषेणामीवांश्चातयत
3.7.9.m: Sinless are we before you, / sent forth by Indra. / May Vāyu be the stalk-producer for you; / may Mitra be the stalk-producer for you; / may Varuṇa be the stalk-producer for you. / Inhabitants of the waters, embryos of the truth, / guardians of the world, falcon guests, / peaks of the mountains, unfailing descendants, / call Indra with your rumble; / drive away ailments with your noise!

3.7.9.s: yuktāḥ stha vahata | devā grāvāṇa indurindra ityavādiṣuḥ | endramacucyavuḥ paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ | ā'smāthsadhasthāt | ororantarikṣāt | ā subhūtamasuṣavuḥ | brahmavarcasaṃ ma āsuṣavuḥ | samare rakṣāṃsyavadhiṣuḥ | apahataṃ brahmajyasya | vākca tvā manaśca śriṇītām
3.7.9.d: युक्ताः स्थ वहत । देवा ग्रावाण इन्दुरिन्द्र इत्यवादिषुः । एन्द्रमचुच्यवुः परमस्याः परावतः । आऽस्माथ्सधस्थात् । ओरोरन्तरिक्षात् । आ सुभूतमसुषवुः । ब्रह्मवर्चसं म आसुषवुः । समरे रक्षांस्यवधिषुः । अपहतं ब्रह्मज्यस्य । वाक्च त्वा मनश्च श्रिणीताम्
3.7.9.m: Yoked are you; draw! / The divine pressing stones have sounded: 'Indu, Indra!' / They have shaken Indra hither from the farthest distance, / from this seat, / from the wide intermediate space. / They have pressed forth good fortune, / they have pressed forth spiritual preeminence for me; / they have slain the demons in the conflict. / Slain is the [enemy] of the robber of sacred lore. / May speech and mind cook you;

3.7.9.s: prāṇaśca tvā'pānaśca śrīṇītām | cakṣuśca tvā śrotraṃ ca śrīṇītām | dakṣaśca tvā balaṃ ca śrīṇītām | ojaśca tvā sahaśca śrīṇītām | āyuśca tvā jarā ca śrīṇītām | ātmā ca tvā tanūśca śrīṇītām | śṛto'si śṛtaṃ kṛtaḥ | śṛtāya tvā śṛtebhyastvā | yamindramāhurvaruṇaṃ yamāhuḥ | yaṃ mitramāhuryamu satyamāhuḥ
3.7.9.d: प्राणश्च त्वाऽपानश्च श्रीणीताम् । चक्षुश्च त्वा श्रोत्रं च श्रीणीताम् । दक्षश्च त्वा बलं च श्रीणीताम् । ओजश्च त्वा सहश्च श्रीणीताम् । आयुश्च त्वा जरा च श्रीणीताम् । आत्मा च त्वा तनूश्च श्रीणीताम् । शृतोऽसि शृतं कृतः । शृताय त्वा शृतेभ्यस्त्वा । यमिन्द्रमाहुर्वरुणं यमाहुः । यं मित्रमाहुर्यमु सत्यमाहुः
3.7.9.m: may exhalation and inhalation cook you; / may sight and hearing cook you; / may skill and strength cook you; / may splendorous might and force cook you; / may lifespan and old age cook you; / may soul and body cook you. / You are cooked, made cooked; / for the cooked [god] to you, for the cooked [gods] to you! / Whom they call Indra, whom they call Varuṇa, / whom they call Mitra, and whom they call Truth;

3.7.9.s: yo devānāṃ devatamastapojāḥ | tasmai tvā tebhyastvā | mayi tyadindriyaṃ mahat | mayi dakṣo mayi kratuḥ | mayi dhāyi suvīryam | triśuggharmo vibhātu me | ākūtyā manasā saha | virājā jyotiṣā saha | yajñena payasā saha | tasya dohamaśīmahi
3.7.9.d: यो देवानां देवतमस्तपोजाः । तस्मै त्वा तेभ्यस्त्वा । मयि त्यदिन्द्रियं महत् । मयि दक्षो मयि क्रतुः । मयि धायि सुवीर्यम् । त्रिशुग्घर्मो विभातु मे । आकूत्या मनसा सह । विराजा ज्योतिषा सह । यज्ञेन पयसा सह । तस्य दोहमशीमहि
3.7.9.m: who is the most divine of the gods, born of heat, / for him to you, for them to you! / In me is that great indriya power; / in me is skill, in me is mental power; / in me is excellent heroic power established. / May the triply shining cauldron beam out for me, / along with intention and mind, / along with the virāj metre and light, / along with sacrifice and milk; / may we obtain its milk!

3.7.9.s: tasya sumnamaśīmahi | tasya bhakṣamaśīmahi | vāgjuṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu | mitro janānprasamitra | yasmānna jātaḥ paro anyo asti | ya āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā | prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ | trīṇi jyotīṃṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī | eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviyaḥ | indro nāma śruto gaṇe
3.7.9.d: तस्य सुम्नमशीमहि । तस्य भक्षमशीमहि । वाग्जुषाणा सोमस्य तृप्यतु । मित्रो जनान्प्रसमित्र । यस्मान्न जातः परो अन्यो अस्ति । य आविवेश भुवनानि विश्वा । प्रजापतिः प्रजया संविदानः । त्रीणि ज्योतींषि सचते स षोडशी । एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्वियः । इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गणे
3.7.9.m: May we obtain its favor; / may we obtain its portion. / May speech, finding pleasure, be satisfied with the soma! / 'Mitra brings men together…', 'He, O Mitra…' [etc.]. / Than whom none other was born higher, / who entered all worlds, / Prajāpati, agreeing with offspring, / accompanies the three lights, being the sixteenfold. / This is the seasonal priest, / known by the name of Indra in the troop.

3.7.9.s: pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsiṣaṃ harī | ya ṛtviyaḥ pra te vanve | vanuṣo haryataṃ madam | indro nāma ghṛtaṃ na yaḥ | haribhiścāru secate | śruto gaṇa ā tvā viśantu | harivarpasaṃ giraḥ | indrādhipate'dhipatistvaṃ devānāmasi | adhipatiṃ mām | āyuṣmantaṃ varcasvantaṃ manuṣyeṣu kuru
3.7.9.d: प्र ते महे विदथे शंसिषं हरी । य ऋत्वियः प्र ते वन्वे । वनुषो हर्यतं मदम् । इन्द्रो नाम घृतं न यः । हरिभिश्चारु सेचते । श्रुतो गण आ त्वा विशन्तु । हरिवर्पसं गिरः । इन्द्राधिपतेऽधिपतिस्त्वं देवानामसि । अधिपतिं माम् । आयुष्मन्तं वर्चस्वन्तं मनुष्येषु कुरु
3.7.9.m: I have praised your two bay steeds for the great rite, / [the steeds] which are seasonal; I solicit for you / the desirable exhilaration of the worshiper. / Indra by name, who like clarified butter / is delightfully poured out with the bay steeds; / famed in the troop, let the songs / enter you who possess bay form! / O Indra, overlord, you are the overlord of the gods; / make me an overlord, / long-lived and radiant among humans!

3.7.9.s: indraśca samrāḍvaruṇaśca rājā | tau te bhakṣaṃ cakraturagra etam | tayoranu bhakṣaṃ bhakṣayāmi | vāgjuṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu | prajāpatirviśvakarmā | tasya mano devaṃ yajñena rādhyāsam | arthe gā asya jahitaḥ | avasānapate'vasānaṃ me vinda | namo rudrāya vāstoṣpataye | āyane vidravaṇe
3.7.9.d: इन्द्रश्च सम्राड्वरुणश्च राजा । तौ ते भक्षं चक्रतुरग्र एतम् । तयोरनु भक्षं भक्षयामि । वाग्जुषाणा सोमस्य तृप्यतु । प्रजापतिर्विश्वकर्मा । तस्य मनो देवं यज्ञेन राध्यासम् । अर्थे गा अस्य जहितः । अवसानपतेऽवसानं मे विन्द । नमो रुद्राय वास्तोष्पतये । आयने विद्रवणे
3.7.9.m: Indra the emperor and Varuṇa the king, / they two first made this portion for you; / in following of them two, I partake of the portion. / May speech, finding pleasure, be satisfied with the soma! / Prajāpati Viśvakarman, / may I propitiate his divine mind with sacrifice! / You go straight to the goal, not forsaken; / O lord of the homestead, find a homestead for me. / Homage to Rudra, lord of the homestead, / in coming, in running away;

3.7.9.s: udyāne yatparāyaṇe | āvartane vivartane | yo gopāyati taṃ huve | yānyapāmityānyapratīttānyasmi | yamasya balinā carāmi | ihaiva santaḥ prati tadyātayāmaḥ | jīvā jīvebhyo niharāma enat | anṛṇā asminnanṛṇāḥ parasmin | tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma | ye devayānā uta pitṛyāṇāḥ
3.7.9.d: उद्याने यत्परायणे । आवर्तने विवर्तने । यो गोपायति तं हुवे । यान्यपामित्यान्यप्रतीत्तान्यस्मि । यमस्य बलिना चरामि । इहैव सन्तः प्रति तद्यातयामः । जीवा जीवेभ्यो निहराम एनत् । अनृणा अस्मिन्ननृणाः परस्मिन् । तृतीये लोके अनृणाः स्याम । ये देवयाना उत पितृयाणाः
3.7.9.m: in setting forth, in departing, / in turning towards, in turning away, / whoever watches over, him I call. / Whatever debts I have that are not paid back, / for which I go about with Yama's tribute, / being here indeed, may we repay that; / living, may we pay it back to the living. / Debt-free in this world, debt-free in the next, / may we be debt-free in the third world! / The paths that are of the gods and that are of the ancestors,

3.7.9.s: sarvānpatho anṛṇā ākṣīyema | idamūnuḥ śreyo'vasānamāganma | śive no dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime | gomaddhanavadaśvavadūrjasvat | suvīrā vīrairanu saṃcarema | arkaḥ pavitraṃ rajaso vimānaḥ | punāti devānāṃ bhuvanāni viśvā | dyāvāpṛthivī payasā saṃvidāne | ghṛtaṃ duhāte amṛtaṃ prapīne | pavitramarko rajaso vimānaḥ | punāti devānāṃ bhuvanāni viśvā | suvarjyotiryaśo mahat | aśīmahi gādhamuta pratiṣṭhām
3.7.9.d: सर्वान्पथो अनृणा आक्षीयेम । इदमूनुः श्रेयोऽवसानमागन्म । शिवे नो द्यावापृथिवी उभे इमे । गोमद्धनवदश्ववदूर्जस्वत् । सुवीरा वीरैरनु संचरेम । अर्कः पवित्रं रजसो विमानः । पुनाति देवानां भुवनानि विश्वा । द्यावापृथिवी पयसा संविदाने । घृतं दुहाते अमृतं प्रपीने । पवित्रमर्को रजसो विमानः । पुनाति देवानां भुवनानि विश्वा । सुवर्ज्योतिर्यशो महत् । अशीमहि गाधमुत प्रतिष्ठाम्
3.7.9.m: debt-free may we dwell along all the paths! / We have just now come to this better homestead; / propitious to us are both these, heaven and earth, / possessing cattle, possessing wealth, possessing horses, full of vigor; / endowed with heroes, may we move about together with heroes. / The sun is the purifier, measuring the realm of space; / it purifies all the creatures of the gods. / Heaven and earth, agreeing in milk, / swollen, yield clarified butter, the nectar of immortality. / The sun, the purifier, measuring the realm of space, / purifies all the creatures of the gods. / Light, heavenly light, great glory, / may we attain a shallow and a firm foundation!

3.7.10.s: udastāṃpsīthsavitā mitro aryamā | sarvānamitrānavadhīdyugena | bṛhantaṃ māmakaradvīravantam | rathantare śrayasva svāhā pṛthivyām | vāmadevye śrayasva svāhā'ntarikṣe | bṛhati śrayasva svāhā divi | bṛhatā tvopastabhnomi | ā tvā dade yaśase vīryāya ca | asmāsvaghniyā yūyaṃ dadhāthendriyaṃ payaḥ | yaste drapso yasta udarṣaḥ
3.7.10.d: उदस्तांप्सीथ्सविता मित्रो अर्यमा । सर्वानमित्रानवधीद्युगेन । बृहन्तं मामकरद्वीरवन्तम् । रथन्तरे श्रयस्व स्वाहा पृथिव्याम् । वामदेव्ये श्रयस्व स्वाहाऽन्तरिक्षे । बृहति श्रयस्व स्वाहा दिवि । बृहता त्वोपस्तभ्नोमि । आ त्वा ददे यशसे वीर्याय च । अस्मास्वघ्निया यूयं दधाथेन्द्रियं पयः । यस्ते द्रप्सो यस्त उदर्षः
3.7.10.m: Savitṛ, Mitra, and Aryaman have ascended; / he has slain all enemies with his yoke. / He has made me great and rich in heroes. / Rest in the Rathaṃtara, svāhā, on the earth! / Rest in the Vāmadevya, svāhā, in the intermediate space! / Rest in the Bṛhat, svāhā, in heaven! / With the Bṛhat I prop you up. / I take you for glory and for heroic power. / In us, O cows that must not be harmed, establish indriya power and milk! / Whatever drop of yours, whatever swelling of yours [there is],

3.7.10.s: daivyaḥ keturviśvaṃ bhuvanamāviveśa | sa naḥ pāhyariṣṭyai svāhā | anu mā sarvo yajño'yametu | viśve devā marutaḥ sāmārkaḥ | āpriyaśchandāṃsi nivido yajūṃṣi | asyai pṛthivyai yadyajñiyam | prajāpatervartanimanuvartasva | anu vīrairanurādhyāma gobhiḥ | anvaśvairanu sarvairu puṣṭaiḥ | anu prajayā'nvindriyeṇa
3.7.10.d: दैव्यः केतुर्विश्वं भुवनमाविवेश । स नः पाह्यरिष्ट्यै स्वाहा । अनु मा सर्वो यज्ञोऽयमेतु । विश्वे देवा मरुतः सामार्कः । आप्रियश्छन्दांसि निविदो यजूंषि । अस्यै पृथिव्यै यद्यज्ञियम् । प्रजापतेर्वर्तनिमनुवर्तस्व । अनु वीरैरनुराध्याम गोभिः । अन्वश्वैरनु सर्वैरु पुष्टैः । अनु प्रजयाऽन्विन्द्रियेण
3.7.10.m: the divine banner has entered the whole world; / protect us for injury-free survival, svāhā! / May this whole sacrifice follow after me, / the All-gods, the Maruts, the sāman, the praise song, / the Āprī hymns, the metres, the nivid formulas, the sacrificial formulas, / whatever belonging to this earth is sacrificial. / Follow the track of Prajāpati; / may we succeed following with heroes, with cattle, / following with horses, and following with all thriving things, / following with offspring, following with indriya power!

3.7.10.s: devā no yajñamṛjudhā nayantu | prati kṣattre prati tiṣṭhāmi rāṣṭre | pratyaśveṣu pratitiṣṭhāmi goṣu | prati prajāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhāmi bhavye | viśvamanyā'bhivāvṛdhe | tadanyasyāmadhiśritam | dive ca viśvakarmaṇe | pṛthivyai cākaraṃ namaḥ | askāndyauḥ pṛthivīm | askānṛṣabho yuvā gāḥ
3.7.10.d: देवा नो यज्ञमृजुधा नयन्तु । प्रति क्षत्त्रे प्रति तिष्ठामि राष्ट्रे । प्रत्यश्वेषु प्रतितिष्ठामि गोषु । प्रति प्रजायां प्रतितिष्ठामि भव्ये । विश्वमन्याऽभिवावृधे । तदन्यस्यामधिश्रितम् । दिवे च विश्वकर्मणे । पृथिव्यै चाकरं नमः । अस्कान्द्यौः पृथिवीम् । अस्कानृषभो युवा गाः
3.7.10.m: May the gods lead our sacrifice straight! / I stand firm in regal power, I stand firm in the realm, / I stand firm in horses, I stand firm in cattle, / I stand firm in offspring, I stand firm in what is to be. / The one has made everything grow; / that rests upon the other. / And to heaven, to Viśvakarman, / and to earth I have made homage. / Heaven leaped upon earth; / the young bull leaped upon the cows.

3.7.10.s: skannemā viśvā bhuvanā | skanno yajñaḥ prajanayatu | askānajani prājani | āskannājjāyate vṛṣā | skannātprajaniṣīmahi | ye devā yeṣāmidaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ babhūva | yeṣāṃ prayājā utānūyājāḥ | indrajyeṣṭhebhyo varuṇarājabhyaḥ | agnihotṛbhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā | uta tyā no divā matiḥ
3.7.10.d: स्कन्नेमा विश्वा भुवना । स्कन्नो यज्ञः प्रजनयतु । अस्कानजनि प्राजनि । आस्कन्नाज्जायते वृषा । स्कन्नात्प्रजनिषीमहि । ये देवा येषामिदं भागधेयं बभूव । येषां प्रयाजा उतानूयाजाः । इन्द्रज्येष्ठेभ्यो वरुणराजभ्यः । अग्निहोतृभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा । उत त्या नो दिवा मतिः
3.7.10.m: Spilled are all these worlds. / Let the spilled sacrifice produce [offspring]. / It has been spilled; it was born, it was generated. / From the spilled [seed] the bull is born. / From the spilled [seed] may we be born. / Which gods, to whom this share belonged, / whose are the fore-offerings and after-offerings, / to those with Indra as eldest, with Varuṇa as king, / to the gods with Agni as Hotṛ, svāhā! / And may that divine prayer of ours by day...

3.7.10.s: aditirūtyā''gamat | sā śantācī mayaskarat | apa sridhaḥ | uta tyā daivyā bhiṣajā | śaṃ naskarato aśvinā | yūyātāmasmadrapaḥ | apa sridhaḥ | śamagniragnibhiskarat | śaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ | śaṃ vāto vātvarapāḥ
3.7.10.d: अदितिरूत्या'ऽगमत् । सा शन्ताची मयस्करत् । अप स्रिधः । उत त्या दैव्या भिषजा । शं नस्करतो अश्विना । यूयातामस्मद्रपः । अप स्रिधः । शमग्निरग्निभिस्करत् । शं नस्तपतु सूर्यः । शं वातो वात्वरपाः
3.7.10.m: ...may Aditi come with aid. / May she, pacifying, bring joy. / Away with adversities! / And may those two divine physicians, / the Aśvins, bring welfare to us; / may they ward off disease from us. / Away with adversities! / May Agni bring welfare along with the fires; / may the sun shine welfare upon us; / may the wind blow free of disease, bringing welfare.

3.7.10.s: apa sridhaḥ | taditpadaṃ na viciketa vidvān | yanmṛtaḥ punarapyeti jīvān | trivṛdyadbhuvanasya rathavṛt | jīvo garbho na mṛtaḥ sa jīvāt | pratyasmai pipīṣate | viśvāni viduṣe bhara | araṃgamāya jagmave | apaścāddadhvane nare | indurindramavāgāt | indorindro'pāt | tasya ta indavindrapītasya madhumataḥ | upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi
3.7.10.d: अप स्रिधः । तदित्पदं न विचिकेत विद्वान् । यन्मृतः पुनरप्येति जीवान् । त्रिवृद्यद्भुवनस्य रथवृत् । जीवो गर्भो न मृतः स जीवात् । प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते । विश्वानि विदुषे भर । अरंगमाय जग्मवे । अपश्चाद्दध्वने नरे । इन्दुरिन्द्रमवागात् । इन्दोरिन्द्रोऽपात् । तस्य त इन्दविन्द्रपीतस्य मधुमतः । उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि
3.7.10.m: Away with adversities! / Not even the wise man knows that track, / by which one who has died returns to the living. / The threefold [chariot] of the world that revolves as a chariot, / may he, living as an embryo, not dead, live. / For him who wishes to drink, / bring all things to the wise one, / who arrives readily, who goes, / the man who does not lag behind. / The drop has approached the drop; / Indra has drunk of the drop. / Of that [drop] of yours, O drop, drunk by Indra, honeyed, / summoned, being summoned, I partake.

3.7.11.s: brahma pratiṣṭhā manaso brahma vācaḥ | brahma yajñānāṃ haviṣāmājyasya | atiriktaṃ karmaṇo yacca hīnam | yajñaḥ parvāṇi pratiranneti kalpayan | svāhākṛtā''hutiretu devān | āśrāvitamatyāśrāvitam | vaṣaṭkṛtamatyanūktaṃ ca yajñe | atiriktaṃ karmaṇo yacca hīnam | yajñaḥ parvāṇi pratiranneti kalpayan | svāhākṛtā''hutiretu devān
3.7.11.d: ब्रह्म प्रतिष्ठा मनसो ब्रह्म वाचः । ब्रह्म यज्ञानां हविषामाज्यस्य । अतिरिक्तं कर्मणो यच्च हीनम् । यज्ञः पर्वाणि प्रतिरन्नेति कल्पयन् । स्वाहाकृता'ऽहुतिरेतु देवान् । आश्रावितमत्याश्रावितम् । वषट्कृतमत्यनूक्तं च यज्ञे । अतिरिक्तं कर्मणो यच्च हीनम् । यज्ञः पर्वाणि प्रतिरन्नेति कल्पयन् । स्वाहाकृता'ऽहुतिरेतु देवान्
3.7.11.m: Brahman is the foundation of mind; brahman of speech; / brahman of sacrifices, of oblations, of clarified butter. / What is redundant in the rite and what is deficient, / the sacrifice, extending the joints, goes on putting in order. / May the oblation consecrated with svāhā reach the gods. / What was made to resound, what was made to over-resound, / what was pronounced with vaṣaṭ, and what was over-recited in the sacrifice, / what is redundant in the rite and what is deficient, / the sacrifice, extending the joints, goes on putting in order. / May the oblation consecrated with svāhā reach the gods.

3.7.11.s: yadvo devā atipādayāni | vācā citprayataṃ deva heḍanam | arāyo asmāṃ abhiducchunāyate | anyatrāsman marutastannidhetana | tataṃ ma āpastadu tāyate punaḥ | svādiṣṭhā dhītirucathāya śasyate | ayaṃ samudra uta viśvabheṣajaḥ | svāhākṛtasya samutṛpṇutarbhuvaḥ | udvayaṃ tamasaspari | udu tyaṃ citram
3.7.11.d: यद्वो देवा अतिपादयानि । वाचा चित्प्रयतं देव हेडनम् । अरायो अस्मां अभिदुच्छुनायते । अन्यत्रास्मन् मरुतस्तन्निधेतन । ततं म आपस्तदु तायते पुनः । स्वादिष्ठा धीतिरुचथाय शस्यते । अयं समुद्र उत विश्वभेषजः । स्वाहाकृतस्य समुतृप्णुतर्भुवः । उद्वयं तमसस्परि । उदु त्यं चित्रम्
3.7.11.m: If, O gods, I should overstep, / even with speech, an intention offending the gods, / the stingy one plots misfortune against us; / elsewhere from us, O Maruts, deposit that! / My work is extended; that indeed is extended again. / The sweetest reflection is recited for the chant. / This ocean is all-healing; / be satisfied with what is consecrated with svāhā, O Ṛbhus! / Up from darkness we, / Up that [sun], wondrous...

3.7.11.s: imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi | tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne | tvamagne ayāsi prajāpate | imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi | maiṣāṃ nu gādaparo ardhametam | śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīḥ | tiro mṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvatena | iṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍaniṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā | bheṣajaṃ duriṣṭyai svāhā niṣkṛtyai svāhā | daurārddhyai svāhā daivībhyastanūbhyaḥ svāhā
3.7.11.d: इमं मे वरुण तत्त्वा यामि । त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने । त्वमग्ने अयासि प्रजापते । इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि । मैषां नु गादपरो अर्धमेतम् । शतं जीवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीः । तिरो मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन । इष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा वषडनिष्टेभ्यः स्वाहा । भेषजं दुरिष्ट्यै स्वाहा निष्कृत्यै स्वाहा । दौरार्द्ध्यै स्वाहा दैवीभ्यस्तनूभ्यः स्वाहा
3.7.11.m: This my [prayer], O Varuṇa; That I ask of you; / You to us, O Agni; So you to us, O Agni; / You, O Agni, are Ayās; O Prajāpati; / This perimeter I place for the living, / lest any other of them go to this region now. / May they live a hundred full autumns; / let them conceal death with a mountain. / To the sacrificed, svāhā! To the unsacrificed, vaṣaṭ, svāhā! / Medicine for mis-sacrifice, svāhā! For expiation, svāhā! / For bad success, svāhā! To the divine bodies, svāhā!

3.7.11.s: ṛddhyai svāhā samṛddhyai svāhā | yata indra bhayāmahe | tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtaye | vi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi | svastidā viśaspatiḥ | vṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī | vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ | svastidā abhayaṃkaraḥ | ābhirgīrbhiryadato na ūnam
3.7.11.d: ऋद्ध्यै स्वाहा समृद्ध्यै स्वाहा । यत इन्द्र भयामहे । ततो नो अभयं कृधि । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये । वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि । स्वस्तिदा विशस्पतिः । वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी । वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः । स्वस्तिदा अभयंकरः । आभिर्गीर्भिर्यदतो न ऊनम्
3.7.11.m: To success, svāhā! To full success, svāhā! / Wherefrom we fear, O Indra, / therefrom make freedom from fear for us. / O bounteous one, grant that to us for aid; / destroy the haters, destroy the adversaries! / Giving welfare, the lord of the people, / the slayer of Vṛtra, the dispeller of adversaries, sovereign, / may the bull Indra go before us, / bestowing welfare, creating freedom from fear. / What is deficient from this through these songs...

3.7.11.s: āpyāyaya harivo vardhamānaḥ | yadā stotṛbhyo mahi gotrā rujāsi | bhūyiṣṭhabhājo adha te syāma | anājñātaṃ yadājñātam | yajñasya kriyate mithu | agne tadasya kalpaya | tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham | puruṣasaṃmito yajñaḥ | yajñaḥ puruṣasaṃmitaḥ | agne tadasya kalpaya | tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham | yatpākatrā manasā dīnadakṣā na | yajñasya manvate martāsaḥ | agniṣṭaddhotā kratuvidvijānan | yajiṣṭho devāṃ ṛtuśo yajāti
3.7.11.d: आप्यायय हरिवो वर्धमानः । यदा स्तोतृभ्यो महि गोत्रा रुजासि । भूयिष्ठभाजो अध ते स्याम । अनाज्ञातं यदाज्ञातम् । यज्ञस्य क्रियते मिथु । अग्ने तदस्य कल्पय । त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम् । पुरुषसंमितो यज्ञः । यज्ञः पुरुषसंमितः । अग्ने तदस्य कल्पय । त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम् । यत्पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा न । यज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्तासः । अग्निष्टद्धोता क्रतुविद्विजानन् । यजिष्ठो देवां ऋतुशो यजाति
3.7.11.m: Swell, O lord of bay steeds, increasing; / when for the praisers you burst open the great cow-pens, / then may we have the greatest shares. / What is unknown, what is known, / that is done mistakenly in the sacrifice, / O Agni, put that in order here; / for you know how it truly is. / The sacrifice is proportionate to man; / man is proportionate to the sacrifice. / O Agni, put that in order here; / for you know how it truly is. / If mortals with simple mind, weak in insight, / do not understand the sacrifice, / Agni, the Hotṛ, knowing the rite, discerning, / most sacrificial, shall sacrifice to the gods in due season.

3.7.12.s: yaddevā devaheḍanam | devāsaścakṛmā vayam | ādityāstasmānmā muñcata | ṛtasyartena māmuta | devā jīvanakāmyā yat | vācā'nṛtamūdima | agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ | gārhapatyaḥ pramuñcatu | duritā yāni cakṛma | karotu māmanenasam
3.7.12.d: यद्देवा देवहेडनम् । देवासश्चकृमा वयम् । आदित्यास्तस्मान्मा मुञ्चत । ऋतस्यर्तेन मामुत । देवा जीवनकाम्या यत् । वाचाऽनृतमूदिम । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः । गार्हपत्यः प्रमुञ्चतु । दुरिता यानि चकृम । करोतु मामनेनसम्
3.7.12.m: Whatever offense to the gods, O gods, / we have committed, O gods, / O Ādityas, release me from that, / and by the truth of cosmic order, release me! / If, O gods, desiring life, / we have spoken falsehood with speech, / may Agni Gārhapatya / release me from that sin! / Whatever bad deeds we have done, / may he make me sinless!

3.7.12.s: ṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī | ṛtena tvaṃ sarasvati | ṛtānmā muñcatāṃhasaḥ | yadanyakṛtamārima | sajātaśaṃsāduta vā jāmiśaṃsāt | jyāyasaḥ śaṃsāduta vā kanīyasaḥ | anājñātaṃ devakṛtaṃ yadenaḥ | tasmāttvamasmānjātavedo mumugdhi | yadvācā yanmanasā | bāhubhyāmūrubhyāmaṣṭhīvadbhyām
3.7.12.d: ऋतेन द्यावापृथिवी । ऋतेन त्वं सरस्वति । ऋतान्मा मुञ्चतांहसः । यदन्यकृतमारिम । सजातशंसादुत वा जामिशंसात् । ज्यायसः शंसादुत वा कनीयसः । अनाज्ञातं देवकृतं यदेनः । तस्मात्त्वमस्मान्जातवेदो मुमुग्धि । यद्वाचा यन्मनसा । बाहुभ्यामूरुभ्यामष्ठीवद्भ्याम्
3.7.12.m: By cosmic order, O heaven and earth, / by cosmic order, you, O Sarasvatī, / by cosmic order, release me from distress, / whatever committed by another we have contracted! / From the curse of a kinsman or from the curse of a sibling, / from the curse of an elder or from of a younger, / whatever unknown sin committed against the gods [there be], / from that release us, O Jātavedas! / What by speech, what by mind, / by arms, by thighs, by knees...

3.7.12.s: śiśnairyadanṛtaṃ cakṛmā vayam | agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ | yaddhastābhyāṃ cakara kilbiṣāṇi | akṣāṇāṃ vagnumupa jighnamānaḥ | dūrepaśyā ca rāṣṭrabhṛcca | tānyapsarasāvanu dattā mṛṇāni | adīvyannṛṇaṃ yadahaṃ cakāra | yadvā'dāsyanthsaṃjagārā janebhyaḥ | agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ | yanmayi mātā garbhe sati
3.7.12.d: शिश्नैर्यदनृतं चकृमा वयम् । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः । यद्धस्ताभ्यां चकर किल्बिषाणि । अक्षाणां वग्नुमुप जिघ्नमानः । दूरेपश्या च राष्ट्रभृच्च । तान्यप्सरसावनु दत्ता मृणानि । अदीव्यन्नृणं यदहं चकार । यद्वाऽदास्यन्थ्संजगारा जनेभ्यः । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः । यन्मयि माता गर्भे सति
3.7.12.m: ...by genitals, whatever untruth we have committed, / may Agni [release] me from that sin! / What offenses I have committed with both hands, / beating down upon the rattle of the dice, / Far-seeing and Nation-bearing, / let those two Apsarases remit those debts! / What debt I incurred without gambling, / or what I promised to people without intending to give, / may Agni [release] me from that sin! / What my mother, while I was in the womb...

3.7.12.s: enaścakāra yatpitā | agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ | yadā pipeṣa mātaraṃ pitaram | putraḥ pramudito dhayan | ahiṃsitau pitarau mayā tat | tadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi | yadantarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmuta dyām | yanmātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihiṃsima | agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ | yadāśasā niśasā yatparāśasā
3.7.12.d: एनश्चकार यत्पिता । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः । यदा पिपेष मातरं पितरम् । पुत्रः प्रमुदितो धयन् । अहिंसितौ पितरौ मया तत् । तदग्ने अनृणो भवामि । यदन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीमुत द्याम् । यन्मातरं पितरं वा जिहिंसिम । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः । यदाशसा निशसा यत्पराशसा
3.7.12.m: ...committed as sin, what my father [did], / may Agni [release] me from that sin! / If, suckling, a joyful son / has hurt mother or father, / may the parents be unharmed by me in that; / in that, O Agni, may I be free of debt. / If the atmosphere, earth, or sky, / if mother or father we have harmed, / may Agni [release] me from that sin! / What by wishful thinking, what by whispering, what by slander...

3.7.12.s: yadenaścakṛmā nūtanaṃ yatpurāṇam | agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ | atikrāmāmi duritaṃ yadenaḥ | jahāmi ripraṃ parame sadhasthe | yatra yanti sukṛto nāpi duṣkṛtaḥ | tamārohāmi sukṛtāṃ nu lokam | trite devā amṛjataitadenaḥ | trita etanmanuṣyeṣu māmṛje | tato mā yadi kiṃcidānaśe | agnirmā tasmādenasaḥ
3.7.12.d: यदेनश्चकृमा नूतनं यत्पुराणम् । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः । अतिक्रामामि दुरितं यदेनः । जहामि रिप्रं परमे सधस्थे । यत्र यन्ति सुकृतो नापि दुष्कृतः । तमारोहामि सुकृतां नु लोकम् । त्रिते देवा अमृजतैतदेनः । त्रित एतन्मनुष्येषु मामृजे । ततो मा यदि किंचिदानशे । अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसः
3.7.12.m: ...whatever sin we have committed, new or old, / may Agni [release] me from that sin! / I step over whatever sin is a misdeed; / I leave behind stain in the highest assembly. / Where the doers of good go, not the doers of evil, / to that realm of the doers of good I now ascend. / Upon Trita the gods wiped off this sin; / Trita wiped it off upon humans; / thence if anything has reached me, / may Agni [release] me from that sin!

3.7.12.s: gārhapatyaḥ pramuñcatu | duritā yāni cakṛma | karotu māmanenasam | divi jātā apsu jātāḥ | yā jātā oṣadhībhyaḥ | atho yā agnijā āpaḥ | tā naḥ śundhantu śundhanīḥ | yadāpo naktaṃ duritaṃ carāma | yadvā divā nūtanaṃ yatpurāṇam | hiraṇyavarṇāstata utpunīta naḥ | imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi | tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne | tvamagne ayā'si
3.7.12.d: गार्हपत्यः प्रमुञ्चतु । दुरिता यानि चकृम । करोतु मामनेनसम् । दिवि जाता अप्सु जाताः । या जाता ओषधीभ्यः । अथो या अग्निजा आपः । ता नः शुन्धन्तु शुन्धनीः । यदापो नक्तं दुरितं चराम । यद्वा दिवा नूतनं यत्पुराणम् । हिरण्यवर्णास्तत उत्पुनीत नः । इमं मे वरुण तत्त्वा यामि । त्वं नो अग्ने स त्वं नो अग्ने । त्वमग्ने अयाऽसि
3.7.12.m: May Gārhapatya release [me]! / Whatever bad deeds we have done, / may he make me sinless! / Born in heaven, born in the waters, / which are born from plants, / and the waters that are born of fire, / may they, the cleansers, cleanse us. / If by night, O waters, we commit a misdeed, / or if by day, new or old, / O golden-hued ones, purify us out of that! / This my [prayer], O Varuṇa; That I ask of you; / You to us, O Agni; So you to us, O Agni; / You, O Agni, are Ayās...

3.7.13.s: yatte grāvṇṇā cicchiduḥ soma rājan | priyāṇyaṅgāni svadhitā parūṃṣi | tathsaṃdhathsvājyenota vardhayasva | anāgaso adhamithsaṃkṣayema | yatte grāvā bāhucyuto acucyavuḥ | naro yatte duduhurdakṣiṇena | tatta āpyāyatāṃ tatte | niṣṭyāyatāṃ deva soma | yatte tvacaṃ bibhiduryacca yonim | yadāsthānātpracyuto venasi tmanā
3.7.13.d: यत्ते ग्राव्ण्णा चिच्छिदुः सोम राजन् । प्रियाण्यङ्गानि स्वधिता परूंषि । तथ्संधथ्स्वाज्येनोत वर्धयस्व । अनागसो अधमिथ्संक्षयेम । यत्ते ग्रावा बाहुच्युतो अचुच्यवुः । नरो यत्ते दुदुहुर्दक्षिणेन । तत्त आप्यायतां तत्ते । निष्ट्यायतां देव सोम । यत्ते त्वचं बिभिदुर्यच्च योनिम् । यदास्थानात्प्रच्युतो वेनसि त्मना
3.7.13.m:
What they cut of you with the pressing-stone, O King Soma,
your dear limbs, the joints with the knife,
unite that with clarified butter, and make yourself flourish!
May we, free from guilt, dwell together in prosperity.
What they made fall of you, as the stone fell from the arm,
what the men milked of you with the right [hand],
let that swell for you, let that
be restored to you!
What they tore of your skin and what of your womb,
as you yearn, having fallen from your place by yourself:

3.7.13.s: tvayā tathsoma guptamastu naḥ | sā naḥ saṃdhā'satparame vyoman | ahāccharīraṃ payasā sametya | anyo'nyo bhavati varṇo asya | tasminvayamupahūtāstava smaḥ | ā no bhaja sadasi viśvarūpe | nṛcakṣāḥ soma uta śuśrugastu | mā no vihāsīdgira āvṛṇānaḥ | anāgāstanuvo vāvṛdhānaḥ | ā no rūpaṃ vahatu jāyamānaḥ
3.7.13.d: त्वया तथ्सोम गुप्तमस्तु नः । सा नः संधाऽसत्परमे व्योमन् । अहाच्छरीरं पयसा समेत्य । अन्योऽन्यो भवति वर्णो अस्य । तस्मिन्वयमुपहूतास्तव स्मः । आ नो भज सदसि विश्वरूपे । नृचक्षाः सोम उत शुश्रुगस्तु । मा नो विहासीद्गिर आवृणानः । अनागास्तनुवो वावृधानः । आ नो रूपं वहतु जायमानः
3.7.13.m:
by you, O Soma, let that be guarded for us!
May that union of ours be in the highest firmament!
He has abandoned his body, uniting with milk;
one after another is his color.
Invited into that, we belong to you.
Grant us a share in the all-formed assembly!
May Soma be farsighted and attentive!
May he not forsake us, receiving our songs,
free from guilt, having strengthened his bodies!
May he, being born, convey beauty unto us!

3.7.13.s: upakṣaranti juhvo ghṛtena | priyāṇyaṅgāni tava vardhayantīḥ | tasmai te soma nama idvaṣaṭca | upa mā rājanthsukṛte hvayasva | saṃprāṇāpānābhyāṃ samu cakṣuṣā tvam | saṃ śrotreṇa gacchasva soma rājan | yatta āsthitaṃ śamu tatte astu | jānītānnaḥ saṃgamane pathīnām | etaṃ jānītātparame vyoman | vṛkāḥ sadhasthā vida rūpamasya
3.7.13.d: उपक्षरन्ति जुह्वो घृतेन । प्रियाण्यङ्गानि तव वर्धयन्तीः । तस्मै ते सोम नम इद्वषट्च । उप मा राजन्थ्सुकृते ह्वयस्व । संप्राणापानाभ्यां समु चक्षुषा त्वम् । सं श्रोत्रेण गच्छस्व सोम राजन् । यत्त आस्थितं शमु तत्ते अस्तु । जानीतान्नः संगमने पथीनाम् । एतं जानीतात्परमे व्योमन् । वृकाः सधस्था विद रूपमस्य
3.7.13.m:
The ladles flow over with clarified butter,
strengthening your dear limbs.
To you, O Soma, be homage and vaṣaṭ!
Summon me, O King, for virtuous action!
Be united with exhalation and inhalation, and with sight;
be united with hearing, O King Soma!
What has been placed upon you, let that be peace for you!
Know us at the meeting of paths!
Know this one in the highest firmament!
O wolves of the assembly, discern his form!

3.7.13.s: yadā gacchātpathibhirdevayānaiḥ | iṣṭāpūrte kṛṇutādāvirasmai | ariṣṭo rājannagadaḥ parehi | namaste astu cakṣase raghūyate | nākamāroha saha yajamānena | sūryaṃ gacchatātparame vyoman | abhūddevaḥ savitā vandyo nu naḥ | idānīmahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ | vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ | śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat | upa no mitrāvaruṇāvihāvatam | anvādīdhyāthāmiha naḥ sakhāyā | ādityānāṃ prasitirhetiḥ | ugrā śatāpāṣṭhā ghaviṣā pari ṇo vṛṇaktu | āpyāyasva saṃ te
3.7.13.d: यदा गच्छात्पथिभिर्देवयानैः । इष्टापूर्ते कृणुतादाविरस्मै । अरिष्टो राजन्नगदः परेहि । नमस्ते अस्तु चक्षसे रघूयते । नाकमारोह सह यजमानेन । सूर्यं गच्छतात्परमे व्योमन् । अभूद्देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु नः । इदानीमह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः । वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः । श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणं यथा दधत् । उप नो मित्रावरुणाविहावतम् । अन्वादीध्याथामिह नः सखाया । आदित्यानां प्रसितिर्हेतिः । उग्रा शतापाष्ठा घविषा परि णो वृणक्तु । आप्यायस्व सं ते
3.7.13.m:
When he comes along the paths traveled by the gods,
reveal to him his sacrifices and charitable gifts!
Uninjured, O King, free from sickness, go forth!
Homage be to your swift-moving eye!
Ascend to the vault of heaven together with the sacrificer!
Go to the sun in the highest firmament!
The divine Savitṛ has now become worthy of our praise,
to be invoked by men at this time of the day,
he who distributes treasures to mankind,
so that he may bestow the best wealth upon us here!
Come here and aid us, O Mitra and Varuṇa!
May the two friends attend to us here!
May the snare, the missile of the Ādityas,
fierce, having a hundred barbs, full of poison, spare us!
‘Swell up...’, ‘May they unite for you...’

3.7.14.s: yaddidīkṣe manasā yacca vācā | yadvā prāṇaiścakṣuṣā yacca śrotreṇa | yadretasā mithunenāpyātmanā | adbhyo lokā dadhire teja indriyam | śukrā dīkṣāyai tapaso vimocanīḥ | āpo vimoktrīrmayi teja indriyam | yadṛcā sāmnā yajuṣā | paśūnāṃ carman haviṣā didīkṣe | yacchandobhiroṣadhībhirvanaspatau | adbhyo lokā dadhire teja indriyam
3.7.14.d: यद्दिदीक्षे मनसा यच्च वाचा । यद्वा प्राणैश्चक्षुषा यच्च श्रोत्रेण । यद्रेतसा मिथुनेनाप्यात्मना । अद्भ्यो लोका दधिरे तेज इन्द्रियम् । शुक्रा दीक्षायै तपसो विमोचनीः । आपो विमोक्त्रीर्मयि तेज इन्द्रियम् । यदृचा साम्ना यजुषा । पशूनां चर्मन् हविषा दिदीक्षे । यच्छन्दोभिरोषधीभिर्वनस्पतौ । अद्भ्यो लोका दधिरे तेज इन्द्रियम्
3.7.14.m:
In that I consecrated myself with mind and with speech,
or with the breaths, with sight, and with hearing,
with seed, with a partner, and with self—
from the waters the worlds have established fiery energy and sensory power.
Bright, releasing from the consecration, from ascetic heat,
may the releasing waters [establish] in me fiery energy and sensory power!
In that I consecrated myself with ṛc, with sāman, with yajus,
on the hide of cattle, with the oblation,
in that with meters, with plants, on a tree—
from the waters the worlds have established fiery energy and sensory power.

3.7.14.s: śukrā dīkṣāyai tapaso vimocanīḥ | āpo vimoktrīrmayi teja indriyam | yena brahma yena kṣatram | yenendrāgnī prajāpatiḥ somo varuṇo yena rājā | viśve devā ṛṣayo yena prāṇāḥ | adbhyo lokā dadhire teja indriyam | śukrā dīkṣāyai tapaso vimocanīḥ | āpo vimoktrīrmayi teja indriyam | apāṃ puṣpamasyoṣadhīnāṃ rasaḥ | somasya priyaṃ dhāma
3.7.14.d: शुक्रा दीक्षायै तपसो विमोचनीः । आपो विमोक्त्रीर्मयि तेज इन्द्रियम् । येन ब्रह्म येन क्षत्रम् । येनेन्द्राग्नी प्रजापतिः सोमो वरुणो येन राजा । विश्वे देवा ऋषयो येन प्राणाः । अद्भ्यो लोका दधिरे तेज इन्द्रियम् । शुक्रा दीक्षायै तपसो विमोचनीः । आपो विमोक्त्रीर्मयि तेज इन्द्रियम् । अपां पुष्पमस्योषधीनां रसः । सोमस्य प्रियं धाम
3.7.14.m:
Bright, releasing from the consecration, from ascetic heat,
may the releasing waters [establish] in me fiery energy and sensory power!
Whereby brahman, whereby regal power,
whereby Indra and Agni, Prajāpati, Soma, Varuṇa the king,
the All-Gods, the sages, whereby the breaths [are established]—
from the waters the worlds have established fiery energy and sensory power.
Bright, releasing from the consecration, from ascetic heat,
may the releasing waters [establish] in me fiery energy and sensory power!
You are the flower of the waters, the sap of the plants,
the dear domain of Soma.
